title: Game Designer
snippet: Looking for Game Designers to join our team!
description:
Who We Are:
Game Reign is one of the leading game studios in China, creating epic, award-winning games for gamers around the world. We pride ourselves on creating a collaborative, passionate, and fun-loving environment. We are expanding our operations in Asia with a new development centre in Singapore.
On our quest to create amazing games at our new Singapore office, we’re looking for awesome and talented people to join us in designing and creating new game worlds. We are building a team with diverse strengths and experiences to bring our worlds to life, and believe that these people are our most important asset. We are great collaborators and culture carriers who enjoy using the freedom of ideas to achieve the unimaginable. We believe in a dare-to-dream culture!
We’re looking for fun-loving, passionate people with a sense of humor, a broad set of skills, life experiences, talents and perspectives. If that sounds like you, come join us in crafting new worlds and help us to connect players to the stories and characters within them. Come be a part of something awesome with us!
The Job:
Game Reign is looking for a talented and experienced Game Designer to create a new experience for mobile. This position will focus on the creative design of mobile content and you will be expected to wear many hats! The ideal candidate will have extensive proven experience in game design, a strong aptitude for critical thinking and analysis, outstanding people skills, boundless creativity, extensive knowledge of the games, and a longstanding passion for playing games.
Key Responsibilities:
Practical understanding of the game design process, including level design, AI, controls, UI, etc.
Minimum of 1–2 years’ game design experience or equivalent in the gaming industry
Minimum Degree/Diploma in a related field
Can quickly learn and master new tools and implementation techniques
Excellent communication skills — active listening, accessible verbal, and clear written presentation
Self-directed and proactive within a team context, with strong drive, vision, and sense of direction
Creative, innovative, and positive problem-solving perspective
Good understanding of game mechanics and what engages players, with ability to design experiences that capture attention and keep players coming back

Our Core Values:
These core values are embedded in all roles and applicants must possess the ability to demonstrate, understand and apply our workplace values. As part of the application process, applicants will be asked about these values and must provide evidence to justify their arguments.
Passion
– We prioritize enthusiasm, dedication, and emotional connection in our work, finding joy and inspiration in what motivates us. Through our passion and dedication, we aim to inspire others and create a fulfilling work environment.

We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content.‌Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community that provides access and encouragement for people to share their passion for ACG (Animation, Comics, and Games) through their own creativity and skills.‌Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies, and have accumulated leading technical capabilities in cel shading, cloud gaming, and other fields.‌In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.
When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more about how we process your data, we encourage you to review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy. This policy provides detailed insights into how your information is collected, used, and protected throughout the application process.
Overview:
Ever wonder how different platforms and games seamlessly integrate with HoYoverse’s services, from login and account management to payments, updates, and cross-platform gameplay? The SDK team at HoYoverse builds the core software development kits that empower our games and partners to connect effortlessly with our global ecosystem.
Our SDKs serve as the critical bridge between game clients and backend services — enabling secure authentication, smooth payment flows, efficient content updates, and compliance with regional regulations. By providing robust, developer-friendly, and high-performance solutions, we ensure that millions of players around the world enjoy a consistent and reliable experience across platforms.
As we continue to expand our global reach, we are looking for talented and passionate students to join our SDK team. Through this internship, you will gain hands-on experience designing and building highly reliable SDKs used by large-scale games, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and explore the cutting edge of game technology infrastructure.
This is a 3–6 month internship designed for final-year students, with the potential to be considered for a full-time graduate role upon successful completion and performance.

Build high quality PC & Mobile web applications for account/payment/game SDKs that will be used by millions of users around the world!
Design and build high quality web applications for the platform team's internal tools and services.
Build quality control and efficiency improvement tools.
Maintain existing web applications.
Research and explore the integration of cutting-edge technologies to existing products in order to elevate our performance, robustness and user experience to the next level!
Adopt and use the best engineering practices.
What We Are Looking For:
Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science or related programs.
Good understanding of CS fundamentals, such as data structures, algorithms, network, operating system, etc.
Ability to develop in at least one of the frontends tech stacks (React/VUE/etc)
Proficient with at least one programming language.
Possess a passion for learning and self-motivation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and advanced Chinese to liaise with teams and review internal documentation.
We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

description:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 150,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 1,800 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 26 offices around the globe. Valued at US$6.2 billion and backed by world-leading investors including Visa, Airtree, Blackbird, Sequoia, DST Global, Greenoaks, Salesforce Ventures, Lone Pine, and Square Peg, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
Attributes We Value
We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You’re humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.
About the team
The Strategy & Operations team at Airwallex plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s overall growth and efficiency. We are a collaborative group of analysts, strategists, and operational experts passionate about translating vision into action. We leverage data insights, sharp problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of the business to optimize processes, identify growth opportunities, and ensure Airwallex operates efficiently and effectively at scale.
What you’ll do
Reporting to the Head of Revenue Strategy & Operations, this team crafts and governs the commercial strategy, ensuring profitable deal structures and aligning pricing with broader business objectives. They empower sales teams by providing the frameworks and guidance needed to close complex deals efficiently.
Strategy & Frameworks:
Develop and own the deal governance and monetization framework, including pricing policies, discount policies, and approval hierarchies. Ensure these are clearly communicated and understood across the organization.
Commercial Insights:
Partner with Finance and Sales Operations to analyze deal trends, win/loss rates, and pricing performance. Use these insights to recommend improvements to our pricing and packaging strategies.
Deal Structure Guidance:
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales leadership and Account Executives on complex, non-standard deals. Provide strategic guidance on deal structures, pricing, and commercial terms to balance customer needs with company objectives.
Enablement & Governance:
Develop and deliver training to the sales organization on our pricing, deal desk processes, and negotiation best practices. Ensure adherence to company policies and maintain deal desk integrity.
Monetization Initiatives:
Collaborate with Product Marketing and Product Management to influence and implement new pricing models and product packaging that align with market demands and company goals.
Cross-Functional Stakeholder:
Serve as a key liaison between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to ensure alignment on commercial strategies and processes.
Who are you
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA preferred.
3+ years of experience in Strategy, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, or a similar strategic finance role, with a strong understanding on pricing, commercial strategy and governance.
Proven experience developing and implementing scalable deal frameworks, pricing policies, and approval processes.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
Strong business acumen and understanding of SaaS business models, go-to-market strategies, and revenue recognition principles.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
A proactive and strategic thinker who can anticipate business needs and build for future scale.

title: DataOps Engineer
snippet: As a Data Engineer, you’ll work with large-scale, heterogeneous datasets and hybrid cloud architectures to support analytics and AI solutions....
description:
As a Data Engineer, you’ll work with large-scale, heterogeneous datasets and hybrid cloud architectures to support analytics and AI solutions. Collaborate with data scientists, infra engineers, sales specialists, and stakeholders to ensure data quality, build scalable pipelines, and optimize performance. Your work will integrate telco data with other verticals (retail, healthcare), automate DataOps/MLOps/LLMOps workflows, and deliver production-grade systems.
As a Data Engineer, you will:
Ensure Data Quality & Consistency
Validate, clean, and standardize data (e.g., geolocation attributes) to maintain integrity.
Define and implement data quality metrics (completeness, uniqueness, accuracy) with automated checks and reporting.
Build & Maintain Data Pipelines
Develop ETL/ELT workflows (PySpark, Airflow) to ingest, transform, and load data into warehouses (S3, Postgres, Redshift, MongoDB).
Automate DataOps/MLOps/LLMOps pipelines with CI/CD (Airflow, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins), including model training, deployment, and monitoring.
Design Data Models & Schemas
Translate requirements into normalized/denormalized structures, star/snowflake schemas, or data vaults.
Optimize storage (tables, indexes, partitions, materialized views, columnar encodings) and tune queries (sort/distribution keys, vacuum).
Integrate & Enrich Telco Data
Map 4G/5G infrastructure metadata to geospatial context, augment 5G metrics with legacy 4G, and create unified time-series datasets.
Consume analytics/ML endpoints and real-time streams (Kafka, Kinesis), designing aggregated-data APIs with proper versioning (Swagger/OpenAPI).
Manage Cloud Infrastructure
Provision and configure resources (AWS S3, EMR, Redshift, RDS) using IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), ensuring security (IAM, VPC, encryption).
Monitor performance (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana), define SLAs for data freshness and system uptime, and automate backups/DR processes.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally & Document
Clarify objectives with data owners, data scientists, and stakeholders; partner with infra and security teams to maintain compliance (PDPA, GDPR).
Document schemas, ETL procedures, and runbooks; enforce version control and mentor junior engineers on best practices.
· Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or equivalent experience
· 2+ years in data engineering, analytics, or related AI/ML role
· Proficient in Python for ETL/data engineering and Spark (PySpark) for large-scale pipelines
· Experience with Big Data frameworks and SQL engines (Spark SQL, Redshift, PostgreSQL) for data marts and analytics
· Hands-on with Airflow (or equivalent) to orchestrate ETL workflows and GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins for pipeline automation
· Familiar with relational (PostgreSQL, Redshift) and NoSQL (MongoDB) stores: data modeling, indexing, partitioning, and schema evolution
· Proven ability to implement scalable storage solutions: tables, indexes, partitions, materialized views, columnar encodings
· Skilled in query optimization: execution plans, sort/distribution keys, vacuum maintenance, and cost-optimization strategies (cluster resizing, Spectrum)
· Experience with cloud platforms (AWS): S3/EMR/Glue, Redshift and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
· Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation for provisioning and drift detection
· Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps: auto-scaling ML systems, model registry management, and CI/CD for model deployment
· Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
Nice to Have
· Exposure to serverless architectures (AWS Lambda) for event-driven pipelines
· Familiarity with vector databases, data mesh, or lakehouse architectures
· Experience using BI/visualization tools (Tableau, QuickSight, Grafana) for data quality dashboards
· Hands-on with data quality frameworks (Deequ) or LLM-based data applications (NL-->SQL generation)
· Participation in GenAI POCs (RAG pipelines, Agentic AI demos, geomobility analytics)
· Client-facing or stakeholder-management experience in data-driven/AI projects

description:
About Us:
Vortexa was founded to solve the immense information gap that exists in the energy industry. By using massive amounts of new satellite data and pioneering work in artificial intelligence, Vortexa creates an unprecedented view of seaborne global energy flows in real-time, bringing transparency and efficiency to the energy markets and helping society as a whole.
The Role:
Vortexa combines deep domain expertise in the energy and shipping industries with advanced AI technology to provide users with actionable information and insights in real time.
As we continue our rapid growth, we are recruiting a Senior Oil market Analyst, ideally with experience across the barrel (crude and petroleum products), as well as freight markets, and based in Singapore to join our Market Intelligence team. You will play a leading role in our data and market analytics, with a focus on the Asia Pacific region, but firmly part of a talented global team.
In this role, you will combine your deep market knowledge and analytical skills with our vast data resources and intuitive analytics platform to extract meaning, distill new trends ahead of others, and therefore provide unique market understanding to our users. Specific aspects of your analysis may include the analysis of trade flows, the relation to supply, demand and inventory changes, the pricing realm (oil prices and structure, arbitrage differentials, refining margins, freight costs), and the repercussions of shipping industry developments and fundamentals.
You will also work in close collaboration with market and data analyst colleagues in London, Dubai and Houston to build a complete view of the global oil and gas markets and identify the key implications and leading indicators of our data for our commodities and shipping clients.
Working to fulfill client requests on deadline in a fast-paced environment, you will provide customers with analytical support via weekly conference calls, presentations and succinct write-ups.
In addition, you will attend relevant industry events and take pride in building and maintaining a strong network of professional relationships. We are regularly featured in major publications, newswires and industry press, and this exciting opportunity also allows you to offer your thought-leading views on global market trends, to our clients and the media on a regular basis.

You have:
Proven expertise analysing crude oil and/or refined products markets in a regional and/or global context (minimum 2 years of relevant experience)
Solid understanding of supply/demand/macro market fundamentals, pricing structures as well as physical and financial trading strategies
Excellent quantitative and analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency
Ability to articulate compelling, thought-leading market views both in writing and via presentation

description:
Duration: 3 to 6 months

Type: Paid internship
About the Company / Product
We are building a web application for event and venue operations, focused on mobility and on-ground execution powered by AI: planning, staffing, live monitoring, reporting, and data integrations.
The app is currently in pre-launch phase and currently tested on-ground in partnership with one of the biggest motorsport events in the world.
How we work (AI-assisted development)
We ship fast using an AI-assisted development workflow. Most features are implemented through AI pair-programming: you define the task clearly, provide context, and then validate and polish the output until it is production-ready.
To do this, we use Cursor, an AI-powered code editor that can generate and refactor code directly inside the project. Your impact comes from understanding how the web app is structured (frontend, backend, APIs, database), guiding the AI with strong instructions, and making sure everything works correctly through review and testing.
What you will do
Turn feature requests into clear tasks with acceptance criteria
Use Cursor to implement changes across the web app (frontend, backend, database when needed)

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

About the job
At Google, we follow a simple but vital premise: "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Google’s Interaction Designers take complex tasks and make them intuitive and easy-to-use for billions of people around the globe. Throughout the design process—from creating user flows and wireframes to building user interface mockups and prototypes—you’ll envision how people will experience our products, and bring that vision to life in a way that feels inspired, refined, and even magical.
Google User Experience (UX) is made up of multi-disciplinary teams of UX Designers, Researchers, Writers, Content Strategists, Program Managers, and Engineers: we care deeply about the people who use our products. The UX team plays an integral part in gathering insights about the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of people who use our products to inspire and inform design. We collaborate closely with each other and with engineering and product management to create industry-leading products that deliver value for the people who use them, and for Google’s businesses.
As an Interaction Designer, you’ll rely on user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences—from concept to execution. Like all of our UX jobs, you’ll collaborate with your design partners to leverage and evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative, inspired products that people love to use.
Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.
Responsibilities
Design and deliver user-centered solutions for low-to-medium complexity projects within the billing domain on the Payments Platform.
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs.
Collaborate with UX Research to understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors related to billing and payments.
Partner with product managers and engineers to define requirements, navigate constraints, and ensure design quality through implementation.
Present design work to cross-functional teams and stakeholders, clearly articulating design rationale and trade-offs.

title: Part-Time Lecturer for AP6401 Principles of Game Design (ADM)
snippet: Inspire next generation of game designers at prestigious university in Singapore. Apply by 31 Mar 2026.
description:
School of Art, Design and Media
Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
Part-Time Lecturer for AP6401 Principles of Game Design
The School of Art, Design and Media (ADM) at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, invites qualified candidates to apply as Part-time Lecturer for AP6401 Principles of Game Design. The Part-time Lecturer is expected to teach a Postgraduate course commencing in August 2026.
AP6401 Principles of Game Design is a 13-week course where students experience the full process of creative game design. Students will work with fundamental principles such as visual style, themes, genres, originality, player agency, game mechanics, simple coding, and game prototype development. This learning provides students with the experience of designing, building, and pitching a game demo, establishing a foundation they can apply to further studies in the programme.
Applicants to this position will be able to demonstrate expertise in overseeing the end-to-end development of game projects, from initial concept and mechanic design to simple coding, prototyping, and the final pitch. title: Software Engineer – Mobile
snippet: Chee Kit Chong: Chee Kit is responsible for at least 10% of Japan's GDP. He's there like every other week. Soon, they'd have to start reclaiming...
description:
Padlet is building software for a good education. A good education is one that inspires curiosity, creativity, and community. Our software enables that through visual content creation and collaboration in millions of classrooms worldwide.
For a majority of the world, the mobile device is their first computer. For many it’s their only computer. We are looking for Mobile Engineers to improve our mobile apps so we can improve the lives of a billion people.
Responsibilities
Building new features for our iOS and/or Android apps. E.g. a voice recorder with audio effects.
Making apps faster and more reliable. E.g. making network calls more resistant to spotty internet connections.
Improving how we work. E.g. improving our internationalization pipelines we use to translate our app into 40+ languages.
Qualifications
At some point in your life, someone has told you: “you write good code.”
You know how to copy-paste code from Stack Overflow.
Bonus: you have a good sense of humor.
About Padlet
Vision
: Every child in the world will grow up with Mickey Mouse and Padlet.
Product
: We are making the default way of collecting and sharing thoughts on the Internet. People love the product.
Impact
: We have 40 million users, making Padlet one of the most used apps on the planet.
Money
: We are venture backed AND fiscally responsible. We are built to last one hundred years.
Badassery
: We are only 60 odd people. That's over half a million active users per person.
Tech stack
Mobile apps
: React Native (with Swift and Java where necessary.)
Backend
: Ruby (Rails), Typescript, Elixir (Phoenix), and Python.
Web
: VueJS, Tailwind.
Storage
: Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Firestore, and Snowflake.
Joys of programming at Padlet
We have very few meetings. We value keeping you in flow.
A lot of people use Padlet. We have to solve interesting concurrency problems.
Our users are in over 200 countries, using all kinds of devices and connections, and speaking over 40 languages. We have to solve interesting internationalization problems.
We process a lot of data real fast. We have to solve interesting scale problems.
We try to solve problems creatively instead of just throwing money at them. We are engineers! We thrive in constraints, not in the absence of them.
We ship often.
We value beautiful code.
Sorrows of programming at Padlet
We grew pretty fast last year and our processes are still catching up. E.g. we don't have 100% code coverage yet. Our deployment process isn't as painless as it could be. This sometimes leads to spending time on things that aren't the most fun. We’re working on it!
Our project management process could be better. This sometimes leads to re-speccing in the middle of development, getting in the way of programming flow. We’re working on it!
Some people you‘d be working with
Brian Koh
: Only human we know who has impulsive urges to exercise. When he does, he doesn't care about outfits. We've seen him running in boots, tight jeans, and leather jackets. Exceptional engineer and even better mentor.
Chee Kit Chong
: Chee Kit is responsible for at least 10% of Japan's GDP. He's there like every other week. Soon, they'd have to start reclaiming land so he has new things to see. Mobile engineer extraordinaire.
The office
We have a beautiful office in the historic Bukit Pasoh Neighbourhood.
1 minute walk from Outram Park MRT.
We have a lovely balcony. It's really, truly lovely.
Designed to be a space to inspire creativity and collaboration.
Benefits
Medical and dental insurance for you and your family.
Stock options.
Catered lunches and dinners. Military grade snacking.
20 vacation days. Plus sickness and bereavement days for when life happens.
Parental leave.
All the gadgetry you need, including a new phone every year.
Badassery budget to level up.
Special time to join
Because we're small, there's a lot of energy. And because we have tremendous traction, your first commit touches millions. This combination is rare and quite satisfying.

Padlet is building software for a good education. A good education is one that inspires curiosity, creativity, and community. Our software enables that through visual content creation and collaboration in millions of classrooms worldwide.
Exceptional products are exceptional in all dimensions that matter. Take the Dyson vacuum cleaner. Not only is it a good at vacuuming, it’s beautiful, feels good in the hand, is portable, and is easy to use. We are looking for Fullstack Engineers to build exceptional software products for a billion people.
Responsibilities
Owning and implementing new features that touch multiple layers of the tech stack. E.g. creating a beautiful search experience.
Creating delight. E.g. through animations and micro UI.
Making the web apps faster and more reliable. E.g. reducing javascript payload or making network requests more resilient.
Improving how we work. E.g. improving our component library or tools we use to translate the web app into 40+ languages.
Qualifications
At some point in your life, someone has told you: “you write good code.”
You know how to copy-paste code from Stack Overflow.
Bonus: you have a good sense of humor.
About Padlet
Vision
: Every child in the world will grow up with Mickey Mouse and Padlet.
Product
: We are making the default way of collecting and sharing thoughts on the Internet. People love the product.
Impact
: We have 40 million users, making Padlet one of the most used apps on the planet.
Money
: We are venture backed AND fiscally responsible. We are built to last one hundred years.
Badassery
: We are only 60 odd people. That's over half a million active users per person.
Tech stack
Mobile apps
: React Native (with Swift and Java where necessary.)
Backend
: Ruby (Rails), Typescript, Elixir (Phoenix), and Python.
Web
: VueJS, Tailwind.
Storage
: Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Firestore, and Snowflake.
Joys of programming at Padlet
We have very few meetings. We value keeping you in flow.
A lot of people use Padlet. We have to solve interesting concurrency problems.
Our users are in over 200 countries, using all kinds of devices and connections, and speaking over 40 languages. We have to solve interesting internationalization problems.
We process a lot of data real fast. We have to solve interesting scale problems.
We try to solve problems creatively instead of just throwing money at them. We are engineers! We thrive in constraints, not in the absence of them.
We ship often.
We value beautiful code.
Sorrows of programming at Padlet
We grew pretty fast last year and our processes are still catching up. E.g. we don't have 100% code coverage yet. Our deployment process isn't as painless as it could be. This sometimes leads to spending time on things that aren't the most fun. We’re working on it!
Our project management process could be better. This sometimes leads to re-speccing in the middle of development, getting in the way of programming flow. We’re working on it!
Some people you‘d be working with
Brian Koh
: Only human we know who has impulsive urges to exercise. When he does, he doesn't care about outfits. We've seen him running in boots, tight jeans, and leather jackets. Exceptional engineer and even better mentor.
Chee Kit Chong
: Chee Kit is responsible for at least 10% of Japan's GDP. He's there like every other week. Soon, they'd have to start reclaiming land so he has new things to see. Mobile engineer extraordinaire.
The office
We have a beautiful office in the historic Bukit Pasoh Neighbourhood.
1 minute walk from Outram Park MRT.
We have a lovely balcony. It's really, truly lovely.
Designed to be a space to inspire creativity and collaboration.
Benefits
Medical and dental insurance for you and your family.
Stock options.
Catered lunches and dinners. Military grade snacking.
20 vacation days. Plus sickness and bereavement days for when life happens.
Parental leave.
All the gadgetry you need, including a new phone every year.
Badassery budget to level up.
Special time to join
Because we're small, there's a lot of energy. And because we have tremendous traction, your first commit touches millions. This combination is rare and quite satisfying.

Experience: 4 - 5 years in Technical Product Management, IT Procurement, or a hybrid IT/business role within eCommerce, logistics, or retail. Minimum 2 years hands-on operational IT experience preferred.

This is an in-person role in...
description:
Padlet is building software for a good education. A good education is one that inspires curiosity, creativity, and community. Our software enables that through visual content creation and collaboration in millions of classrooms worldwide.
There are some products that are so good, you feel delight using them. You wish you had more problems just so you could use the products more. Think Dyson vacuum cleaner, a faucet with the perfect laminar flow, a sharp knife, WD40.
We aspire to build such products at Padlet, and are looking for a Product Manager to help us fulfill our aspirations.
This is an in-person role in Singapore.
Responsibilities
Work closely with our sales and support teams to understand the needs of school and district administrators.
Define and ship features that make it easier for schools to adopt and manage Padlet at scale.
Partner with engineering, design, and customer success to build intuitive administrative tools that drive adoption and retention.
Champion the voice of schools inside the company.
Build tools that help schools manage rosters, licenses, integrations, and compliance.
Enable school leaders to see the value Padlet is bringing to their teachers and students.
Help make Padlet the default classroom collaboration tool from kindergarten to college.
Qualifications
You like working hard.
You are honest.
You’ve worked with or for school systems and know how they buy and use software.
You’re comfortable juggling ambiguous requirements, shifting priorities, and strong opinions.
Former educator or teacher experience is good to have.
Bonus: You make a great demo and have a soft spot for teachers.
About Padlet
Vision
: Every child in the world will grow up with Mickey Mouse and Padlet.
Product
: We are making the default way of collecting and sharing thoughts on the Internet. People love the product.
Impact
: We have 40 million users, making Padlet one of the most used apps on the planet.
Money
: We are venture backed AND fiscally responsible. We are built to last one hundred years.
Badassery
: We are only 60 odd people. That's over half a million active users per person.
Joys of product at Padlet
You’ll help shape tools that support teachers and students around the world.
We ship fast. Your work won’t sit in backlog purgatory.
We value quality and craft over dashboards and drama.
We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we do take education seriously.
Sorrows of product at Padlet
You’ll have to listen to impassioned arguments about API naming conventions.
CEO has very strong opinions about product and can often be incorrigible.
Priorities change. Plans get scrapped. It’s not for the faint of heart.
You will get feature requests. Lots of them. From every corner of the Earth.
Some people you‘d be working with
Brian Koh
: Only human we know who has impulsive urges to exercise. When he does, he doesn't care about outfits. We've seen him running in boots, tight jeans, and leather jackets. Exceptional engineer and even better mentor.
Gerard Searchfield
: Insists that wallabies and kangaroos are different animals, artificially inflating the biodiversity of his homeland. Will notice a 1px misalignment from 18 feet away.
The office
We have a beautiful office in the historic Bukit Pasoh Neighbourhood.
1 minute walk from Outram Park MRT.
We have a lovely balcony. It's really, truly lovely.
Designed to be a space to inspire creativity and collaboration.
Benefits
Medical and dental insurance for you and your family.
Stock options.
Catered lunches and dinners. Military grade snacking.
20 vacation days. Plus sickness and bereavement days for when life happens.
Parental leave.
All the gadgetry you need, including a new phone every year.
Badassery budget to level up.
Special time to join
Because we're small, we move fast. And because we have tremendous traction, your designs will go in the hands of millions. This combination of speed and impact is rare and quite satisfying.

* OUR MISSION (THIS IS WHAT MATTERS)
We believe web security shouldn't require a PhD.
Right now, 30,000 websites get hacked daily. Why? Because traditional WAFs are complex, expensive, and require specialized security knowledge most developers don't have.
We're Kratos Lab—and we're on a mission to change that.
KratosWAF is the world's first AI-powered WAF middleware that:
Deploys in 5 minutes (not days of configuration hell)
Costs 40-60% less than enterprise solutions like Cloudflare

You're not here to just "do marketing."

Building apps without proper security because WAFs are too complex

Paying enterprise prices for features they'll never use
Spending hours configuring rules they don't understand

"You don't need to be a security expert to protect your app"

You don't actually care about web security or helping developers

AI-powered security exists and changes everything
KratosWAF lets them protect their apps in 5 minutes, even without security expertise

Speechify is a text-to-speech app that makes it easy for the world to access information. 20+ million people use our Google Chrome extension, web app, iOS app, and Android app. our mission is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Our amazing users are students, professionals, and productivity lovers. Many of them have learning differences like dyslexia and ADHD, while many just want to read faster and listen on the go. With Speechify you can turn any book, document, or website into audio, and listen while you’re in the car, doing laundry, walking your dog, making dinner, working out, skydiving—whatever your daily routine is! Speechify also powers Medium, the Star Tribune, The Direct, and more. Easily add text-to-speech to your website.
Cliff Weitzman, our fearless CEO, founded Speechify in 2017 in a dorm room at Brown University so he could share with others the incredible text-to-speech software he’d been working on. Cliff has dyslexia and he was frustrated with how much time and energy it took for him to read. Advanced TTS technology was a total gamechanger, it allowed him to finish his readings 3x faster than a normal reader and to better comprehend and retain information.
At Speechify our goal is for reading to never be a barrier to learning for anyone. Nothing should hold you back from learning information quickly and effectively.

snippet: Monetization Simulation: You will need to build complex spreadsheets or simulations to predict how changes in the game economy affect revenue. For...

Game Mathematician (Casual Games)
Full time/Permanent
Monday to Friday (1 day WFH)
Free office snacks & drinks
Company provides Group Health & Surgical/Outpatient Medical Benefits
Location: Labrador Park, mTower building
Job Description:
Handle the Game Balancing and Economy Design:
You define the numerical values for everything in the game, from how much XP a player earns per level to the drop rates of items. You ensure that the game isn't too easy (boring) or too hard (frustrating) by having a gradual progression curve that keep players engaged over time.
Probability and RNG Modeling:
Design the underlying probability engines and ensure the
Random Number Generation (RNG)
feels fair to the players.
Monetization Simulation:
You will need to build complex spreadsheets or simulations to predict how changes in the game economy affect revenue. For example, if you give players 100 free coins, you calculate how that impacts the long-term sink (spending) of the game’s virtual currency. You must be good with using spreadsheet.
Statistical Analysis & Monte Carlo Simulations:
Before a feature is even coded, you run millions of automated simulations (often using Python or Spreadsheet) to see how a game mechanic behaves over time. This helps catch game-breaking exploits where a player could theoretically get infinite resources.
Collaboration with other Game Designers:
You are the bridge between creative fun and hard logic. You translate a game designer's vision (e.g., "I want this boss fight to feel epic but winnable") into specific damage formulas, health pools, and critical hit chances.
Job Requirements:
Possess a good local Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computing, Computer Science, RTIS discipline etc
Strong Foundation in Maths - Good expertise in Probability Theory, Statistics, Combinatorics, and Linear Algebra
Good hands-on experience with Unity game engine, Google/Excel spreadsheet
Know Python (run large-scale simulations that Excel can't handle)
Plays a wide variety of light to midcore casual mobile games
Excellent communication – active listening skills, accessible verbal and written presentation
Work well in a lean team, team-player
Creative, innovative, positive problem-solving perspective

About us
Endowus is Asia’s leading fee-only digital wealth platform. Licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and Hong Kong Securities & Futures Commission (SFC), Endowus is the first digital advisor in the region to span both private wealth (Cash) and public pension savings (CPF & SRS in Singapore), helping all investors grow their money with expert advice, institutional access to financial solutions, low and fair fees, and a delightful personalised digital wealth experience.
 
 
 Our clients entrust us with a responsibility that goes far beyond technology or financial markets - they entrust us with their wealth - their livelihoods and ambitions of a better future for themselves and their loved ones. Our mission is clear: help people invest better so they can live easier today, and better tomorrow.
 
 
 ‍
The people you will work with
The team has deep domain knowledge in finance and technology, bringing together decades of experience at Morgan Stanley, Amazon, JPMorgan, UBS, Goldman Sachs, Blackstone, Vanguard, ANT, Fidelity, McKinsey, Grab, ByteDance, and many others. We practise inclusion and treasure our diversity in background and experience. A diverse team is our biggest asset and we look for people who share our belief in Endowus’ clear mission.‍
 
 
 ‍
Investors, recognition, licensing
Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised a total of US$95 million in funding from investors such as UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Z Venture Capital, Samsung Ventures, Singtel Innov8, and global leading venture capital firms Lightspeed Venture Partners and Softbank Ventures Asia.
 
 
 ‍
 
 
 Endowus’ leadership and growth have been recognised by the industry and it has attained numerous awards including Singapore’s Rising Star and Fintech Innovation in Asset Management, CEO of the Year, CIO of the Year (Asia Asset Management’s Best of the Best Awards 2022), Singapore’s Fintech Startup of the Year (The Asset Triple A Digital Awards 2022), LinkedIn Top Start-ups 2021, Forbes Asia 100 to Watch, WealthTech of the Year (Asia FinTech Awards 2022), Top 15 Singapore’s Best Workplaces Award and Top 100 Asia’s Best Workplaces Award 2022 (Great Place to Work).
 
 
 ‍
 
 
 The Endowus Group comprises Endowus' licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, as well as Hong Kong-based multi family office Carret Private. Endowus Group serves over a hundred thousand clients with content, advice and access. With group assets of over US$6 billion, it is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia. From a combination of 100% trailer fees rebates as direct cashback to clients, savings from the access to institutional share class and exclusive funds, Endowus has created more than US$40 million in savings per year for its clients.
 
 
 ‍
 
 
 Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS).
About this role; responsibilities & ownership:
We are looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join us at our office in Singapore. As an Engineering Intern at Endowus, you will:
Join one of our full stack teams that combine Product, Engineering, Design, and Data skills to create and deliver compelling end to end customer journeys in production.
Learn how to use agile practices to design, develop and deliver high quality product features, by participating in the team’s regular development activities.
Learn how a modern digital wealth management platform works.

https://tech.endowus.com/mobile-intern-experience/

Third year student working towards a Bachelors' or above in Computer Science, or a related field.

Strong familiarity with one or more programming languages; ideally one of the languages that we use: Scala, Typescript, Dart, Python, Kotlin, Java.
Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.

Eager and willing to learn new things. Staying up to date with the latest technologies.
Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership and & able to work independently.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
Our Technology & Culture:
Using our deep collective domain experience, we have built our digital wealth platform completely in-house.
 
 
 Our backend is a collection of 30+ microservices adhering to Domain Driven Design (DDD) and Event Sourcing principles that are written in Scala and are running in Kubernetes on AWS. On the frontend, to craft a superior customer experience, we use Flutter for our iOS/Android apps and React/TypeScript for our Web app. Our transactional data layer uses Cassandra and PostgreSQL while our data lake is built using Spark, Airflow, and Athena. We use Kafka for async communication between services. All of this is underpinned by a completely cloud native CI/CD platform that we have secured using industry leading zero-trust security practices.
We take pride in what we build and love shipping software every single day. Yes, every single day! In 2024, we averaged nearly a dozen production releases every working day!
If you love building high quality, client-centric software at a fast pace, you’ll love working with us. You can read more about our tech culture & development practices on our blog at

SGX Internship Program
We are Asia’s leading and trusted securities and derivatives market infrastructure, operating equity, fixed income, currency and commodity markets to the highest regulatory standards. We also operate a multi-asset sustainability platform, SGX FIRST or Future in Reshaping Sustainability Together (sgx.com/first).
We are committed to facilitating economic growth in a sustainable manner leveraging our roles as a key player in the ecosystem, a business, regulator and listed company. With climate action as a key priority, we aim to be a leading sustainable and transition financing and trading hub offering trusted, quality, end-to-end products and solutions.
As Asia’s most international, multi-asset exchange, we provide listing, trading, clearing, settlement, depository and data services, with about 40% of listed companies and over 80% of listed bonds originating outside of Singapore. We are the world's most liquid international market for the benchmark equity indices of China, India, Japan and ASEAN. In foreign exchange, we are Asia's leading marketplace and most comprehensive service provider for global FX over-the-counter and futures participants. Headquartered in AAA-rated Singapore, we are globally recognised for our risk management and clearing capabilities.
Be a part of this fast-paced world where your contributions count. SGX offers you the unique experience of gaining insights into the Exchange business and the finance value chain. You will be immersed in the respective specialist functions – at SGX, we believe that our interns are involved in real-time work from Day 1.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated intern to join our Product team within a Foreign Exchange (FX) electronic trading venue. This role sits directly under the Head of Product and oAers a unique opportunity to gain deep exposure to institutional FX markets, electronic trading platforms, and market microstructure. The intern will support strategic initiatives including business analysis, market research, competitive intelligence, and thought-leadership content development related to the design and evolution of a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) FX venue. This position is ideal for candidates interested in financial markets, fintech, trading technology, or product management careers.
Why Join Us?
Direct mentorship from senior product leadership.
Exposure to real-world institutional trading infrastructure.
Opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives and thought leadership.
Strong learning environment with potential future career opportunities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business & Product Analysis
Support product strategy initiatives through structured business analysis.
Gather and document product requirements, workflows, and functional specifications.
Analyze trading data, client behavior, and liquidity metrics to derive insights.
Assist in preparing internal presentations, strategy decks, and product documentation.
2. Market Research & Whitepapers
Conduct research on FX market structure, electronic trading models, and liquidity aggregation.
Contribute to writing whitepapers on topics such as:
Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) architecture in FX markets
Institutional trading workflows
Market fragmentation and liquidity dynamics
Emerging trends in FX electronic trading
Translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured content.
3. Competitive Landscape & Benchmarking
Perform competitive analysis comparing our venue against major FX venues globally.
Track features, pricing models, liquidity pools, participant types, and technology offerings.
Prepare comparative matrices and strategic insights to support product positioning.
Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, and market innovations.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work with Product, Technology, Sales, and Liquidity teams to gather inputs.
Participate in internal brainstorming sessions and product discussions.
Support ad-hoc strategic projects led by the Head of Product.
Learning Outcomes
By the end of the internship, you will gain:
Practical exposure to institutional FX markets and trading venue operations.
Understanding of market microstructure and electronic trading platforms.
Experience in fintech product strategy and research methodologies.
Professional experience in writing industry whitepapers and analytical reports.
Requirements
Education
- undergraduate or postgraduate student in: Finance, Economics, Engineering / Computer Science, Mathematics / Statistics, Business or related fields
Skills & Competencies:
Strong analytical and structured thinking ability.
Excellent research and writing skills.
Interest in financial markets, trading, or fintech.
Ability to simplify complex concepts into clear documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
Basic knowledge of financial markets or trading concepts is a plus.
Preferred (Nice to Have)
Exposure to capital markets, FX trading, or fintech platforms.
Understanding of market microstructure or order book dynamics.
Experience with data analysis tools (Python, PowerBI, or similar).
Prior internship in finance, consulting, or technology.
Personal Attributes
Curious and intellectually driven.
Self-starter with strong ownership mindset.
Detail-oriented with high quality standards.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication and presentation skills.

About Sembcorp
Sembcorp is a leading energy and urban solutions provider headquartered in Singapore. Led by its purpose to drive energy transition, Sembcorp delivers sustainable energy solutions and urban developments by leveraging its sector expertise and global track record.
Purpose & Scope
Reporting to the Department Head, Asset Performance – Solar & BESS, the Solar Asset Performance Manager is accountable for driving performance excellence across Sembcorp’s global Solar PV portfolio. This role plays a critical part in ensuring high‑performing, reliable, and optimized solar assets by leading asset monitoring, conducting in‑depth performance and reliability analysis, and championing the standardization and compliance of asset performance practices across Markets.
The role will also contribute to the evaluation and assessment of emerging New Energy technologies — including green hydrogen, green ammonia, methylcyclohexane (MCH), and other green molecules—to support Sembcorp’s long‑term decarbonization and innovation agenda.
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Capability Development
Mentor and support Solar Asset Performance Engineers across Markets, stronger technical capabilities.
Enhance team technical competency through structured guidance, knowledge sharing, and continuous competency development.
Support regional Markets in building robust solar performance engineering capabilities and technical maturity.
Collaborate with digital teams to enhance solar asset optimization models and automated diagnostics.
Governance & Standards
Oversee Solar PV asset performance across assigned Markets, ensuring robust monitoring and consistent stewardship of key performance indicators.
Lead the implementation of solar asset KPIs, performance tracking methodologies, and continuous improvement programs.
Develop and maintain technology-specific performance benchmarks for Solar PV assets to drive global alignment and best-in-class performance.
Support the standardization and adoption of advanced analytics and AI-enabled performance monitoring tools to improve accuracy and predictive insights.
Promote standardization of data models and AI-driven dashboards across Markets.
Guide Markets in the interpretation and adoption of corporate policies, technical standards, and operational governance frameworks.
Business Support
Identify performance gaps, production losses, and efficiency deviations across solar assets through predictive analytics and early-warning algorithms; conduct root cause analyses and propose targeted corrective actions.
Analyze data trends from SCADA, inverter systems, string-level monitoring, and site-level sensors to uncover issues and drive preventive interventions.
Lead solar asset performance optimization initiatives, leveraging global best practices and internal knowledge-sharing networks.
Collaborate with Markets and corporate teams on cross-functional performance enhancement and asset optimization programs.
Conduct Level 2 (L2) audits to ensure compliance with project delivery, operations, and maintenance processes.
Contribute to technology scanning, feasibility assessments, and early-stage evaluations of next-generation renewable and energy transition solutions.
Qualifications, Skills & Experience
At least 5 years of experience in Solar PV engineering, O&M, project execution, performance engineering, or related energy sectors.
Solid understanding of Solar PV technologies; experience in performance modelling, degradation analysis, or solar O&M practices is a strong advantage.
Prior exposure to corporate‑level asset performance functions and implementation of centralized digital or analytics platforms (e.g., SolarOS, Power BI, APM systems).
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related engineering discipline.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving ability, with a resourceful and proactive working style.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities effectively.
Willingness to travel occasionally for business needs.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Experience with PVsyst, Power BI, SCADA systems, or programming tools such as Python or MATLAB is an added advantage.
Our Culture at Sembcorp
At Sembcorp, our culture is shaped by a strong set of shared behaviours that guide the way we work and uphold our commitment to driving the energy transition.
We foster an institution-first mindset, where the success of Sembcorp takes precedence over individual interests. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, as we work seamlessly across markets, businesses, and functions to achieve our goals together. Accountability is a core principle, ensuring that we take ownership of our commitments and deliver on them with integrity and excellence. These values define who we are and create a workplace where our people can thrive while making a meaningful impact on driving energy transition.
Join us in making a real impact!

title: Video & Audio Lead, Content-as-a-Service (2-Year Contract)
snippet: We welcome talented individuals to join us and grow a career in a vibrant & collaborative environment built around a culture of respect & inclusivity.
description:
About Us
SPH Media’s mission is to be the trusted source of news and lifestyle content in Singapore and Asia. One of our core purposes is to produce credible, balanced, and objective news and analysis, always with a view to uphold the public good and fostering an informed, engaged citizenry.
We welcome talented individuals to join us and grow a career in a vibrant and collaborative environment built around a culture of respect and inclusivity.
As an employer, we are committed to rewarding our people fairly and developing them in their careers.
About the Role
The Video & Audio Lead is responsible for the strategy, direction and quality of all video and audio output produced by SPH Media’s new Content-as-a-Service (CaaS) capability, based within the international-award-winning Content & Solutioning Division.
SPH Media is Singapore’s trusted national media organisation, with a long-standing role in shaping public understanding through credible journalism and storytelling. CaaS builds on this trust by supporting public- and regulated-sector organisations with editorially rigorous, audience-focused content delivered across multiple formats.
You’ll collaborate closely with the Associate Director, Content-as-a-Service, the Senior Editor and the Art Director to shape how complex ideas are expressed through video and audio – from concept through to final delivery. The ability to translate institutional client briefs into compelling narratives that connect with real audiences is key.
While much of the production will be delivered through external partners, the role requires strong hands-on literacy across video and audio production. You should be comfortable stepping into post-production when needed – shaping an edit, refining sound, or stress-testing creative decisions – both to ensure quality and to collaborate effectively with production houses and freelancers.
This is a 2-year contract position, with renewal possibilities.
What you’ll do
Own video and audio strategy and standards:
Be accountable for the quality, consistency and effectiveness of all video and audio output under CaaS.
Define storytelling approaches, formats and production standards across video and audio.
Ensure outputs are editorially sound, audience-appropriate and aligned with CaaS objectives.
Ensure content is produced as pitched, on brief, on time, on budget, and to SPH Media editorial and creative standards.
Act as final creative sign-off on key video and audio projects.
Translate briefs into compelling screen and audio storytelling:
Work with the Senior Editor to shape narratives for video and audio formats.
Develop story approaches that make complex institutional material accessible and engaging.
Identify the most effective format for each story – long-form, short-form, episodic, documentary-style, explainer, animation, podcast or hybrid.
Ensure storytelling remains human, clear and purposeful across formats.
Lead commissioning and production direction:
Develop clear briefs, treatments and creative frameworks for production partners.
Commission and manage external production houses, videographers, editors, animators and audio producers.
Direct productions to ensure outputs meet editorial, creative and technical standards.
Review cuts, scripts and audio edits with a strong editorial eye.
Bring hands-on production judgement:
Apply post-production experience to review and refine edits where required.
Shape pacing, structure and storytelling at the edit stage.
Apply a strong understanding of sound design, music, animation and motion graphics.
Collaborate on integrated multi-format output:
Work closely with the Art Director to ensure visual coherence across still and moving formats.
Collaborate with the Senior Editor to maintain narrative consistency across text, video and audio.
Ensure video and audio outputs integrate seamlessly into broader content ecosystems.
Build video and audio capability:
Establish workflows, templates and best practices for video and audio production.
Build and maintain a trusted network of production partners and freelancers.
Stay informed on evolving formats, platforms and audience behaviours.
Who we’re looking for
You’re likely to have:
Senior experience in video or multimedia roles within media, production or content environments.
Strong storytelling instincts across screen, audio and social formats.
Experience commissioning and directing external production partners.
Comfort working on documentary, explainer, animation, branded or institutional content.
A solid understanding of sound design, animation, motion graphics and mixed-media storytelling.
Experience working with government, public-sector or regulated-industry stakeholders.
A solid understanding of production processes, budgets and timelines.
Comfort working inside an edit suite when needed, without needing to be the primary editor on every project.
The judgement to balance creative ambition with practical delivery.
You understand that great video and audio start with story, not equipment.
What this role is not
Not a purely technical or post-production role
Not a longform-video-only role
Not a one-person production team
Not a full-time post-producer role
This is a senior storytelling and production leadership role.
Why this role is interesting
You’ll shape how important stories are experienced through moving image and sound, backed by a trusted national media organisation and embedded within a high-performing, award-winning division. The role offers space to experiment with format and form – from long-form documentary to social hits to audio storytelling – while working alongside strong editorial and creative peers on content that matters.
About SPH Media’s Content & Solutioning Division
This is where editorial craft meets creative ambition. The division brings together Content Lab, Brand Newsroom and SPH Media’s advertising capabilities to produce commissioned work that spans branded storytelling, native content in news environments, video, and integrated campaigns across social, digital, print, audio and out-of-home. The team's work has been recognised internationally by organisations such as The Drum, the Content Marketing Association, the Content Marketing Institute, and WAN-IFRA – including multiple wins for public-sector, video and multiformat work. It’s a place for people who like ideas, enjoy solving complex briefs, and want to make work that is smart, credible, entertaining, and genuinely impactful.

About the job
Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.
As an Associate Product Marketing Manager (APMM), you will be part of the APMM Program, Google’s global program for early career Marketers. During your time in the program, you will work on priority marketing projects in your organization, develop a breadth of marketing skills, join a strong community of peers and alumni, and be supported by dedicated mentors and executive leaders. In addition to your core work, you are expected to complete learning and development milestones, attend APMM programming, and actively contribute to the APMM community.
You will be assigned projects within the marketing organization supporting their business goals and you will make direct contributions under the scope of a larger project, with general guidance. For example, you will help bring the user into the product development process or develop the go-to-market (GTM) plans for driving awareness and adoption for new products and features among goal segments. You will drive growth marketing and optimization, contribute to Google’s brand strategy, generate user insights, or manage campaigns and programming.
Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Renaissance Planners & Designers Pte Ltd is a multi - disciplinary design practice established in 1994.
The office currently employs a staff of 15. Creative and technical staff are grouped into teams that follow projects all the way through from concept to completion.
Philosophy
Renaissance's strategy is to study various requirements of the client. Through negotiating the conflicting requirements of site, climate, technologies and various consultants, a "concept" is produced that incorporates all these requirements.
These concepts are then used to develop the design at all levels and scales, creating a design language unique for the project.
We do not propose a particular style as they limit options available, and stifle exploration.
Renaissance believes good design is produced from careful study and research, combined with technical knowledge and artistic judgement.
Attention to detail, proportions and scale, together with common sense ensures the finished project fully develops within the concept.
Today, modern Asian houses have evolved as a response to the increasingly tight suburban lots and the need to use the fronts, rear and side setback as "viewing courts". The courts allow a dialogue between the interior & the exterior spaces.

title: Junior Product Designer - Jewellery

description:
As a Junior Product Designer at Ask & Embla, you will support the design and development of innovative, trend-relevant jewelry that aligns with the brand’s vision and customer identity. You will assist in research, conceptualization, and technical design work while learning to translate creative direction into production-ready deliverables. This role is ideal for someone with foundational jewelry design skills who is eager to grow into a full-fledged designer role.
What You'll Do
Design Research & Concept Development

Contribute to the development of mood boards, design decks, and seasonal concept presentations.
Support the Creative Director and Product Design team by sketching and proposing jewelry concepts aligned with the brand’s vision and assortment plan.
Technical Design & CAD Support
Learn and apply CAD tools (e.g. Rhino, ZBrush) to translate sketches into 3D models and technical drawings.
Assist in preparing tech packs and design specifications for sampling and production.
Provide support in the creation of prototypes, including working with 3D printing processes.
Collaboration & Iteration
Work closely with the Product Design and Product Development team to refine designs during sampling stages.
Incorporate feedback into revisions of sketches, 3D models, and technical documentation.
Participate in cross-functional meetings, offering input from a design perspective.
Project Support & Administration
Help maintain organized design records, references, and material libraries.
Assist in compiling decks, reports, and design documentation for internal use.
Support the design team in day-to-day tasks to ensure smooth workflow and timely delivery.
Who You Are
A graduate of a product design or industrial design course, and experience in a product design or jewelry design role, is preferred.
Foundational knowledge of jewelry design principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
Familiarity with jewelry CAD software and 3D prototyping - Rhino and ZBrush preferred.
Strong sketching and visualization skills, with attention to detail and creativity.
Ability to manage multiple tasks under deadlines while maintaining design quality.
A collaborative mindset with a passion for learning and growing in jewelry design.
About Ask & Embla

Ask & Embla is a rapidly growing Alternative Body Jewelry brand based in Singapore with a collective following of more than 500,000 across our social media channels. As an E-commerce brand, we ship internationally to a diverse range of customers and we are proud to be one of the leading brands worldwide in the alternative jewelry space.
At Ask & Embla, we’re passionate about creating a company that brings out the best in everyone and where individuals love to work and grow as a team. That means constantly learning and building new things, being flexible about how and where we work, and empowering each other to do the proudest work of our lives.
Ask & Embla, led by an ex-Googler and ex-Amazonian, has dozens of employees across multiple countries. We are building the foundation to expand several business verticals beyond e-commerce, while supporting existing business functions for fulfilling thousands of orders each month.
Ready to Join Us?

title: Soft Goods Product Designer (Plush Toys)
snippet: Design plush toys from concept to production, working with factories to ensure quality, safety, and brand alignment.
description:
Company Description
Founded in 2010, Viahart® is a global consumer products company creating educational toys enjoyed by children around the world. Our products are sold internationally through retail and e-commerce. Our plush toy brand, TigerHart® Toys, creates realistic stuffed animals designed to be comforting companions while inspiring curiosity and learning. We are expanding our Singapore team to support TigerHart’s continued global growth.
Role Overview
Our designer will create original plush toy designs for TigerHart® Toys from concept to production. This role works closely with our Singapore team and overseas factories to ensure designs meet safety, cost, and quality standards.
Job Responsibilities
•
Concept Development:
Design new plush animals for TigerHart Toys in collaboration with the Design Director. Conduct real animal reference studies and plush toy market research to ensure designs are accurate, appealing, and aligned with our brand.
•
Design Execution:
Create clear sketches and design documents for factory pattern makers. Review and refine development samples to ensure accuracy, correct material use, and proper detailing.
•
Collaboration & Communication:
Work closely with internal teams and overseas manufacturing partners to ensure smooth development from concept to production.
•
Product Development & Quality Control:
Oversee prototype development and production samples, and resolve issues related to sewing, pattern making, materials, and overall product quality.
•
Safety & Compliance:
Ensure all plush designs meet international toy safety standards and Viahart’s quality requirements.
•
Supplier Visits:
Travel occasionally to our manufacturers in Indonesia, Vietnam, and China to review development samples, improve quality, and oversee production.
Skills and traits required
Proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, with the ability to create sketches and technical design documents.
Experience in plush toy design or related fields such as fashion, soft goods, or toy design is preferred.
Basic understanding of sewing, pattern making, plush construction, fabrics, and materials.
Strong attention to detail, especially in proportions, colors, and product quality.
Good sense of color, materials, and overall design aesthetics.
Able to communicate clearly and work well with the team and overseas factories.
Comfortable using Google Drive and general computer tools.
Creative, responsible, and willing to learn and improve.
Familiarity with AI tools for design is a plus.
Work Eligibility
This role is open to Singapore Citizens only.
Work Commitment & Availability
This is a full-time, onsite role requiring approximately 40 hours per week
Candidates must be able to work consistently during agreed working hours and be available throughout the workday
This role is best suited for someone who can commit fully to a standard full-time schedule
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly salary: SGD 4,200 to 6,300, commensurate with experience
7 business days of paid time off are granted in addition to the 11 public holidays of Singapore. The 7 business days are granted after 3 months probation.
Performance bonus: Annual merit-based bonus paid in February (up to 15% of annual salary)
Salary and benefits are negotiable for the right candidate
Location
109 North Bridge Road, #07-21 (Located inside Funan Mall)
7 minute walk from City Hall MRT

includes reference checks with previous supervisors or managers, as well as standard background checks. This helps us build a team of trustworthy, capable, and dedicated people.

snippet: Cutting-edge game art program at NTU Singapore seeks passionate Part-Time Lecturer. Join dynamic team, guide students' technical & creative skills.
description:
School of Art, Design and Media
Nanyang Technological University, Singapore
Part-Time Lecturer for AP6413 Modelling and Animation for Games
AP6413 Modelling and Animation for Games is a 13-week course covering the design, modelling, and preparation of original visual assets for game engines. Students explore essential techniques for creating 2D sprites, 3D models, textures, and basic animation, including the use of motion capture and fundamentals of environment design. The course emphasizes principles of efficiency and basic assembly inside a game engine, culminating in a portfolio of modular art assets for a game proposal. This learning enables students to build capable, engine-ready assets for any game project.
Applicants to this position will be able to demonstrate expertise in the complete game art pipeline, from initial asset design and 3D modelling to texturing, rigging, and animation. Applicants will be able to demonstrate passion in guiding students through the technical nuances of motion capture integration, environment design, and modular asset creation. You will support students in mastering the principles of technical efficiency and the practicalities of assembling and optimizing visual assets within a modern game engine.
Candidates should have a relevant Master’s and/or PhD in Animation, Game Art, Digital Media, or a related field with a track record of creative practice in professional game asset production. Past teaching experience at the Undergraduate Level is preferred.
