Syfe is APAC's largest and fastest-growing digital wealth platform, trusted with over US$10 billion in assets. We are fundamentally changing how hundreds of thousands of people across Asia-Pacific build wealth through a holistic approach to managing money rather than just pushing investment products. Backed by world-class investors and recognised as a leader in WealthTech, we are a team of passionate builders creating the future of wealth management.
The Right Profile
Product is a key growth and retention driver for our Brokerage business. As a Product Management Intern, you will work closely with the Brokerage Product team to support the development and optimization of trading features across equities, ETFs, and options. This role is highly analytical and execution-focused. You won’t just sit in meetings, you’ll work with real trading data, write SQL queries, contribute to PRDs, and help measure feature performance. You will gain hands-on exposure to how a modern fintech brokerage builds discovery tools, pricing models, trading workflows, and analytics dashboards. You’ll learn how product decisions are driven by user behavior, market trends, and business impact while developing practical skills in structured thinking, data analysis, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is ideal for someone who is curious about financial markets, enjoys solving problems with data, and wants to experience what it takes to ship real trading products in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer needs and industry trends (equities, ETFs, options, brokerage features).
Assist in drafting Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and functional specifications.
Support product analytics by:
Writing basic SQL queries to extract and analyze trading/user data.
Using tools like Pendo to track feature adoption, user engagement, and funnel performance.
Assist in building dashboards and performance reports to evaluate feature impact.
Collaborate with design and engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
Participate in product reviews, UAT testing, and feedback sessions.
Prepare presentations and documentation for stakeholders.
Support ad-hoc product, analytics, and operational tasks as needed.
Minimum Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Basic SQL knowledge (SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, aggregations).
Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Pendo (or similar tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA).
Basic understanding of brokerage, stock markets, ETFs, or trading products (personal investing/trading experience is a plus).
Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Google Suite.
Basic understanding of UX/UI principles.
Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

description:
About WPP Production
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
Fancy becoming a content creator and getting paid to make content for major brands? We’re looking for innovative, passionate individuals to join our WPP Production Creator Network. This will be our inaugural batch of content creators in Singapore.
THE BASICS
WHO?
This is open to anyone and everyone. No CVs or experience required, we’re just interested in your creative and social talent. Crucially, we're seeking TikTok natives. Individuals who instinctively understand the platform's rhythm, latest trends ('skibidi' and
‘
6-7’ are dead by now), 'brainrot' humour, and how to authentically connect with its communities.
WHAT?
6 months paid internship in Content Creation.
WHERE?
You’ll be based at our video and photography studios in One George Street, Singapore (5 days a week)
WHEN?
1st April 2026 to 1st October 2026
HOW?
To apply, simply fill out the form below, send a link to your video introduction showcasing your personality, and include any social media links to your portfolio of work as a content creator.
WHAT DOES THE INTERNSHIP INVOLVE?
As part of the Creator Network, you will be based at our Studios at the WPP Campus on One George Street. You will be given an intensive orientation period where different teams will provide you with a thorough understanding of what goes on in the world's largest production agency creating content for the world's biggest brands. This will equip you with foundational knowledge and contacts.
Once orientation is complete, the team will get creating! You’ll get the opportunity to share your ideas and make content for brands – for real. A key part of your role will involve creating engaging content for WPP Production's social platforms (Instagram, TikTok) and contributing to our employer branding efforts. You may also be asked to support on live client social content shoots where needed.
This is a unique opportunity for hands-on, end-to-end creative development. Beyond contributing to existing briefs, you'll have the exciting chance to conceptualize and front your own content series ideas, taking on diverse roles such as producer, scriptwriter, videographer, editor, and even on-screen talent. This immersive experience will allow you to develop a comprehensive skillset and truly own your creative vision from start to finish.
Week 1: Welcome week & initial orientation - get to understand WPP Production, the offering and our network.
Weeks 2-8: Comprehensive orientation sessions with various teams (e.g., Video production, Photography, Creative, Strategy, Post-Production, Metaverse) to provide a deep dive into our capabilities and processes. You will begin your content creation journey here.
Week 8 onwards: Deployed on real briefs, pitches, research, innovation and further development, including creating content for WPP Production's social channels, supporting client shoots, and leading the production of your own content series.
WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR IN YOUR SUBMISSION?
We want to know what makes you, you. Show us what you got by submitting a video introduction showcasing your personality, and links to your social media platforms that highlight your content creation portfolio.
It could also include anything else (quite literally anything) so long as you can attach the link to your file in the form below. Have you created a Graphic novel, Music track, Pottery, Recipe, Comedy sketch, Dance routine, Make-Up look, Sculpture, Poetry, Illustration, Short Story? If it isn’t digital sending pictures of your work is all good – please don’t try to send us a life-sized sculpture. Go on, show us what you got!
WHAT HAPPENS AFTER I SUBMIT MY APPLICATION?
Once you’ve filled out the form and submitted your video introduction, social media links, and any other creative work, our team will review all applications and shortlist people to move onto the next phase. Phase 2 will involve us sending you an email to invite you for a chat to understand your creative 'vibes' and passion for content creation. This will likely involve a casual discussion and a review of your work with some of our team members at our Singapore office. Phase 3, you will be given a test brief for us to review your creative capabilities!
#LI-CT1
Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy  This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

snippet: We are looking for a highly motivated intern to join our Service Delivery team within a Foreign Exchange (FX) electronic trading venue. This role...
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated intern to join our Service Delivery team within a Foreign Exchange (FX) electronic trading venue. This role sits directly under the Head of Sellside Service Delivery and offers a unique opportunity to gain deep exposure to institutional FX markets and electronic trading platforms. As a part of Service Delivery Team, we are responsible for providing seamless services to all our clients that include Banks, Asset Managers, Hedge Funds etc. The team is responsible for serving our clients technically by implementing, designing, and supporting our products. We also work closely with the Development, QA, IT and Sales team to provide input from the technical point of view. The team members can build in-depth understanding of the FX market and develop skills around different technical aspects of Front, Middle and Back-office systems used across the financial domain globally.
Why Join Us?
Direct mentorship from senior leadership.
Exposure to real-world institutional trading infrastructure.
Opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives and thought leadership.
Strong learning environment with potential future career opportunities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Client Management
Understand client requirements. Break into the technical tasks and implement solutions for clients based on the product offering.
Engage with clients on the weekly/biweekly meetings and update on the projects and feature releases along with business team.
Support the MaxxTrader products at the client sites on an ongoing basis. This requires the candidate to learn the business requirement and implement them for both backend and frontend of the system.
2. Technical
Constantly build tools and scripts to automate the installation and troubleshooting of the system.
Manage the overall client setup and work as technical managers for the accounts allocated.
Update/enhance/write new scripts and small code changes to cater to client’s requirements.
3. Functional
Understand the functional aspect of the product to map it to correct technical requirements, this needs understanding of the FX-OTC business which will be acquired the as you work in the team.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work with Product, Technology, Sales, and Liquidity teams to gather input.
Participate in internal brainstorming sessions and product discussions.
Support ad-hoc strategic projects led by the Head of Sellside Service Delivery.
Learning Outcomes
By the end of the internship, you will gain:
Exposure of the technical architecture of the FX world and knowledge of the tools and software used in the fintech domain.
Practical exposure to institutional FX markets and systems.
Experience in fintech product strategy and research methodologies.

title: Management Trainee
snippet: A Management Trainee will undergo exposure to all aspects of the business, to build a robust understanding of processes and implement change.
description:
About Us:
Nova Furnishing is a premier furniture retail powerhouse in Singapore, dedicated to transforming houses into homes. With an extensive network of outlets islandwide, we pride ourselves on providing stylish, high-quality, and affordable home solutions to our diverse clientele.
As a publicly listed company on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, Nova Furnishing combines the stability and prestige of a regional leader with the agility of a growth-oriented enterprise. We are currently at a pivotal junction of our journey, aggressively pursuing digital transformation. We invite bold, innovative, and tech-forward individuals to join us in redefining the future of retail through AI, automation, and operational excellence.
The Opportunity
Reporting directly to the CEO, you will be the catalyst for change within Nova Furnishing. This isn't a typical "shadowing" role; it is a high-visibility, high-impact position designed for a future leader who isn't afraid to get their hands dirty. You will rotate through every core pillar of our business. Sales, Logistics, Purchasing, Marketing, and HR, to master the full business cycle and implement the next generation of retail workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Rotations: Undergo a structured rotational programme (up to 6 months per department) to master the end-to-end furniture retail ecosystem.
AI & Automation Implementation: Identify manual, paper-based bottlenecks and lead the implementation of AI-driven tools and automated workflows to streamline operations.
Process Engineering: Conduct "as-is" analysis of current business processes and design "to-be" models that improve efficiency and reduce human error.
Direct CEO Support: Act as a right-hand to the CEO on high-priority strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives.
Change Management: Act as the bridge between senior leadership and ground-level staff, ensuring the smooth adoption of new digital tools across all outlets and warehouses.
Data-Driven Insights: Use departmental data to create performance dashboards that help the leadership team make informed decisions.
What We Are Looking For
Educational Background: A degree in any disciple.
The "Builder" Mindset: You don't just find problems; you build solutions. You should be comfortable with low-code/no-code automation tools or have a high degree of "AI fluency."
Resilience & Agility: Retail is fast-paced. You must be comfortable with varying working hours and moving between a corporate office, retail floors, and logistics hubs.
Communication Skills: The ability to explain complex technical improvements to non-technical staff in a way that gains their "buy-in."
Strong Ownership: You treat the business like it's your own.

Minimum 5 to 7 years’ experience in UX, Product Design, or UX Strategy, with a strong track record leading end-to-end UX for e-commerce or transactional digital products.
Demonstrated ability to drive large-scale redesigns, from strategic vision to hands-on execution (journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes).
Expertise in information architecture, journey mapping, user research, navigation design and understands how UX impacts business metrics like conversion, revenue, and loyalty.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to present to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

description:
Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore, with a net portfolio value of S$434 billion (US$324 billion, €299 billion, £250 billion, and RMB2.35 trillion) as at 31 March 2025. Marking our unlisted assets to market would provide S$35 billion of value uplift and bring our mark to market net portfolio value to S$469 billion.
Our Purpose “So Every Generation Prospers” guides us to make a difference for today’s and future generations.
Operating on commercial principles, we seek to deliver sustainable returns over the long term.
We have 13 offices in 9 countries around the world: Beijing, Hanoi, Mumbai, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore in Asia; and Brussels, London, Mexico City, New York, Paris, San Francisco, and Washington, DC outside Asia.
Introduction
Temasek's Cybersecurity department is looking to hire full-time interns to support various cybersecurity initiatives across different teams. This internship will give you an opportunity to gain first-hand experience in planning and executing cybersecurity projects while developing valuable technical and business skills in a global investment company.
The department comprises of 4 key technical pillars: (1) Defence and Resilience, (2) Governance and Oversight, (3) Architecture and Engineering Operations, and (4) Innovation, Incubation & Initiatives. Specific domain requirements are listed below, but interns would have the opportunity for cross-functional learning and experience.
1.Defence and Resilience Intern
This role will assist in supporting the uplift of Temasek’s cybersecurity resilience through development and execution of an effective cyber resilience programme and establishment of new/advanced cyber capabilities to strengthen cyber awareness, enhance cyber readiness and monitoring capabilities. This enables us to driving a culture of cyber resilience across Temasek and its ecosystem.
Drive security awareness through innovative and engaging methods, creating a culture where cybersecurity becomes second nature
Develop compelling technical content for both technical and non-technical audiences
Design interactive training programs that transform complex security concepts into actionable behaviours
Plan and facilitate realistic tabletop exercises that prepare operational and management teams for real-world cyber threats
Monitor effectiveness of existing awareness programmes gather feedback, and recommend enhancements for continuous improvement
2. Governance and Oversight Intern
This role will assist in supporting continuous enhancement and implementation of an effective governance and risk management framework to manage technology, data security, and cyber risks across the enterprise. This will enable Temasek to be better prepared to mitigate and manage these risks in the face of evolving cybersecurity threats.
Perform Governance, Risk and Compliance related duties including policy reviews, risk assessments, and control testing
Identify gaps in governance frameworks and propose enhancements to strengthen oversight
Provide support to GRC related reviews and processes
Track audit findings and follow up with IT partners/vendors on audit/assurance findings
Maintain accurate records of compliance processes risk registers, and assurance reports
3. Architecture and Engineering Operations Intern (Security Operations)
This role will assist in supporting Temasek’s security operations through monitoring and compliance checks, streamlining documentation, coordinating incident response, enhancing governance to address operational risks, and providing project management support for ongoing initiatives.
Perform ongoing monitoring on security operations hygiene, controls compliance by leveraging variety of management tools and techniques to detect operational irregularities and lapses.
Support development, maintenance and streamline documentation of operational SOPs, playbooks, configuration baselines, operational reports to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure prompt and efficient incident response and support containment activities.
Drive and improve security governance to identify operational gaps and risk across the security solution stack.
Provide project management support in ongoing initiatives
4. Architecture and Engineering Operations Intern (Architecture)
This role will assist in supporting in the development and execution of Temasek’s cybersecurity defense strategy and planning for future cybersecurity needs.
Support security technology evaluations and proof-of-concept for security solutions, documenting findings and recommendations
Research emerging security threats, technologies, vulnerabilities, and industry trends
Assist in creating technical security documentation, diagrams and presentations to support solution design and stakeholder communication
5. Innovation, Incubation & Initiatives Intern
Assist the team by researching and evaluating emerging technology risks (e.g., quantum computing, agentic AI) and identifying potential security use-cases and mitigations.
Support initiatives to enhance detection of hard-to-detect threats by exploring advanced solutions (e.g., automation, advanced analytics) to improve alert quality, triage speed, and mitigation workflows.
Additional scope may include supporting the establishment of an Insider Risk & Security (IRS) capability to improve visibility of insider threats and enable timely response actions.
Requirements
Able to commit full-time for a minimum of 20 weeks, preferably from July 2026 onwards, and will still be enrolled with a recognised university by the end of the internship.
Please indicate your availability (start and end date) and expected graduation date.
University undergraduates pursuing any of these majors/degrees: Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, IT Management.

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Visual Designers weave space, typography, color, and iconography to help people successfully navigate our products, ensuring they are beautiful and accessible. description:
Get to Know the Team
The Regional Product Marketing team develops user insights and marketing strategies for Grab's Mobility, Deliveries, E-commerce, and Financial Services businesses. We work with regional product managers and country operations teams to increase adoption across consumer, merchant, driver, and enterprise segments in Southeast Asian markets. Our focus is translating user data into strategies that improve product adoption and revenue performance.
Get to Know the Role
You will lead product marketing strategy for Grab's service portfolio, developing positioning and launch plans for new products and features across multiple countries. You will analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities and collaborate with product teams to incorporate insights into development roadmaps. You will also implement automation tools to streamline marketing research and reporting processes, while managing revenue targets tied to product adoption and user retention metrics.
You will report directly to the Regional Head of Marketing, Brand and Creative and this is a fully onsite role.
The Critical Tasks You will Perform
You will develop customer value propositions for new product launches across Mobility, Deliveries, E-commerce, and Financial Services. You will also develop go-to-market strategies, adapting messaging for consumers, merchants, drivers, and enterprise clients in different Southeast Asian markets.
You will analyze user adoption, retention, and revenue data to identify growth opportunities, presenting findings to product teams and senior leadership to inform roadmap priorities and marketing investments.
You will coordinate launch timelines and marketing programs across regional product teams and country operations, aligning stakeholders on priorities and ensuring consistent execution across multiple markets.
You will implement AI tools and automation workflows for market research, user insights, and marketing execution, reducing manual processes and improving data accuracy for decision-making.
You will manage revenue accountability for product adoption metrics, tracking performance against quarterly growth targets and adjusting marketing strategies based on performance data.
You will present market insights, competitive analysis, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and board members, informing company-wide investment decisions.

Company Profile
SKIA is building a whole-food, fibre-led functional beverage brand focused on everyday metabolic health. Fibre is the most under-consumed nutrient in modern diets. Most people struggle to get enough because it is inconvenient, unappealing, or uncool. SKIA exists to change that.
SKIA’s launch product is a clean, refreshing sparkling chia seed drink. It is a real-food, high-fibre beverage designed to be paired with meals. SKIA supports steadier energy after meals and helps reduce the familiar “food coma.” By making fibre tasty, convenient, and desirable, SKIA aims to narrow the daily fibre gap through a new, occasion-based approach to functional beverages.
We are in the product R&D phase and will launch in SG in Q2 of 2026.
Job Description
WHO WE ARE
SKIA is a fiber-forward sparkling chia drink launching in Singapore mid-2026 — built to close the daily fiber gap in a way that’s actually convenient and enjoyable.
We’re operator-founders who’ve scaled 0→$100M businesses, grown platforms from 2M→20M users, and built inside Google, P&G, Amazon and hyper-growth startups.
Now we’re building again — from zero.
WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO
This is not desk research.
You will:
Run real-world observation studies on consumption behaviour
Speak with clinicians — dietitian, gut health specialists — to understand how fibre is prescribed
Conduct retail field audits — mapping shelf placement, pricing, and positioning across Singapore
Analyse online communities and marketplaces to extract demand signals
You won’t just collect data. You’ll synthesise it into strategic recommendations that shape go-to-market.
You’ll also have the opportunity to sit in on a brand identity workshop — seeing how raw consumer insight becomes brand, packaging, and positioning. Very few get the opportunity to do this outside of marketing books.

Direct founder mentorship
Exposure to early-stage brand building
A tangible project you can showcase

Drawn to health, longevity, F&B, or consumer brands
Comfortable talking to strangers in a food court!

description:
ABOUT GAIN CITY
At Gain City, we’ve been delivering trusted expertise and quality solutions in consumer electronics, air-conditioning, and home appliances since 1981. As a household name in Singapore, we take pride in our strong customer focus, innovative spirit, and commitment to service excellence. With a dynamic workforce and a network of stores and service centres island wide, we offer a vibrant and growth-oriented environment where employees are empowered to thrive, take ownership, and make a real impact.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end development and performance of our household and lifestyle product lines. This includes identifying market opportunities through in-depth research, sourcing and validating new products, and managing profitability through careful P&L oversight. You will work cross-functionally to execute the product roadmap, support marketing initiatives, and ensure successful product launches. The ideal candidate is strategic, analytical, and entrepreneurial, with strong communication skills and the ability to navigate fast-paced, high-growth environments.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
·
Product Strategy & Research
Conduct deep market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and gaps in the market. Translate findings into actionable product ideas and insights.
·
Sourcing & Product Validation
Source and evaluate new products, test market fit, and gather feedback to improve or pivot product offerings.
·
Profit & Loss Management
Monitor and manage the P&L for each product line, with a focus on increasing revenue and managing costs to maximize profitability.
·
Cross-functional Collaboration
Drive the product roadmap by working closely with marketing, distribution, operations, and sales teams to ensure alignment and smooth implementation.
·
Product Forecasting & Performance Tracking
Lead product forecasting, conduct regular reviews, and work with teams to optimize product lifecycles and inventory planning.
·
Marketing & Launch Support
Provide input for marketing campaigns and ensure product positioning, communication, and materials are in line with brand and strategic goals.
·
KPI Ownership
Define and track KPIs to ensure product success metrics are met across sales, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
·       Bachelor’s degree
·       Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in product development or product management
·       Experience in household/lifestyle products is a strong advantage
·       Strategic thinker with the ability to drive projects across departments
·       Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills
·       Entrepreneurial, driven, and solutions-oriented
·
Good Chinese Skills (spoken and written)

snippet: In this role, you will join our Payments Network SRE team, where you’ll be responsible for continuously assessing and improving the service quality...
description:
Our Purpose

Title and Summary
Senior F5 & Network Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
Lead F5 and Network Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
Our Purpose:
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people across more than 200 countries and territories worldwide.
We are committed to building an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere—by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Through secure data, trusted networks, strong partnerships, and relentless innovation, we help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses unlock their greatest potential.
About the Role:
Mastercard’s Program aligned Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams are dedicated to delivering a seamless experience for our customers. We achieve this by maintaining every aspect of our Programs infrastructure and technology ecosystem to the highest standards, ensuring compliance with rigorous security requirements.
Within Mastercard, SRE focuses on the reliability and performance of core infrastructure, networks, and foundational services that power our applications. Our mission is to ensure these components operate with excellence, enabling applications to deliver an outstanding customer experience.
In this role, you will join our Payments Network SRE team, where you’ll be responsible for continuously assessing and improving the service quality of our F5 load balancer operations and a diverse range of networking technologies. You will provide strategic insights to key stakeholders on optimal resource utilization, capacity forecasting, and performance trends—helping to ensure availability, scalability, and resilience across our network.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead continuous assessments of our F5 and network infrastructure supporting critical Mastercard applications, focusing on health, performance, and capacity analysis. Collaborate with Product and Development teams to forecast growth requirements and ensure scalability.
Lead regular incident reviews with internal support teams to ensure root causes are identified. When patterns of failure or compatibility issues between software and infrastructure emerge, develop and implement strategies to remediate or mitigate risks.
Champion observability as a core principle for infrastructure services by assessing environments and technologies to uncover gaps in monitoring and alerting. Design and implement strategies to close these gaps, ensuring all infrastructure telemetry is integrated into a unified, single-pane-of-glass view.
Leverage automation and AI technologies to enhance proactive issue detection, enable self-healing capabilities, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM).
Develop testing and validation plans for new environment builds, disaster recovery exercises and post-maintenance activities to certify environment readiness before customer traffic is routed to it.
Champion continuous learning, development, and knowledge sharing across F5 and networking and other infrastructure disciplines to strengthen multi-disciplinary SRE team capabilities. Lead training initiatives for team members and Product and Development on networking aspects of the platforms.
Evaluate vendor hardware, firmware, and software upgrade roadmaps, and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) testing to identify potential risks and opportunities for improvement in upcoming releases.
All about you:
• 4–8 years of experience working with F5 load balancers and related network technologies in operational or design roles, including a minimum of 3 years supporting e commerce, financial services, or large scale SaaS platforms
• Strong understanding in F5 technologies, including core network and TMOS configuration, Web Application Firewall (WAF) management, data group creation and maintenance, iRule development, BGP routing, TMSH operation, load balancing algorithms and traffic management stratagies, OneConnect profiles, and AS3/automation tooling, with the ability to design, operate, and troubleshoot complex application delivery and security environments.
• Expert-level understanding of TCP/IP networking, including LAN and WAN architectures. Experience with private MPLS networks and SD WAN technologies is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency or formal certifications in F5 Cisco, Arista, and/or Check Point network platforms.
• Strong knowledge of HTTP, DNS, and TLS protocols, with the ability to troubleshoot at the application and transport layers.
• Familiarity with Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and DDoS protection services.
• Solid Linux fundamentals, including networking, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
• Hands on experience with automation and IaC tools such as Ansible and Terraform, as well as structured data formats (JSON/YAML).
• Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Dynatrace or Datadog, and familiarity with the OpenTelemetry observability framework.
• Proficient in packet level debugging, including capturing traffic with tools like tcpdump and analyzing packets using tools such as Wireshark
• Familiarity with Network telemetry tools such as Solarwinds & Netscout
• Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to coordinate complex troubleshooting efforts and lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities.
The Payments Network SRE team is responsible for the runtime availability of some of Mastercard’s most critical core payment systems, which support national infrastructure and operate 24/7 year‑round. As a result, this role will include periodic on‑call responsibilities when required.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The role focuses primarily on real-time video intelligence, model optimisation, and scalable system architecture, with secondary exposure to LLM integration for workflow automation and intelligent analytics.
Key Responsibilities
🔹 Requirements & Technical Design
Translate operational requirements into technical system specifications for CCTV and facial recognition systems.
Define performance benchmarks (latency, accuracy, throughput) for real-time inference systems.
Design system architecture ensuring reliability, scalability, and security.
🔹 Computer Vision & YOLO Pipeline
Design and implement real-time object detection and facial recognition pipelines using YOLO and related deep learning models.
Optimise inference speed, model loading time, and GPU utilisation.
Improve detection accuracy while reducing false positives and false rejects.
Apply model optimisation techniques such as quantisation, ONNX conversion, and TensorRT acceleration.
Integrate CV systems with CCTV camera streams and backend services.
🔹 System Architecture & Deployment
Architect scalable systems capable of handling multiple concurrent video streams.
Design GPU-based inference infrastructure (on-prem or cloud).
Develop backend inference APIs (FastAPI/Flask) to serve model outputs.
Implement containerised deployment using Docker and configure load balancing where required.
Monitor latency (P95 targets), system uptime, and performance metrics.
🔹 LLM & Intelligent Analytics (Secondary Focus)
Integrate LLM-based components for alert summarisation, incident reporting, and intelligent search across CCTV metadata.
Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows where required.
Ensure secure and compliant handling of sensitive data in AI-driven workflows.
🔹 Testing & Compliance
Validate model performance using metrics such as mAP, precision, recall, and F1-score.
Conduct load testing for high-volume camera environments.
Ensure systems comply with government security and operational standards.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience with YOLO (v5/v7/v8 or equivalent).
Experience building real-time video analytics systems.
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Experience with OpenCV and video stream processing.
Familiarity with GPU optimisation (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime).
Experience designing scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs.
Experience with Docker and Linux environments.
Understanding of system performance tuning and high-availability design.
Preferred
Experience with facial recognition systems.
Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, RAG, GPT-based APIs).
Experience in government or security-related projects.
Experience deploying AI systems in on-prem or edge environments.

description:
The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud.
About the Team:
E-commerce supply chains are among the most dynamic and complex systems in the world. Every click, every order, and every delivery triggers thousands of operational decisions across warehouses, transportation networks, routing systems, and last-mile operations.
Job Description:
As an Operations & Data Analytics Intern, you will work at the heart of this ecosystem — using data to uncover inefficiencies, diagnose root causes, and fix real operational problems across the end-to-end supply chain.
You will deep-dive into ambiguous issues, challenge assumptions, and design scalable, pragmatic solutions that can be implemented on the ground. Your work will directly influence how millions of parcels move across the region.
You will also partner with Shopee’s 8 markets to understand local nuances and operational constraints — adapting regional frameworks into scalable, practical solutions across diverse market environments.
If you are someone who enjoys figuring out why things break, gets energised by solving messy real-world problems, and wants to see your solutions drive tangible impact, this role is for you.

Deep-dive operational issues to uncover root causes — not just symptoms

Propose and drive scalable, pragmatic solutions that can be executed across markets
Work closely with operations, product, and tech teams to turn insights into real-world fixes
Collaborate with regional and local stakeholders to adapt solutions based on market-specific realities

As a Product Manager Intern for SeaTalk, you will support the end‑to‑end product lifecycle from discovery to delivery and iteration and help explore how AI can enhance SeaTalk. You will:

We are hiring a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to design and build an AI/ML platform capable of high-throughput training and inference across local and cloud GPU environments. This role focuses on systems architecture, GPU acceleration, performance engineering, and reliable operation of AI workloads at scale. You will lead engineering initiatives, define platform architecture, and collaborate closely with ML and hardware teams.
Responsibilities
System Architecture & Core Engineering
Design and implement the architecture for model training, fine-tuning, and serving.
Build platform components that support heterogeneous compute environments (GPUs, NPUs, accelerators).
Develop and optimize high-performance inference stacks using frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton.
Develop APIs, CLI tools, and backend services for model lifecycle management.
Local & Cloud GPU Acceleration
Build and operate GPU clusters in on-prem systems and cloud environments (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure).
Optimize GPU memory, compute throughput, PCIe/NVLink utilization, and inter-node communication for distributed inferencing & training.
Tune CUDA, cuDNN, NCCL, and related libraries for performance and reliability.
Deploy scalable GPU-based inference systems with attention to latency, throughput, and cost.
Collaboration & Leadership
Mentor engineers; drive design reviews, architecture discussions, and coding standards.
Work with ML researchers and hardware teams to co-design efficient algorithms and deployment strategies.
Coordinate engineering deliverables and provide clear technical direction for the team.
Pre-Requisites :
Required Skills & Experience
8+ years of experience in software engineering, ML infrastructure, or high-performance computing.
Hands-on experience designing and operating both local GPU servers and cloud GPU environments.
Deep knowledge of transformer-based model inference and training optimization.
Experience building high-availability distributed systems, including failover, replication, and autoscaling patterns.
Strong proficiency in Python and at least one systems language (C++ or Go).
Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT, Triton).
Solid understanding of distributed systems, parallel computing, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Solid understanding of GPU programming (CUDA or ROCm), GPU memory hierarchy, and performance tuning.
Strong collaboration and communication skills; ability to lead engineering efforts.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with on-device or edge-accelerated inference.
Familiarity with cloud-native GPU scheduling and autoscaling systems.
Experience with model compression, quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference-efficiency techniques.
Contributions to open-source AI infrastructure projects.
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

title: Principal Engineer, Payments
snippet: As a Principal Engineer for Payments at Grab, you will be the technical driver behind the architecture and delivery of regional-scale payments...
description:
Get to Know the Team
At Grab Financial Group (GFin), we're building the future of payments in Southeast Asia. As Head of Payments Engineering, you will lead the end-to-end engineering organization powering all payment experiences across the Grab ecosystem – from in-app wallet transactions and online checkouts, to in-store POS payments and acquiring services for merchants. This is a director-level role with a remit that spans both strategic direction and deep technical leadership.
Get to Know the Role
As a Principal Engineer for Payments at Grab, you will be the technical driver behind the architecture and delivery of regional-scale payments platforms that power our consumer, driver, merchant, and enterprise ecosystems across Southeast Asia. You will design and ship fault-tolerant, compliant, and cost-efficient services that process high volumes of transactions across multiple countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulatory regimes.
You will partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and country teams to build platform capabilities spanning authorization, capture, settlement, reconciliation, disbursements/payouts, refunds and disputes, as well as wallets and real-time bank transfers. You will set the technical vision, lead complex multi-quarter initiatives, and raise engineering quality across the organization through design leadership, hands-on implementation, and mentorship.
You will report to the Head of Engineering. This position will be onsite at Grab One-North office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Own design and delivery of mission-critical payment systems with high availability, low latency, and strict correctness.
Define core payments architecture and drive platformization with clear domains, stable APIs, event contracts, data models, and versioning.
Build resilient integrations to card networks, banks, APMs, and real-time rails that tolerate changes and outages.
Champion reliability, observability, security, compliance, scalability, operability, and cost with SRE and Security, and lead chaos tests, DR, and incidents.
Lead regionalization across currency, localization, regulation, and scheme needs with safe rollouts and migrations.
Make pragmatic, data-driven decisions that balance impact, speed, and maintainability, and align stakeholders on trade-offs.
Author and review design docs/RFCs, lead architecture reviews, set coding/testing standards, and elevate service.
Lead by example with prototypes and critical-path builds, mentor senior and staff engineers, and scale best practices and culture.

Triple-A, the digital currency payment institution, enables businesses to pay and get paid in both traditional and digital currencies, volatility-free. From API to no-code integration, Triple-A’s frictionless, white-label payment solutions are designed to blend smoothly into existing business operations — all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
Triple-A is licensed in the United States, European Union and Singapore. We enable borderless collections & global payouts for 20,000 partners across 200 countries, including Grab, Charles & Keith, Razer, Du and Singapore Red Cross.
Join the team
Triple-A is a global payment institution. We are headquartered in Singapore, with offices across the Americas, Europe and Middle East.
We are a dynamic and passionate team building towards a more efficient global payment ecosystem. We are actively bridging the gaps in cross-border payments, between traditional & digital currencies, and web2 and web3.
Guided by our CEO, Eric Barbier, who brings 18 years of experience and a proven track record in building and scaling payment companies worldwide, Triple-A is growing our team. If you're bold, tenacious, and creative, we believe you'd be a perfect match for us!

As a Senior Application Development Manager, Treasury & Financial Systems, you will own and drive the end-to-end technology strategy and execution for automating Triple-A’s financial and treasury operations. This role sits at the intersection of application development, product strategy, finance, treasury, FX, and crypto, working very closely with our Finance and Treasury teams as well as dedicated engineering teams.
You will be responsible not only for product ownership and strategic direction, but also for overseeing the acquisition, architecture, development, and delivery of software systems and internal platforms. These platforms will cover everything from partner reconciliation and settlement, to forecasting automation, liquidity management, FX optimization, and broader treasury technology enablement.

About Airwallex
Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 150,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 1,800 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 26 offices around the globe. Valued at US$6.2 billion and backed by world-leading investors including Visa, Airtree, Blackbird, Sequoia, DST Global, Greenoaks, Salesforce Ventures, Lone Pine, and Square Peg, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
Attributes We Value
We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You’re humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.
About the team
Our Mobile Team is responsible for the end-to-end development of both our iOS and Android apps, leveraging the latest technologies to build a seamless user experience. On iOS, we work with SwiftUI, Combine, and Async/Await, while on Android we use AndroidX, Coroutines, Hilt, and a suite of Jetpack libraries.
You’ll be joining Airwallex at a pivotal moment as we expand the capabilities of our modern, fully native mobile apps. These apps empower customers to manage global B2B payments, submit and approve expenses, and control both virtual and physical Airwallex cards—including seamless Apple Pay and Google Pay integration for card transactions.
What you’ll do
As a Mobile Engineer, you’ll focus on building high-quality, user-friendly native mobile applications using modern frameworks and best practices. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver features that are reliable, intuitive, and performant.
This role is can be based in Singapore or Melbourne.
Responsibilities
Take ownership of the design, implementation, and delivery of key features across our iOS and Android apps, ensuring they are intuitive, performant, and reliable.
Collaborate closely with fellow engineers to define architecture, share best practices, and drive high-quality standards across platforms.
Influence how we scale and evolve our mobile apps—built less than three years ago—by shaping core architecture and contributing to long-term technical direction.
Go beyond feature development: contribute to team processes, product decisions, and broader engineering strategy as we scale globally.
Be a hands-on technical leader who takes pride in clean, testable code and actively supports continuous improvement across the mobile stack.
Who you are
We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum Qualifications:
6+ years of experience developing native mobile applications on iOS or Android, using modern frameworks and development practices
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Proven experience shipping one or more production apps, ideally available in the App Store or Google Play
Strong focus on code quality—writes testable code with high test coverage
Experience maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Bitrise)
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with modern Android or iOS development tools and libraries, such as AndroidX, Jetpack, SwiftUI, Combine, Hilt, or Coroutines
Equal opportunity
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Lead Simulation Engineer
snippet: Lead Simulation Engineer at Grab in Singapore, focusing on building production robotics and autonomy systems for urban environments.
description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
Get to Know the Team
You'll join a team that builds production robotics and autonomy systems for urban environments across Southeast Asia. We develop perception, planning, and control capabilities step by step, using safety evidence to guide each release. We focus on robust systems, quality code, and technical depth maintained within the team. We are a senior engineering group that values clean interfaces, reproducible development workflows, and systems that work in real-world conditions.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Simulation Engineer, you'll report into the Head of Engineering and be based in Grab One North Singapore Office. You'll lead the simulation platform that enables autonomy development and validation. You'll build capabilities across log replay, open-loop evaluation, and closed-loop simulation to help engineers test changes and catch regressions before they reach vehicles. You'll define system architecture, implement core components, and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable, and integrated into daily engineering workflows.
The Critical Tasks You will Perform
You'll architect and maintain the end-to-end simulation platform used by perception, planning, and control teams, ensuring it remains fast to run and easy to debug during daily development work.
You'll design versioned, testable integration contracts between the simulation environment and the autonomy stack, maintaining these interfaces as the system architecture evolves.
You'll build reproducible pipelines for scenario generation, test execution, and results reporting, creating clear pass/fail signals and trend tracking for autonomy changes.
You'll develop and maintain physics-based models of vehicle dynamics, sensors, and urban environments to improve agreement between simulated and real-world vehicle behaviour.
You'll build curated scenario libraries that reflect Southeast Asia driving patterns and edge cases, using real operational data and ensuring reproducible replay capabilities.
You'll design distributed simulation infrastructure that enables large-scale regression testing across thousands of scenarios.
You'll work with Perception, Planning, and Control engineers to align simulation fidelity with the validation needs of each subsystem.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You will Need
You have:
At least 5 years of experience building simulation systems for robotics or autonomous vehicles, plus production software development skills in C++ or Python.
Experience defining APIs or interface contracts between simulation environments and production software stacks.
Experience constructing log replay systems and automated scenario evaluation frameworks using real-world robotics datasets.
Experience with vehicle dynamics modelling, sensor simulation, or physics engines for robotics applications.
Experience curating test datasets or scenario collections from real-world vehicle operations.
Experience building scalable compute systems for continuous integration, regression testing, or large-scale simulation workloads.
Experience collaborating with perception, planning, or control teams to define validation requirements and acceptance criteria.
A Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience that helps you understand the vehicle dynamics and software architecture principles that this role requires.

About the Role
We’re building a next-generation Real World Assets (RWA) DeFi protocol that brings institutional-grade assets on-chain—securely, compliantly, and at scale. You’ll be the technical owner of the protocol, leading a team of ~5 engineers across smart contracts, backend infrastructure, and integrations. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will architect, code, review, and ship. If you enjoy designing systems where capital, risk, and code collide, this role is for you.
What You Can Expect To Work On
Technical Leadership
Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the RWA protocol across on-chain and off-chain systems
Lead, mentor, and unblock a small, high-impact team (~5 engineers)
Set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, security, testing, and documentation
Make pragmatic build vs. buy decisions across protocols, infrastructure, and vendors
Protocol & Smart Contracts
Design and implement production-grade smart contracts for:
Tokenized real-world assets (e.g. private credit, receivables, loans)
Capital deployment, redemptions, and yield distribution
Risk controls, liquidation logic, and circuit breakers
Ensure contracts are audit-ready, secure, and battle-tested
Work closely with auditors before mainnet deployments
Backend & Infrastructure
Architect off-chain systems supporting:
Asset lifecycle management
Oracle ingestion and verification
Compliance, reporting, and risk monitoring
Integrate with wallets, custodians, stablecoins, and on-chain liquidity venues
Design for reliability, observability, and graceful failure
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner directly with founders on product direction and technical roadmap
Translate legal and compliance constraints into robust, enforceable code
Collaborate with product and design to deliver developer- and user-friendly flows
What You Need to Succeed
7+ years of engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in crypto / DeFi
Strong hands-on experience with Solidity (or equivalent EVM languages)
Deep understanding of:
DeFi primitives (lending, AMMs, liquidations, yield mechanics)
Smart contract security patterns and common exploits
Proven experience leading engineers and shipping complex systems
Comfort operating in ambiguity—this is a build-from-zero role
Nice-to-Have (Strong Plus)
Experience with RWA, TradFi, or fintech systems (credit, payments, custody)
Familiarity with:
Oracles (e.g. Chainlink-style architectures
Account abstraction, permissioned DeFi, or compliance-aware protocols
Experience running or participating in protocol audits
Background in system design for high-value financial infrastructure
Tech Stack (Indicative)
Smart Contracts: Solidity, Foundry / Hardhat
Backend: TypeScript / Node.js, Python (where relevant)
Infra: Cloud-native (AWS/GCP), containers, CI/CD
Data & Oracles: On-chain + off-chain data pipelines
Security: Formal audits, monitoring, alerting
Why Join Us
Work on real money, real assets, real impact—not testnet vaporware
Significant ownership and influence over architecture and roadmap
Competitive compensation + meaningful upside
Build at the intersection of DeFi, private credit, and institutional finance
Benefits and Why You’ll Love Working With Us
We Listen. Your voice matters. We value your ideas and suggestions, and we’re always evolving based on your input. Together, we build a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.
Our People. At Mon Co, you'll work alongside a dynamic, multicultural, and talented team that’s not just skilled, but also fun, supportive, and inspiring. You’ll be proud to work with people who value diversity and teamwork as much as you do.
On the Edge of Innovation. Stay ahead of the curve. We work on cutting-edge technologies and trends, including Web3 and blockchain, empowering you to grow in an ever-evolving landscape.
Flat Organisation. We believe in a true decentralised spirit. Whether you’re new or seasoned, everyone has an equal voice. We collaborate across all levels, fostering an open, transparent, and supportive environment where every team member contributes to our success.

title: Product Manager – IT & Internal Platforms
snippet: Lead internal systems end-to-end: solve problems, own outcomes, bridge teams, and ensure tools work seamlessly for the business.
description:
What this role is
This is a role for someone who thinks like an engineer but operates like a product owner. You'll report directly to the CTO and be responsible for the internal systems and tools the rest of the business depends on — owning what gets built, why, and making sure it actually works for the people using it.
You won't be handed specs. You'll talk to the teams that rely on these systems, understand their problems better than they can articulate them, and direct the engineering work that solves those problems. The trust you earn won't come from writing every line of code — it'll come from consistently asking the right questions, understanding the landscape deeply enough to make good calls, and following through until things actually work.
You'll also be the connective tissue between a capable, independent engineering team and the rest of the business. The team doesn't need someone looking over their shoulder. They need someone who handles the noise, clears the path, and brings enough technical understanding to have real conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and direction.
What you'll actually do
Own internal products end-to-end (~30%)
You'll take ownership of internal IT products and systems — from identifying the real problem, through to directing the solution, shipping it, and iterating. You make the calls on what to build and how to approach it. You work with the engineering team to shape architecture and implementation, bringing product clarity so they can focus on execution.
Solve problems and build things (~25%)
You have the technical foundation to dig into issues, understand systems, and figure out what's going wrong. When something breaks or underperforms, you can get to the root of it — whether that means jumping into the problem yourself or knowing exactly what to ask. You'll also have the freedom to build smaller internal tools on your own — if you see something that would make people's lives easier or a process that could be smarter, you can go ahead and make it. That kind of initiative is welcomed here, not gatekept.
Keep delivery moving (~15%)
We use an internal AI assistant for project logging and prioritisation, so you're not buried in admin. Your job is to make sure things actually get done — following through on commitments, resolving priority conflicts between departments, and keeping momentum without creating overhead.
Run IT operations (~15%)
You're the escalation point when things go wrong across the company. Domain renewals, certificates, broken integrations, system incidents — the unglamorous but critical work that keeps everything running. You balance putting out fires with making sure they don't start again.
Be the bridge (~15%)
You sit between a strong engineering team and every other department in the business. IT touches everything, which means people will come to you with problems framed in business language, and you'll need to translate that into something the team can act on — and vice versa. You're the person department heads call when they need something from IT, and the person the engineering team trusts to protect their focus.
Who this is for
You've spent time building software — enough to understand systems, ask sharp technical questions, and hold your own in a conversation about architecture or tradeoffs. But what excites you most isn't writing code all day. It's figuring out what should exist, why it matters, and making sure it gets built well.
You're looking for a role where you can take ownership of products at a level of complexity and impact you haven't had before — and grow into it.
You might not have managed a team formally, but you're someone people naturally turn to. You know how to give others space to do their best work while making sure the right things are getting built.
On learning and tooling
The way software gets built is changing fast. We've been leaning into that — for example, we built an end-to-end AI customer support agent before most companies were even considering it. Not because we had a specialist team for it, but because someone was curious enough to explore what was possible and capable enough to make it real.
We don't expect you to walk in as an expert in every tool or method we use. One of our strongest engineers joined without fully realising what modern tooling could do — and became one of our most valuable people once he saw the possibilities and ran with them. What matters is that you're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you discover a better way to do something, and you go and try it.
If that sounds like you, you'll find plenty of room here to explore, learn, and apply what you discover.
What we'd like you to bring
5+ years in a technical role where you were close to how software gets built — whether as a developer, technical lead, or a product manager with real engineering fluency
Experience owning outcomes, not just tasks — you've been responsible for things that people depended on
Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to figure things out without waiting for perfect information
Strong communication — you can work with department leaders, translate between technical and non-technical worlds, and earn trust across both
Enough technical depth to have meaningful conversations about systems, architecture, and tradeoffs — even if you're not the one implementing every solution
Technical foundation
We care about whether you understand how software and systems work — not whether you've used our specific stack. If you've written code in any language, built or maintained something real, or been close enough to the process to understand how things fit together, that's the foundation that matters. The specific language or framework is less important than it's ever been. With the tools and resources available today, anyone with strong fundamentals can pick up a new stack quickly — and we've seen that play out on our team firsthand.
For context, our environment includes PHP (Laravel), Vue.js, Node.js, and Bun on the application side, with AWS infrastructure across services like EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, and Kinesis. Some projects touch data visualisation tools like Tableau and DOMO. But we mention these so you know what you'd be walking into, not because we expect you to know them already.
What we really value is someone who understands the fundamentals — how systems talk to each other, why something might be slow or breaking, what questions to ask when evaluating an approach. That kind of thinking transfers across any language or platform.

Orchestrate the Vision: Lead inception workshops and envisioning sessions with policy owners and C-suite stakeholders to crystallise vague problem statements into clear product opportunities.
De-Risk the Future: Conduct rigorous fit-gap analysis, market sizing and feasibility assessments. You will influence if a problem requires a digital solution, a policy change or a process redesign.
Shape the User Experience: Apply design thinking to translate user research into actionable service concepts, opportunity maps and prototypes. You will partner with Design and Engineering to co-create services that are visionary, viable and inclusive.
Bridge Policy & Tech: Act as the translator between high-level government policy goals and on-the-ground technical constraints, ensuring solutions are both visionary and viable.
Modernise Legacy: Tackle complex legacy systems by proposing future-ready, interoperable architectures that pave the way for digital transformation.
Stakeholder Management: Engage and align C-suite and senior government stakeholders on the product vision, strategy and delivery roadmap.
Deliver Clarity: Your final "product" in this role is clarity. You will synthesize insights into a validated product direction and roadmap, facilitating a seamless handover to delivery teams.
[What we are looking for]
We are looking for a strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity and can tell a compelling story.
Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Discovery Expertise: Strong experience in shaping early product direction, MVP scoping or working on pre-delivery discovery (0-to-1 work).
Strategic Translation: Ability to translate user needs, policy requirements, and technical constraints into viable product strategies.
Design Thinking: Solid understanding of design thinking principles and how to apply user research insights to product and service design.
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to navigate bureaucracy and align senior leadership/C-suite.
Collaboration: Able to facilitate cross-agency collaboration and navigate ambiguity to drive alignment.
Technical Fluency: Familiarity with technology and system design principles and agile ways of working.
Bonus Points For:
Familiarity with government processes, digital service standards, procurement frameworks or data governance.
Experience in public sector digital transformation or modernising large-scale legacy systems.
Why Join Us?
Shape the National Agenda: Work upstream where the biggest decisions are made. The directions you define will become the roadmap for national services used by millions.
Pure Product Thinking: Focus on the "Why" and "What" without getting bogged down in the daily grind of delivery and ticket management.
A World-Class Team: Join a discovery squad with Design, Engineering and Policy working as one team.
Tangible Impact: Continue the legacy of products like CulturePass and CrowdTaskSG, influencing how government services are imagined, not just implemented.
Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programmes.
We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

AP6415 Emerging Trends in Game Design is a 13-week course that begins with a comprehensive analysis of the games industry's past, present, and future. Students explore how trends develop and impact the industry, making their own predictions based on evidence and research. The course requires students to dive deep into specific game genres, tracking their evolution and projecting future developments. Additionally, the course emphasizes continuous professional development through class participation, peer critique, and collaborative interaction, mirroring the soft skills essential for the games industry.
Applicants to this position will be able to demonstrate expertise in industry analysis and game studies, with a high capacity for identifying and articulating shifts in market trends, technology, and player behaviour. Applicants will be able to demonstrate passion in guiding students through rigorous research methodologies, helping them translate data and history into logical future projections. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional in Digital Infrastructure and Systems Integration to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the conceptualisation, development and implementation of an integrated IT ecosystems and digital platforms supporting our multi-year master planning and development initiatives. You will orchestrate the technology foundation enabling seamless collaboration across Architecture and Land Planning, Engineering and Project Management, and Integrated Operations Divisions throughout the design, construction, and operational phases of Sentosa's transformation. This is a 3-year contract with the possibility of renewal.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Technology Planning
Drive the development of comprehensive IT roadmaps that align with Sentosa’s master planning objectives and support the full project lifecycle from conceptual design through operational handover. Collaborate with division heads to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions that enhance cross-divisional workflows and data integration.
Platform Development and Integration
Lead the selection, customization, and implementation of specialized platforms including Building Information Modelling (BIM) systems, Computer-Aided Design (CAD) environments, project management suites, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and operational management platforms. Ensure seamless data flow and interoperability between systems to support collaborative planning and real-time project visibility.
Cross-Divisional Coordination
Serve as the primary technology liaison between the three divisions, facilitating requirements gathering, system design workshops, and change management processes. Establish governance frameworks for data standards, system access protocols, and collaborative workflows that optimize efficiency while maintaining security and compliance standards.
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with technology vendors, system integrators, and external consultants while ensuring alignment with government procurement guidelines and statutory board requirements. Coordinate with Singapore's Smart Nation initiatives and relevant government agencies to leverage shared platforms and maintain compliance with national IT standards.
Implementation and Change Management
Develop and execute phased implementation plans that minimize disruption to ongoing operations while building organizational capability. Lead training programs, establish user support frameworks, and create documentation standards that enable effective technology adoption across all divisions.
Requirements
·       Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Architecture, or related field with minimum 8 years of progressive project management experience in large-scale infrastructure or construction technology implementations. Professional certifications in project management and familiarity with land architecture and construction industry-standard platforms such as ARCGIS, CAD, Primavera or similar integrated project delivery environments.
·       Demonstrated experience managing technology projects within construction, real estate development, or infrastructure sectors, preferably with exposure to master planning or mixed-use development initiatives. Understanding of tourism and hospitality operations technology requirements would be advantageous given Sentosa's unique operating environment.
·       Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder relationships in matrix organizational structures. Strong communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and translating technical concepts for diverse audiences including architects, engineers, and operations personnel.
·       Familiarity with Singapore government IT governance frameworks, procurement processes, and statutory board operating requirements will be an advantage.
