title: Manager/Senior Manager, Curatorial and Museum Design (NS Gallery Development)
snippet: The jobholder will be part of a team that conceptualises, strategises and develops a world-class NS-themed gallery (NSG)
description:
THIS IS A 2-YEARS RENEWABLE / CONVERTIBLE CONTRACT ROLE
Job Synopsis
The jobholder will be part of a team that conceptualises, strategises and develops a world-class NS-themed gallery (NSG) opening in 2028. The NSG aims to be a world-class exhibition that impart audiences with an understanding of Singapore’s immutable vulnerabilities, the importance and significance of NS, and why we ourselves must defend Singapore.
Key project components include (a) curating and executing NSG content, gallery design and fabrication across 4000 square metres of exhibition space; (b) conceptualising other museum-related planning and operations - e.g. special exhibitions.
Specific to the jobholder, he/she will work with the NSG development team to drive and ensure project delivery in the following areas:
(a)
procurement and management
of the gallery design and fabrication firm;
(b)
content research, curatorial and exhibition design
of the NSG – including guiding the appointed firm to translate the desired messages and outcomes into immersive and engaging content and exhibits for an effective visitor experience;
(c)
Large platform display at the NS Square Atrium
– including its installation, design fabrication and narrative messaging.
As part of overall project management, the jobholder is expected to manage the overall project timelines; work with the team to clear project fora where required; and front frequent and timely reports to senior management.
The following key responsibilities will be distributed among the NSG development team, with specific assignment determined as the project develops:
1.   Conduct Curatorial and Museum Design Efforts.
Manage the museum exhibition design vendors; chart project timelines and work with vendor to ensure the timely and successful delivery of the NSG in 2027/28.
Track, manage and meet timelines and fora clearance requirements for the museum design and other design-related proposals.
Help conduct and integrate findings from necessary focus group discussions on the gallery content and visitor experience into the overall gallery planning.
2.   Conduct Content Research and Development Efforts
Chart out the required timelines and plans; and manage content researcher and the research team (inhouse, DCS, interns etc) to flesh out the NSG content narrative, and develop the final gallery exhibition content.
Assess the sufficiency of the mapped out inventory of exhibition assets (artefacts and multimedia) for display in the NSG; and how to procure more if needed.
Evaluate and endorse the team’s assessment on the need for appointed content researcher to access MINDEF/SAF archival materials and liaise with various government entity to facilitate access.
Keep abreast of developments in the defence/security landscape that could be incorporated into the storyline.
Liaise and work with relevant internal and external stakeholder – including MINDEF/SAF agencies, WOG agencies/Ministries, and Defence Collective Singapore – on the content research effort, as well as requests for loans or acquisitions of objects needed to support the exhibits.
Assess and recommend the necessary resources that team requires, including HR and external expertise (NHB; consultants; FGDs etc).
3.   Project Management for the Design, Fabrication and Installation of the Large Platforms at Atrium, and Main Exhibition Gallery
Work closely with stakeholders, to ensure that the deliverables are on track. This includes liaising with (a) NS Square Project Office on larger NS Square development, SAF and Home Team; as well as (b) museum design firm on the design approaches and desired visitor experience.
Review and proofread copywriting for the exhibition content.
Work on the narrative and creative design/depiction of the large platforms displayed in Atrium, as well as in the main Gallery (exhibition and non-exhibition) spaces.
Monitor and track the necessary budget usage, procurement and contract matters related to the vendor/contract.
4.     Provide updates to NS Gallery Task Force and Working Groups
Support Assistant Director (NS Gallery) to provide regular updates, where relevant and required, to MINDEF/SAF management and other inter-agency platforms; including raising issues of concerns and recommending the course of actions.
Draft the minutes for key NSG fora.
5.     Work closely with internal tribe, key defence stakeholders, other target groups and general public to generate support for NS Gallery and ensure resonance.
Plan and implement the engagement sessions with desired target audience to generate support for NSG’s content.
Liaise with various agencies (e.g., Service Engagement Branches, MHA/Home Team, MOE, PA, SDC, MCCY etc) to set up engagement sessions with stakeholder groups under their purview.
Conduct analysis of the data and feedback collated during the engagement sessions, as well as the recommended changes, to the NS Gallery design, concept and storyline.
Plan and implement traveling exhibitions as part of audience testing for the content and design of the gallery.
Challenges:
As the gallery is a high-profile project involving many agencies, the key challenge would be to balance the needs and requirements of different stakeholders and effectively managing the design firm. He/she needs to ensure that the project remains on schedule and within budget, and the gallery meets its overall intent and objective
Job Requirements
Educational Requirements: Postgraduate degree in Arts or Social Sciences, preferably history, with a keen interest in Singapore’s social and military history.
The jobholder should preferably have minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in content research and development, as well as prior museum or curatorial experience.
The jobholder should have a strong command of both spoken and written English. The jobholder should also preferably be proficient in one other vernacular language.
The jobholder should have excellent communication, organisational and project management skills. Prior experience in project management in related areas is also an advantage.
The jobholder should be mature and possess excellent interpersonal skills.
The jobholder should be meticulous and detail-oriented.
The jobholder should take a problem solving perspective on issues, and help the team move towards viable solutions in a timely manner.
The jobholder should be comfortable with multi-tasking and tracking and driving multiple workstreams concurrently.
The jobholder should take the initiative in leading the team and be able to work collaboratively with different partners.

The Technical Marketing role plays a central role in shaping the future direction of Singapore's semiconductor R&D landscape. Through informed analysis and technical judgment, you will influence multi-million-dollar R&D funding decisions and help position IME's Advanced Packaging and Silicon Photonics capabilities three to five years ahead of volume market adoption, particularly for AI Computing and data center scaling.
This role is suitable for candidates with strong technical foundations and a deep passion for semiconductor technology, with the ability to think systemically and communicate clearly across disciplines.

Global Technology Intelligence & Synthesis

Synthesize insights from academic research, industry roadmaps, and competitor activities into structured analyses that inform internal strategy and funding priorities.
Engage with industry partners, research collaborators, and system companies to understand emerging needs and constraints, even when these are not yet well-defined or commercially mature.
Identify early inflection points in materials, integration approaches, and system architectures that may shape future R&D directions.
Institute-Wide Roadmap & Strategy Development
Support the definition and evolution of IME's technology roadmap by translating external signals into clear strategic themes and development priorities.
Work across multiple Technology Development (TD) departments to align research programs under a coherent, long-term vision.
Contribute to gap analyses against international benchmarks and roadmaps, helping to identify areas where new capabilities, facilities, or talent investment may be required.
Translate high-level system requirements into structured problem statements and research directions that guide R&D teams.
Required Qualifications
Education
Degree in a related engineering or science discipline.
Experience
Open to early-career PhD/Masters graduates as well as experienced professionals.
Core Attributes
Strong passion for semiconductor innovation.
Ability to rapidly learn new technical domains and connect disparate ideas into coherent strategic perspectives.
Comfort operating in ambiguity, where future requirements are not yet clearly defined.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with senior researchers, industry experts, and leadership.
Ability to influence without formal authority in a research-driven environment.

description:
We are seeking a talented and passionate Senior Process Engineer to join our silicon carbide (SiC) crystal growth team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing crystal growth technologies, operating crystal growth tools, and supporting the production of semi-insulating SiC wafers used as substrates for RF and millimeter-wave GaN devices. This position is within the National Semiconductor Translation and Innovation Centre Gallium Nitride (NSTIC - GaN) program.
Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize crystal growth technologies for semi-insulating silicon carbide (SiC) wafers used as substrates for RF and millimeter-wave GaN devices.
Design, execute, and analyze SiC crystal growth experiments using Physical Vapor Transport (PVT) and related growth techniques.
Characterize SiC crystals and wafers, including resistivity, defect density, crystal quality, and uniformity.
Collaborate closely with device, epitaxy, and integration teams to ensure material performance meets device requirements.
Troubleshoot processes and equipment to maintain tool performance and process quality. Prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Out-of-Control Action Plans (OCAPs), SPC, FMEA and other technical documentation.
Work with external vendors to control the wafering process and produce SiC wafers from SiC boules.
Collaborate with equipment engineers to maintain PVT and supporting tools, ensuring tool uptime above 90%, and provide backup support for equipment maintenance activities.
Document experimental results, prepare technical reports, and contribute to publications, patents, and project reviews.
Prepare and deliver technical presentations for internal reviews, conferences, and journals.
Support technology transfer and scale-up activities aligned with NSTIC - GaN program objectives.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Requirements:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
3 - 5 years of hands-on experience in silicon or silicon carbide (SiC) material growth.
Strong background in semiconductor device physics and materials processing.
Excellent communication skills, strong industry awareness, and proven problem-solving abilities.
Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Prior industry experience is an advantage.

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

snippet: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Research Software Engineer to join HD4. The Research Software Engineer will play a key role in...
description:
Who are we?
We are the University of Cambridge research centre in Singapore called Cambridge CARES, sponsored by the NRF CREATE program CAM.CREATE. Health-driven design for cities (HD4) is a collaborative research programme between the University of Cambridge, Nanyang Technological University and National University Singapore within Cambridge CARES. HD4 will deliver highly actionable data and evidence on the social determinants of health in Singapore, which have the potential to improve the public’s health.
HD4 sits at the heart of Singapore’s global research and development hub and paves the way for a sustainable and healthy city. It will undertake research in the following key areas: characterising the features of the environment that potentially impact health in Singapore; understanding the links between environmental factors, individual behaviours and health outcomes; observing the impact of environmental change on health in Singapore; simulating the impact of potential changes on the health of Singaporeans; and working with government agencies to co-develop data-rich public health tools. A key component of the project is SG100K, a population-based cohort of 100,000 participants with detailed information already collected. The cohort will be measured again in the future and we are therefore also pilot testing new methods of assessment.
The scientific techniques, technologies, tools and most importantly the knowledge gained through the programme will create a comprehensive systems view of how the urban environment affects population health in Singapore.
The programme will train and enrich the talent pool of next generation of researchers, and benefit from local and international expertise and an innovative interdisciplinary research ecosystem. It will provide the basis for a data-rich public health framework, supporting the development of a healthy Singapore.
Who are we looking for?
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Research Software Engineer to join HD4. The Research Software Engineer will play a key role in developing a scalable knowledge-based solution to automate ingestion pipelines for data to be represented as a knowledge graph by means of ontologies. This position provides an exciting opportunity to gain experience with building agentic workflows based on Large Language Models (LLMs) which, in particular, employ Model Context Protocol (MCP) in order to maintain integrity and quality of a dynamically changing knowledge graph environment. This role requires a skilled software engineer that can work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
Key Responsibilities:
· Software development: Design, develop, and maintain knowledge-based software applications.
· Collaboration: Work closely with researchers to understand their needs and translate them into effective software solutions.
· Optimization: Optimize software for performance, security, scalability, and usability.
· Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for software applications and processes. Support project reporting.
· Support: Provide technical support and training to researchers.
· Innovation: Stay updated with the latest advancements in software engineering and computational research to incorporate new technologies and methodologies.
What skills will you need?
· Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
· Experience: Proven experience in software development, preferably in a research or academic environment.
· Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Java.
Knowledge of software development methodologies and best practices.
Competence with version control systems (e.g., Git).
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
· Communication: Excellent oral and verbal communication skills.
· Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
· Competence with containerisation technologies (e.g., Docker).
· Experience with ontologies and knowledge graphs.
· Familiarity with libraries and frameworks for geospatial data processing and visualisation (e.g., graph databases, PostGIS, Ontop, Geoserver).
· Experience working with sensitive (e.g., personally identifiable) data.
What can we offer you?
· A stimulating working-environment with friendly, highly motivated colleagues.
· Opportunities to develop and implement new ideas in a creative environment.
· A competitive salary in line with your skills and experience.
· A comprehensive medical insurance cover as part of your employment.
Please note this post is mainly based in the CREATE Tower at NUS University Town, Singapore.

recruitment@cares.cam.ac.uk

description:
Nanyang Technological University (NTU) is a leading global research university, renowned for innovation in education and interdisciplinary research. The School of Art, Design and Media (ADM) is at the forefront of digital creativity and storytelling. We are seeking a forward-thinking individual to join our technical leadership team and help advance our animation and visual effects infrastructure.
Why Join NTU
Be part of one of Asia’s most advanced digital media and storytelling hubs.
Contribute to interdisciplinary innovation at the intersection of art, technology, and research.
Enjoy access to professional development, a vibrant campus culture, and flexible work policies that support creativity and wellness.
Collaborate with internationally renowned faculty and passionate students driving the future of animation and immersive media.
As Senior Assistant Manager for Animation, Game Design & Emerging Media capabilities, you will be responsible for leading the management, optimization, and innovation of ADM’s animation and VFX pipeline infrastructure. You will oversee and maintain advanced studios and technical facilities including the render farm, motion capture system, green screen stage, stop motion lab, and 2D/3D animation studios.
This role is central to enabling high-quality, future-ready teaching, learning, and research across animation and adjacent disciplines such as Interactive Media, Game Design, and Virtual Production. You will guide the adoption of cutting-edge software and hardware (e.g., Maya, Houdini, Unreal Engine), collaborate with faculty on curriculum and R&D, and lead technical training for students and staff.
You will also supervise a technical team and student assistants, manage a substantial operational budget, and liaise with vendors and industry partners to ensure ADM remains at the forefront of animation and media production innovation.
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee and optimize ADM’s high-performance animation and VFX pipeline across multiple specialized studios and labs.
Lead the maintenance, upgrading, and scaling of infrastructure including render farms, storage systems, and industry-standard software platforms.
Conduct structured training workshops each semester for students and faculty on technical workflows and best practices in animation, VFX, and real-time production.
Collaborate with faculty to integrate new technologies into teaching, Final Year Projects (FYPs), and research; support innovation pilots using real-time engines and AI.
Manage a team of full-time and part-time staff, coordinating schedules, project support, and technical delivery across peak periods.
Plan and execute procurement and budgeting for technical operations (~$100K–$120K annually); evaluate new tools, vendors, and capabilities in alignment with ADM’s growth.
Must-Have Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Animation, Media Arts, Computer Graphics, or related field.
5–8 years of experience in managing animation/VFX pipelines, render farms, or media production infrastructure.
Proficiency in industry-standard tools (e.g., Maya, Houdini, Nuke, Unreal Engine, Deadline Manager).
Strong planning, troubleshooting, and technical leadership abilities.
Experience training or mentoring users in an educational or production setting.
Good-to-Have Qualifications:
Familiarity with AI-based animation tools, virtual production workflows, cloud-based rendering, or AR/VR integration.
Experience supporting cross-disciplinary media projects (e.g., games, immersive installations, digital filmmaking).
Project management or vendor engagement experience in a creative tech environment.
We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

On our quest to create amazing games at our new Singapore office, we’re looking for awesome and talented people to join us in designing and creating new game worlds. We’re looking for fun-loving, passionate people with a sense of humor, a broad set of skills, life experiences, talents and perspectives. If that sounds like you, come join us in crafting new worlds and help us to connect players to the stories and characters within them. Come be a part of something awesome with us!

Game Reign is looking for talented and experienced individuals to create a new experience for mobile. This position will focus on the creative design of mobile content and you will be expected to wear many hats! The ideal candidate should be
highly driven, eager to learn, and possesses a clear sense of creative vision and direction
. You should have strong interpersonal skills, boundless creativity, a deep understanding of games, and a genuine passion for crafting meaningful player experiences.

Strong portfolio showcasing creative work in game design, art, or narrative development.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate creative ideas clearly.
Demonstrate strong drive, vision, and a clear sense of direction, proactively taking ownership of tasks and contributing to long-term team and business goals.
Passion for gaming and a strong understanding of player engagement and experience.

Our commitment extends beyond office hours as we engage in activities to strengthen our bonds and create a supportive workplace community.
Have Fun! – We prioritize and encourage a light-hearted, enjoyable, and positive work environment, fostering joy, laughter, and fulfilment in our daily tasks. Our commitment is to create a workplace where happiness and job satisfaction are integral to our daily experience.

Attestation: Implement and verify Hardware Root of Trust (RoT) and Secure Boot

Access (IAM): Design and enforce granular Zero-Trust Access policies for the

Response: Configure and monitor AI-specific Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)

Telemetry: Design real-time network telemetry dashboards to monitor link

description:
About us
Dyson is a global technology enterprise.  We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. About the role
As a Software DevOps Architect, you will design, build, and maintain the custom integrations, automation services, and platform components that make the SDLC toolchain work as a cohesive, scalable, secure system.
This role acts as a developer platform product engineer, building the internal services, middleware, automation pipelines, and self‑service capabilities that eliminate manual effort, reduce human error, and dramatically improve engineering productivity.
You will translate operational pain points into technical solutions, architect Python‑based services, integrate SDLC tools, and create automation that empowers engineering teams across software, embedded, hardware, and power systems engineering.
Accountable for:
Discovery & Solution Shaping
Understand manual workflows and capability gaps
Analyse recurring service desk requests and operational pain points
Identify manual tasks performed by tools engineers (provisioning, access, reporting, migrations)
Determine limitations of off‑the‑shelf plugins (security, cost, missing features, integration constraints)
Translate needs into buildable problem statements
Define user journeys (who, what, when, why)
Capture key constraints (security, compliance, network boundaries, performance, support expectations)
Produce lightweight functional and non‑functional requirements
Design & Architecture of Bespoke Tooling Solutions
Select appropriate solution patterns
Patterns commonly used:
API‑driven automation services
Middleware between SDLC systems (webhooks, events, queues)
Internal web apps/portals for self‑service
CLI tools for tooling engineers
Scheduled jobs for housekeeping and governance
Produce maintainable, robust architecture
Define service boundaries and API contracts
Design for idempotency, retry logic, observability, and strong security practices
Decide on data storage (or intentionally avoid persistence)
Consider threat modelling and dependency risks
Build Custom Integrations Across the SDLC Toolchain
Integrate core SDLC systems via APIs and events
Implement webhook/event processors (e.g., Bitbucket → CI → Jira)
Build cross‑tool automation, including:
Jira project + Confluence space + Bitbucket repo provisioning
Auto‑configuring SonarQube projects and quality gates
Auto‑applying BlackDuck policies
Creating Artifactory repositories and permission structures
Maintain consistent metadata, naming conventions, and tagging
Maintain integration resilience
Handle API changes, rate limits, and pagination
Implement robust error handling and auditing
Provide safe rollback or compensating actions
Automate Manual Operational Tasks (“Remove Toil”)
Identify and eliminate toil
Review runbooks and support tickets for repetitive work
Identify human‑error‑prone workflows and opportunities for policy‑as‑code
Convert manual steps into scripts → jobs → services → self‑service portals
Build self‑service capabilities
Provide UI/CLI automation for:
New project onboarding
Repository creation with templates and policy controls
Standardised pipeline creation
Permission/approval workflows
Reduce dependency on administrators for routine operations
Build System Enablement & Advisory for CI/CD Engineers
Develop reusable pipeline components
Maintain shared pipeline libraries and templates
Provide “golden path” examples for major stacks
Build reusable tasks for scanning, testing, packaging, and publishing
Improve pipeline reliability and performance
Implement caching, parallelism, and artefact reuse
Build diagnostic tooling for pipeline failures
Reduce flakiness through deterministic environment setup
Support CI/CD engineers
Provide tooling such as bootstrap scripts and validation checkers
Assist with complex pipeline designs across multi‑repo/mono‑repo patterns
Build automated checks for missing configurations or secrets
About you
Qualification & Skills
Strong Python development experience in automation, APIs, and backend services
Deep understanding of SDLC tooling (e.g., Jira, Bitbucket/GitHub/GitLab, SonarQube, Artifactory, BlackDuck)
Experience designing and implementing automation services and integrations
Strong knowledge of CI/CD principles and pipeline architecture
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Understanding of secure development practices, authentication patterns, and secrets management
Ability to design maintainable architectures with clear boundaries and observability
Experience operating the services you build (monitoring, logging, incident response)
Behaviours
Analytical, curious, and deeply pragmatic
Enjoys problem‑solving and simplifying complexity
Comfortable working hands‑on with engineering teams
Strong communicator—able to explain technical decisions clearly
Collaborative and supportive across global teams
Keen to automate, improve, and reduce toil wherever possible
Desirable
Experience with event‑driven architecture or queue systems
Familiarity with compliance‑driven software development (safety‑critical, regulated industries)
Experience designing internal portals or developer‑facing services
Knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, proxies, certificates)
Benefits
Dyson Singapore monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. But financial benefits are just the start of a Dyson career. Professional growth, leadership development and new opportunities abound, driven by regular reviews and dynamic workshops. description:
Production Line Leader
Job Description:
1. Supervising Production Activities:
Oversee the daily operations on the production line to ensure efficiency and quality standards are met.
Coordinate with other departments to ensure the production schedule is adhered to and any issues are promptly addressed.
Ensure that all production processes are followed according to safety, quality, and regulatory guidelines.
2. Team Management and Leadership:
Lead and manage a team of operators and workers, ensuring they are adequately trained and motivated.
Delegate tasks based on workers' skills and the production requirements.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback and coaching to team members.
3. Quality Control:
Monitor the production process to ensure the output meets the required quality standards.
Address any quality issues, initiating corrective actions as needed.
Ensure that proper documentation and reports related to quality are maintained.
4. Problem Solving and Troubleshooting:
Identify any problems or bottlenecks in the production process and find solutions to improve efficiency and minimize downtime.
Oversee maintenance and troubleshooting of production machinery, often collaborating with maintenance teams.
5. Ensuring Health and Safety:
Enforce safety protocols on the production line to reduce accidents and ensure a safe working environment.
Train and remind workers about safety procedures, ensuring they follow established health and safety guidelines.
6. Inventory and Resource Management:
Monitor and manage materials, ensuring there is enough stock for production without overstocking.
Report inventory shortages or excesses to ensure optimal production flow.
Ensure that the necessary tools and equipment are available and in good condition for the team to use.
7. Reporting and Documentation:
Maintain records of production quantities, machine performance, and worker attendance.
Prepare daily or weekly reports for upper management on production targets, quality issues, and staff performance.
8. Continuous Improvement:
Lead initiatives to improve production efficiency, reduce waste, and implement Lean or Six Sigma principles.
Suggest improvements to production processes or workflows and support the implementation of new technologies.
9. Coordination with Other Departments:
Work closely with other departments (such as logistics, maintenance, and engineering) to ensure smooth operations.
Communicate any delays or issues with upper management and suggest corrective measures.
Skills & Qualifications:
·       Minimum Secondary or Diploma or equivalent required
·       Technical or vocational training in manufacturing, machinery operation, or a related field is a plus.
Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of production processes, equipment, and safety standards.
Problem-solving abilities and a focus on continuous improvement.
Experience in managing teams and coordinating cross-functional activities.
Ability to handle pressure and adapt to changing production requirements.

description:
Product Manager
Date:
27 Feb 2026
Location:
Singapore, Singapore
Company:
Singtel Group
Product Manager (CyberSecurity)
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping the future of the enterprise Cybersecurity? We are on the lookout for a visionary Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of innovation, strategy, and execution. In this transformative role, you will have the unique opportunity to spearhead the design and delivery of groundbreaking Cybersecurity solutions and services that redefine how businesses operate and secure their critical infrastructure and data in the digital age.
As the driving force behind our Cybersecurity products, you will develop Cybersecurity services focusing on solutions from our strategic partner Palo Alto Networks, harnessing the collaboration to continuously enhance our service portfolio and capabilities and transform how enterprises implement and manage Cybersecurity. as well as leverage AI to address the evolving Threat Landscape. Given the rapidly evolving threat landscape, the Product Manager must also proactively identify ways to utilise AI in order to mitigate emerging vulnerabilities and counter new Cyber threats.
You’ll work closely with multidisciplinary teams—from engineering and marketing to sales, operations and legal, to ensure the tight execution of cutting-edge product strategies and overarching business objectives. Your strategic insights will fuel go-to-market initiatives, propelling successful product launches and driving sustainable revenue growth.
But that’s not all! This role is about creating tangible impact—engaging with enterprise customers to understand their evolving needs, leveraging their feedback to refine offerings, and ultimately delivering innovative solutions that make a lasting difference. If you crave the excitement of solving complex challenges and want to lead and shape the development of Enterprise Cybersecurity services, this role is for you.
1. Achieving Revenue and Profitability Targets
The Product Manager for Cybersecurity must prioritize financial goals, ensuring that each product contributes effectively to the organization’s overall revenue and profitability. This includes developing precise financial forecasts and budgets, analyzing sales trends, and identifying key opportunities to expand into new markets or optimize existing segments. By constantly evaluating the product’s financial performance and adjusting strategies, they can maximize profitability while balancing costs and investments in innovation and quality.
2. Formulating Product Strategies and Roadmaps
Creating a robust product strategy involves aligning with the organization’s vision and staying ahead of market trends and technological advancements. The Product Manager must define clear objectives for the product, detailing how it will address customer needs and differentiate itself from competitors. Roadmaps serve as actionable guides that track progress and prioritize tasks, while ensuring all stakeholders, including engineering and marketing teams, work cohesively to deliver the product successfully.
3. Managing the Entire Product Lifecycle
The Product Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire journey of a product, from initial concept and development stages to market launch and eventual retirement. This involves coordinating with Sales, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Delivery and other key stakeholders to ensure timely and efficient development. Post-launch, they continuously monitor the product’s performance, gather customer feedback, and initiate improvements or upgrades to keep the product relevant in a dynamic market. Planning for the product’s retirement also involves transitioning customers to newer offerings while preserving brand loyalty.
4. Driving GTM (Go-To-Market) and Pipeline Generation Initiatives
To ensure a product’s successful entry into the market, the Product Manager collaborates with marketing and sales teams to develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies. This includes defining the target audience, crafting compelling positioning messages, and designing promotional campaigns that maximize visibility. Additionally, they focus on building a strong pipeline of leads by leveraging industry events, partnerships, and data-driven strategies to secure sales opportunities and drive adoption across regions.
5. Working with Key Technology Partners for Continuous Innovation
Staying ahead in the Cybersecurity industry requires forging strategic partnerships with technology leaders, research institutions, and startups. The Product Manager must actively seek out new ways to integrate emerging security technologies into their products, ensuring they remain cutting-edge and competitive. Regular communication and joint initiatives with partners foster innovation, enabling the development of unique features and enhancements that keep the company at the forefront of Cybersecurity advancements.
6. Ensuring Alignment Across Teams
The Product Manager acts as the central coordinator between various teams in the organization, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and support. By facilitating clear communication and collaboration, they ensure that all departments are aligned on product objectives, processes and timelines. Establishing regular meetings, progress tracking tools, and shared resources helps create a cohesive work environment that drives efficiency and minimizes misalignment.
7. Monitoring Market Trends and Customer Needs
Understanding both the current market landscape and evolving customer expectations is vital for product success. The Product Manager conducts in-depth research on competitors, industry developments, and emerging technologies. They also actively engage with customers through surveys, interviews, and direct conversations to understand their unique requirements. This engagement allows the Product Manager to introduce tailored Cybersecurity solutions that address specific pain points, demonstrate value, and foster trust in the company’s offerings.
The Road Ahead
The future of cybersecurity managed services is being reshaped by rapid advancements in AI and automation. These technologies are revolutionising how organisations protect their digital assets, detect threats, and respond to incidents. By leveraging AI-driven Cybersecurity solutions from Palo Alto Networks, Singtel can deliver faster, more accurate threat identification, streamline incident response, and proactively address vulnerabilities for Enterprises before they escalate. As cyber threats become more sophisticated, the continuous integration of emerging technologies will empower Singtel to anticipate and neutralise risks, ensuring robust protection for clients. Embracing this next wave of innovation positions us to not only meet today's Enterprise security demands but also stay ahead of tomorrow's evolving challenges, delivering greater value and peace of mind in an increasingly complex digital landscape.

snippet: The DFO will provide comprehensive, strategic financial leadership in relation to the Technology & Operations functions. You will work with the...
description:
Objective
The Regional Finance team partners with the Business, Technology, Operations, and HR teams to support these functions in all aspects of financial management. The DFO is a trusted partner, advising on strategic and operational decision-making through financial insight and analysis.
The DFO will provide comprehensive, strategic financial leadership in relation to the Technology & Operations functions. You will work with the business through the commercial decision-making process to ensure optimisation of the cost base and investment options, constantly analysing and ensuring key concerns are raised and addressed early. You will maintain a forward-looking view of financial performance, including key performance levers, risks and opportunities relating to Technology and Operations.
The role will lead and develop direct reports dedicated to the Finance team.
Responsibilities
Portfolio Management (Information & Technology)
:
Liaises with Portfolio, Program and Project Managers to plan, forecast & report all portfolio related spends. Works with Project lead to ensure Project Managers accurately breakdown the cost components on projects, including the correct application on Chubb applicable accounting policies.
Appraise business proposals and participate critically in the capital governance processes. Ensure that all business cases are reviewed by Finance and incorporate robust and realistic financial projections.
Work with the APAC Exec and CFO to ensure portfolio view of spend is optimized to support the wider strategic and commercial objectives of the APAC business.
Working with the Project Managers to identify and implement standardized processes and approaches to project accounting, including greater reliance on systemized information.
Owns the financial lens of the Total Cost of Ownership model for the technology portfolio across APAC.
Capital management (CAPEX):
Collaborate with IT operations in ensuring that details of APAC CAPEX are accurately maintained in the APM. Each project is assigned a specific APM and project ID and the details as per APM module for various projects are reconciled with WIP for projects under completion and FAR for capitalised IT assets in PeopleSoft Ledger.
Ensure that list of WIP is reviewed on quarterly basis for potential project completion and the details of completed projects are referred to IT Steering Committee (thourgh COG controllership function) for their approval in relation to capitalisation of IT assets.
Produces, and analyses capital reports across all Business Units at agreed intervals, identifies performance indicators & trends and analyses causes of unexpected variance.
Work with IT and Operations stakeholders to improve capital reporting and forecast reliability in relation to CAPEX for APAC.
Liaise with Country Finance teams to ensure that the CAPEX spend is accurately reflected in their Balance Sheet on USGAAP / Local GAAP basis incuding the accounting for Work In Progress and capitalisation of IT assets.
Produces and analyses a forecasted view of the depreciation impact of all capital plan from a Strategic and Annual plan, and Fixed Asset Register (FAR)/WIP perspective.
Expense management (IT OPEX):
Support the function to create the bottom-up driver based 1 year expense plan which aligns to the top-down constraints provided by management as part of the 5 yr Strategic Plan and wider COG and Group IT strategy.
Advise on key business planning assumptions, trade-offs, and opportunities through scenario analysis.
Provide a forward-looking view of performance through forecasting, analysing expense drivers and identifying risk and opportunities, proactively communicating to both the IT and Operations Finance teams.
Identify both financial variance to plan and forecast providing business level explanation of these variances.
Responsible for monthly monitoring of actuals versus forecast versus plan across APAC on a timely basis, ensuring accuracy, completeness and required reconciliation to Chubb reporting systems.
Drives Intercompany & Interdepartmental allocation methodologies within both corporate and regulatory boundaries to ensure equitable and transparent cost of ownership for all functions.
Liaise with Group IT/ COG IT in gaining full understanding of Corporate IT cost allocation for APAC and provide support in conducting benefits analysis test for COG APAC operations.
Business partnering and decision support:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within APAC and COG, including but not limited to the APAC Business Office, CIO, Operations, CFO, COG IT, COG controllership and COG expenses Team.
Advise stakeholders on the financial base of the functions, interpretation, analysing and driving performance.
As appropriate, represent stakeholder interests with relevant internal groups through meetings, comms, etc.
Process improvement
Analyze existing finance processes and identify opportunities for efficiency, standardization, and automation.
Advocate for the adoption of innovative technologies (e.g., use of AI/ data analytics) to enhance finance processes and decision-making.
Monitor and enhance internal controls related to CAPEX and OPEX management in relation to IT spending.
Regulatory Compliance:
Ensure compliance with various Accounting Standards (USGAAP/IFRS) and the Company’s Accounting poliices  with respect to the accounting for IT OPEX, WIP, Capitalisation of IT assets and amortisation.
Ensure compliance with Transfer Pricing requirements in APAC countries with respect to allocation and cost recharges for intragroup IT OPEX/CAPEX .
Stay updated on industry trends and regulatory changes that may impact IT expense management practices.
Skills
The ideal candidate will possess superior finance, data analytics and Excel modelling skills and be able to apply them in a wide range of business situations.
Demonstrated knowledge in finance and accounting with strong analytical and problem-solving skill.
Strong interpersonal skills, highly collaborative working and communication style.
Highly organized, self-motivated with strong written and verbal communication skills and a customer focused, professional demeanor.
Ability to work independently, partner cross-functionally, and be self-motivated in a fast-paced and rapidly changing technology environment.
Knowledge and/or background in Technology projects and operational, and/or Technology Infrastructure and Application with strong business acumen is preferred.
Experience leading and developing others.
Experience
10+ years of experience in financial analysis role, preferably with experience in supporting the Technology and Operations functions
5+ years in a leadership position
Experience in Technology asset management, procurement and vendor management is an added advantage
Multi lingual, multi-currency corporate environments highly preferable.
Qualifications
Professional degree or equivalent in Accounting. Additional qualification in Technology field preferred but not essential for this position.

We provide the capabilities for small sellers to sync their products, inventory and orders across platforms so they can focus on growing their business instead of being overwhelmed by daily operations.
As a small startup, we move fast, test ideas often, and value learning over perfection. Everyone here gets hands-on exposure, autonomy in their work, and a real voice in shaping how the product evolves.
You will get to try things, break things, learn fast, and see your work turn into real product decisions.
Job Description
About the role:
We are looking for a Growth and Content Intern to help us experiment, learn, and find what truly resonates with small online sellers.
This is a hands-on role where you will be involved in testing content ideas, talking to real sellers, and helping us understand what works and what does not. There is no fixed playbook here. You will be encouraged to try things, learn quickly, and iterate based on feedback.
What you will be doing:
Create short, simple content for platforms like TikTok and Instagram to explore seller pain points and workflows
Experiment with different hooks, messages, and formats to see what resonates with small sellers
Engage with sellers who comment or message us, and help onboard them into pilot testing
Sit in or observe onboarding sessions and see how sellers interact with the product
Collect feedback, questions, and objections from sellers and share insights with the team
Work closely with the founder to refine messaging, content ideas, and user experience
Your work will directly influence both how we talk about Indexync and how the product evolves.

We care more about curiosity and initiative than formal experience.
You might be a good fit if you:
Have sold online before or are familiar with platforms like Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop
Enjoy creating or experimenting with social media content
Are comfortable figuring things out without step by step instructions
Like autonomy and taking ownership of your work
Are curious about startups, products, and how small businesses operate
You do not need to be a marketing expert or have perfect videos. We value willingness to try, learn, and improve.

Hands-on experience working inside an early-stage SaaS startup

Robinson Rd, Singapore
Map

$600 - 1,400 monthly
Company Profile
We are a Singapore-based quantitative trading firm and fintech startup trading U.S. equities with fully automated intraday strategies. We run real capital, real infrastructure, and real research pipelines.
We also build an AI-native quant research platform internally and commercially — meaning you’ll be working with institution-grade data, backtesting systems, and research workflows, not toy notebooks.
Job Description
You will not be cleaning CSVs all day. We provide:
Clean, institutional-grade historical & intraday data
A production-grade C++ / Python backtesting engine
Full research infra, logs, factor libraries, and analytics stack
Clear research problems with real PnL impact
Your job is to turn ideas into strategies and features that make or save money.
* What You’ll Do
You will work directly with our quant team on systematic strategy R&D, including:
Research new alpha ideas for intraday U.S. equities (long & short)
Design quantifiable features / factors from price, volume, microstructure, regime, etc.
Implement and test strategies in our backtesting framework
Analyze large-scale backtest results:
PnL distributions
Drawdowns
Regime performance
Failure modes
Improve existing strategies:
Entry logic
Exit logic
Filters
Risk logic
Help build strategy variants and parameterized families instead of one-off ideas
Write clean research notes: hypothesis → test → result → conclusion
If you perform well, your work can and will be deployed to live trading.
* What We Provide (You Don’t Have to Worry About This)
* Clean, survivorship-bias-safe historical data
* Intraday minute data, corporate actions, session logic handled
* Fast backtesting engine
* Research tooling, logs, analytics, dashboards
* Existing factor & strategy libraries
* Guidance on what actually works in small-cap / intraday trading
You focus on thinking, testing, and improving edge.
* What We’re Looking For
Must Have:
Strong logical thinking and quantitative intuition
Comfortable with Python (for research / analysis)
Basic understanding of:
Backtesting
Overfitting
Data leakage
Regime dependency
Able to think in if-this-then-that systematic rules
Curious, skeptical, and not emotionally attached to ideas
Nice to Have:
Experience with:
Trading strategies
Backtesting frameworks
Statistics / ML
Financial time series
Experience with pandas / numpy / vectorized analysis
Interest in market microstructure, intraday behavior, or small caps
We do NOT require:
Prior profitable trading
Finance degree
Fancy ML background
We care about how you think, not your resume.
* What Kind of Problems You’ll Work On
Examples:
Why do some parabolic shorts fail and squeeze while others fade cleanly?
How to detect regime shifts in small caps?
How to cluster trades into behavioral buckets?
How to turn 10 similar strategies into one adaptive strategy?
How to detect crowded vs fragile price structures?
How to build context-aware filters instead of static rules?
* What You’ll Learn
How real quant research is done in a trading firm
How to avoid fake edges and backtest lies
How to think in distributions, not examples
How to design strategies as systems, not one-off setups
How professional research pipelines are structured
How ideas move from research → backtest → production
* Compensation & Upside
Monthly stipend (depends on profile)
High performers may get:
Extension to full-time
Performance-based bonus
Direct ownership over live strategies
* Culture Fit (Important)
You must like being wrong and updating fast
You must enjoy killing your own ideas
You must prefer truth over ego
You must be comfortable with:
“90% of ideas don’t work. That’s normal.”
Application Instructions
Please apply for this position by submitting your text CV using InternSG.
Kindly note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
Apply for this position

description:
We are Reckitt
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
​Research & Development​
In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.
We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.
The size of our organisation means you'll have the opportunity to learn and work in different functions within R&D, giving you exposure to different disciplines, teams and environments. You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
About the role
Would you like to get a glimpse behind the scenes of a Powder manufacturing Process? Come and join us as Process Engineering Intern. In this way, you will gain valuable practical experience and perform a range of day-to-day tasks as a fully integrated member of the team while still a student.
If you are interested and have experience in the domain of data analytics, machine learning, numerical simulation, or process simulation you have opportunity to work on designing and building industrial scale numerical and process simulation application.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing and creating virtual simulation models to test various kinds of manufacturing process, technical assessment and pilot plant operation workflows in virtual environments.
The scope could be anything from liquid applications to spray drying applications to plant scaling up.
You will collaborate with our scientists and Process Engineers, analyse the existing prototype simulation tool, and help develop applications for demonstrating the algorithms and the simulation results. This gives great opportunity for you to go through various phases of simulation software development process starting from analysing the existing system, designing building the new system, testing and implementation to use in process engineering.
You will be reporting to Head of Process Engineering ASIA R&D.
Your responsibilities
Work together with Process Engineer and Scientist in R&D environment.
Design, analyse, and test software prototypes and algorithms.
Develop simulation tools and program to improve workflows by using Microsoft Powerapps application
We expect that you show above-average motivation to develop demonstrators and software prototypes and proactiveness to come up with new concepts and ideas on how to overcome possible challenges.
The experience we're looking for
Undergraduate from Food Science, Chemistry or Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems programme
Curious, always keen to learn, open-minded and enthusiastic to work in a vibrant environment with experienced people
Currently enrolled in applied mathematics, physics, computer science, data science, engineering, or similar knowledge from software development for other projects
You have a sound knowledge in Python and Microsoft Powerapps and shell scripting
Good knowledge in data analytics libraries
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Good verbal and written communication skills
What we offer
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
Equality
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

By harnessing the potential of technology and establishing a foundation built on trust, our aim is to tackle obstacles, improve services, and pave the way for a more promising future.

Your Role and Responsibilities
•        Plan and conduct user research activities — including interviews, surveys, and usability testing — synthesising findings into actionable insights, personas, journey maps, and service blueprints that inform product strategy and prioritisation.
•        Facilitate discovery workshops with business users and stakeholders to surface pain points, map current-state workflows, and define the design scope.
•        Map current-state and to-be user journeys across digital touchpoints and backend processes, articulating system interactions and technical dependencies to define optimal end-to-end experiences.
•        Translate user insights and stakeholder requirements into wireframes, mock-ups, and high-fidelity Figma prototypes for usability testing, stakeholder review, and development handover.
•        Develop design iterations and alternatives with clear rationale and trade-offs; drive continuous refinement through usability testing and iterative improvements that simplify complex systems.
•        Build and maintain design systems, component libraries, UI specifications, and interaction patterns to ensure consistency across products and support development teams during implementation.
•        Collaborate closely with engineers throughout the development lifecycle — from initial concepts to final delivery — ensuring accurate and feasible implementation.
•        Engage stakeholders throughout the design process — gathering requirements, prioritising problem statements, and presenting design concepts and research findings in clear, compelling formats.
Skills and Experience Required
•        Diploma or bachelor's degree in design, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
•        5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or service design, with the ability to work across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
•        Strong proficiency in Figma and other prototyping tools; familiarity with Miro, Jira, or equivalent collaboration tools.
•        Experienced in facilitating ideation workshops, requirements gathering, and synthesising UX design approaches with stakeholders.
•        Confident in executing UX research methodologies, journey mapping, service blueprinting, visual and interaction design, and prototyping.
•        Solid understanding of design systems, responsive design, and accessibility principles (WCAG 2.1 AA).
•        Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•        Experience in government, public sector, or large-scale enterprise settings is preferred.
•        A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process, strategic thinking, and measurable impact is required.
Who We Are and What We Offer
We are a dynamic and enterprising design team, embarking on an exciting journey to shape the digital landscape in Singapore. As part of Ufinity, a custom software development company, we specialize in executing product design within an agile environment, while thriving on pushing boundaries and delivering the objectives given.
With a passion for innovation and a flair for user-centric design, we are committed to redefining what's possible. We seek creative visionaries who possess the drive to think beyond conventions, motivate others, and accomplish the seemingly impossible. In our fast-paced environment, we embrace experimentation and learning from failure. Collaboration is our cornerstone, fostering a supportive and inclusive atmosphere where we unite in pursuit of our mission.
With that said, here are some things we offer:
•        A comprehensive skillset development program to build your career
•        Annual training budget for individual and team upskilling
•        Regular team gatherings for sharing of work and non-work-related ideas
•        A dynamic and open working environment to learn and grow

Who we are
Open Government Products (OGP)
operates like a startup within the government; We are a fast-paced, dynamic team of engineers, designers, and product managers dedicated to public good. We autonomously identify opportunities to solve public problems using tech, rapidly prototype, and launch solutions - from citizen apps to automating public agency operations. Embracing an open-sourced and flat hierarchy, we cut through bureaucracy to focus on real-world, user-centric innovations that drive change.
What does a Senior Product Designer do?
We have over 40 products, with each team typically made up of 1 Product Manager, 1 Designer, and 2 to 4 Engineers. As a
Senior Product Designer
, you will own the end to end experience of your product, from vision to execution.
On a day to day basis, this means:
Engaging with citizens and public officers to deeply understand their needs and motivations
Facilitating cross-domain and cross-functional collaboration to align goals and guide decisions
Driving problem exploration, solution discovery, and delivery across teams
Working autonomously and navigating complexity with confidence
Defending design decisions and securing buy-in from both internal and external stakeholders
You will work on meaningful projects that solve problems pertinent to our society, from transportation, to education, to healthcare. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. You will have direct ownership of your work with over 70% of our projects starting as ground up initiatives.
Rather than work on commercial ventures commonly found in the startup scene, we're here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.
We look for people who
Design with impact
— You have extensive experience shipping products and experiences, whether through work or personal projects.
Show strong design sense and judgment
— Your portfolio demonstrates thoughtful work, and you can clearly explain the decisions behind it.
Are fluent with modern tools —
We mainly use Figma, with some using Cursor. You should be comfortable learning and adopting new tools to deliver your best work.
Communicate across disciplines —
You engage across disciplines, clearly communicate your designs, and influence others, including policymakers.
Take initiative
— You don’t wait for instructions; you push for change, challenge the status quo, and make things happen.
Care about the public good
— You believe in serving people above politics, and you’re willing to stand up when something isn’t in the public interest.
Overall we look for people who have ability, initiative, good communication, and an interest in public good.
Working at OGP
Ownership and Autonomy
— Beyond technical tasks, this means having autonomy to voice opinions and suggest future directions. Building what you believe in drives the creation of great solutions.
Rapid Prototyping
— We prioritize testing ideas over debating them, allowing us to identify problems quickly and convey possibilities to others. This fail-fast approach accelerates innovation.
Flexibility
— We provide flexible work arrangements based on what works best for our team and its members, fostering a productive and supportive environment.
Continuous Learning
— Drive professional growth by exploring new architectures, frameworks, and technologies. With dedicated yearly learning months and hackathons, continuous learning is essential as we tackle innovative ideas and challenges.
Mission-Driven
— Our work is dedicated to the public good, aiming to improve the lives of Singapore citizens. We focus on creating impactful solutions that enhance the community and the place we call home.
Projects we have worked on include:
Covid-19 Vaccination National Appointment System
- A suite of systems built to enable Singapore's national vaccination campaign for Covid-19. This includes informational sites, appointment booking systems, and records management systems.
Data.gov.sg
- An open repository of all the Singapore Government's public data. It helps people understand the data using visualisations and articles, and provides real-time APIs for developers to use.
Parking.sg
- A mobile app alternative to parking coupons. It lets users pay, extend, and refund their parking sessions just using their phones.
FormSG
- A form builder tool for agencies to self-service and create online forms that capture classified data, with the goal of replacing paper forms.
Isomer
- Isomer provides government agencies with an easy-to-deploy static website building and hosting service to create usable, secure and faster informational websites quickly.
RedeemSG
- RedeemSG helps the Singapore Government to create, send and track redemptions of digital vouchers easily.
PaySG
- PaySG was developed to enable digital payments for government services, and was initially used for payments for COVID-19 swab tests and Stay-Home Notices for incoming travellers to Singapore.
An overview of other OGP products can be found on our website: https://www.open.gov.sg/products/

title: Architectural Coordinator (Executive or Senior Level)
snippet: As a growing practice, this is an opportunity to be part of the core team, build and own your work processes and be part of the success story.
description:
Are you a technically fluent architectural professional who takes ownership of your work and wants to see it built? We are looking for a driven and dependable Architectural Coordinator to join our lean, ambitious team — someone ready to grow with a practice that is building something worth being part of.
About Us
Taler Studio + Architects
is a Singapore-based practice at an exciting stage of growth. We work across experience design, residential, conservation, commercial mixed-use, retail projects and real estate strategy. Our directors Ar. Lawrence Ler and Ar. Kenneth Tan brings together more than two decades of award-winning experience in architecture, interior design and real estate advisory — and we are now building the core team that will grow with us. We are small by intention: every person here has real ownership over their work, real exposure to clients and consultants, and a real stake in the practice’s future.
Why This Role Exists
As we take on more projects, we need a technically strong coordinator who can
lead and own
the documentation side of our work — producing submission-ready drawing sets, keeping cross-discipline coordination tight, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks between design intent and built reality. This is not a role where you push drawings in the background. You will be a visible, valued part of how our projects get delivered.
The Role
This is a
full-time or part-time
Architectural Coordinator or Senior Architectural Coordinator position based in Singapore. You will work both independently — managing your own drawing sets from design development through to detailed and tender packages — and in close support of the Principal Architect on more complex deliverables. You will own the authority submission process across both the current CORENET 2.0 platform and the new CORENET X / RABW workflow, ensure design compliance against building codes before lodgement, coordinate across consultants, and help us build stronger internal documentation systems as the practice scales.
What You’ll Do
Drawing production:
Prepare and manage comprehensive architectural drawing sets across all project stages — from design development through to detailed and tender drawing packages, ensuring sets are complete, coordinated, and construction-ready
Code compliance checking & Authority laison:
Assist in reviewing and checking design proposals against relevant Singapore building codes, BCA and URA regulations, and all technical agency/authority requirements — identifying compliance issues early so that designs are submission-ready before lodgement. Liaise directly with authority officers to resolve code compliance and technical issues.
Authority submissions — CORENET 2.0:
Prepare, compile, and lodge authority submission packages via the current CORENET 2.0 platform, ensuring all documentation is accurate, complete, and meets prevailing agency requirements.
Authority submissions — CORENET X / RABW:
Prepare for and execute submissions under the new CORENET X platform and its Regulatory Approval of Building Works (RABW) workflow — the 3-Gateway sequential process (Design, Construction, Completion) that consolidates agency review into a integrated coordinated BIM submission in IFC-SG (openBIM) format
Consultant coordination:
Coordinate technical drawings with structural, M&E, and specialist consultants to ensure cross-discipline consistency and accuracy throughout all project phases
Independent and collaborative work:
Work independently on your own drawing sets while supporting the Principal Architect on more complex deliverables — capable of managing both in parallel
Site supervision support:
Assist with site supervision — verifying that works on site align with approved drawings and specifications, and flagging discrepancies promptly, especially where regulatory interpretation and compliance is required
Document control and approval timelines:
Maintain drawing registers, revision schedules, submission records, and correspondence logs with rigour and consistency across all active projects
Standards & workflows:
Contribute to the continuous improvement of drawing standards, submission templates, and BIM workflows as the practice grows
What Makes This Role Different
You are an early hire, not a number:
Joining at this stage means your contributions shape how the practice develops — including its culture, standards, and reputation.
Real ownership from day one:
You will manage your own drawing sets and see your technical work translate directly into built projects, from conservation shophouses to new residential and commercial developments.
A growth path with the practice:
As the team and project pipeline expand, so does your role. We are building a team of long-term collaborators, not a revolving door.
A team that values craft:
We care about the quality of every drawing set. If you take pride in precise, well-coordinated documentation, you will feel at home here.
What We’re Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Diploma in Architecture
, Design, or a related field from a recognised Polytechnic or equivalent
3 to 8 years
of hands-on experience in architectural technical drawing production, documentation, and authority submissions in Singapore.
Salary and title
(Architectural Coordinator / Senior Architectural Coordinator) shall match according to proven depth and breadth of experience.
We believe in fair compensation for talented candidates who are committed to grow with our business and see their future with us.
Submissions & Compliance
Hands-on experience preparing and lodging authority submission packages via CORENET 2.0; working understanding of — or demonstrated readiness to adopt — the new CORENET X platform and its RABW (Regulatory Approval of Building Works) 3-Gateway workflow, including the shift to coordinated BIM submissions in IFC-SG format
Ability to review design drawings proactively against Singapore building codes, BCA and URA regulations — catching compliance gaps before they become submission issues
Experience preparing detailed drawing packages and tender documentation for construction procurement
Software
Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; working knowledge of Revit and BIM workflows
Proficiency in SketchUp or Rhino for 3D visualisation and design communication
Working knowledge of Adobe Suite for presentation and documentation purposes
Coordination & Personal Qualities
Experience coordinating with structural, M&E, and specialist consultants across multiple project stages
Exposure to site supervision and construction administration
Meticulous attention to detail — you check your work, and then check it again
Systematic and organized – to manage submission progress, project timelines and document control
Ability to manage multiple drawing sets and meet tight deadlines without compromising quality
Clear, professional communication skills — written and verbal
Legal right to work in Singapore.
This is a Singapore based position; candidates must possess the legal right to work in Singapore.
Who You Are
You are a technically experienced and self-motivated architectural professional with a strong foundation in documentation and submissions. You understand that a well-prepared drawing set is not just a deliverable — it is the difference between a smooth approval and a frustrating one, between a build that goes to plan and one that does not. You are at a career stage where you want more ownership, more breadth, and more investment in the work you do — not just more years doing the same thing. You are diligent, organised, and you do not cut corners.
You want to be part of something that is growing, and you are ready to grow with it.
You're not filling a seat — you're helping build the team, the standards, and the culture of a growing studio. Early hires at Taler Studio+ benefit directly as the practice scales. If you've ever wanted to be part of something from the ground up, this is that moment.

Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Ampersand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

Draft technical work instructions for preventive and corrective maintenance activities and/or quality procedures.
Identify, propose, and implement cost effective technologies, and/or changes to process and/or maintenance regime to enhance railway infrastructure system performance.
Support LTA and SMRT projects in reviewing project design specifications and ensure their adequacy for the safety, reliability, maintainability, and operability. To provide other

Degree in Mechanical / Mechatronics / Electrical / Electronics / Civil & Structural Engineering or equivalent from a recognised institution

Strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Comfortable to work hands-on in office and site environment alongside other Engineers, Assistant Engineers and Technical Officers. Must also be able to work in different shift timings, when required.
