title: Senior Software Engineering Lead, Resilience and Chaos Engineering
snippet: In this role, you will establish and lead an engineering team dedicated to the stability and endurance of our robotics software platform. You will...
description:
Role
In this role, you will establish and lead an engineering team dedicated to the stability and endurance of our robotics software platform. You will design systems that proactively identify vulnerabilities within our APIs, SDKs, web interfaces, and cloud-to-edge communication layers.  By simulating scenarios such as AI model inference timeouts, high network latency, data pipeline congestion, and malformed input, you will ensure the platform maintains a safe and predictable state even when the environment is not. You will guide a specialized team in developing automated frameworks that replicate real-world disruptions, thus providing a dependable infrastructure for the developers building the next generation of AI-driven robotics. This responsibility includes developing the necessary monitoring tools to gain deep insights into overall system health. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate with world-class engineering teams in Mountain View and Munich to synchronize resilience strategies and set global standards for software reliability.
How your work moves the mission forward
Create automated resilience tests focusing on service boundaries and hybrid environments (on-prem and Cloud).
Bolster the robustness of AI integrations by implementing failure injection within data pipelines.
Deploy fuzzing and property-based testing techniques platform-wide to guarantee graceful degradation.
Enhance the stability of developer tools and frontend systems against latency and service interruptions.
Cultivate a culture of reliability through engineer mentorship in defensive programming and by spearheading global "Game Day" exercises.
Construct observability tools to monitor and analyze holistic system health.
Skills you will need to be successful
4-year degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
At least 5 years experience in software engineering.
Demonstrable experience with cloud computing.
Proven ability to lead a team, providing architectural guidance and fostering professional growth for other engineers in a global setting.
Experience with one of Go, Python, or C++.
Strong communication skills.
Skills that will differentiate your candidacy
Distributed Systems Architecture:
Strong experience building and debugging hybrid software environments where local runtimes interact with cloud-hosted services.
Reliability Engineering Patterns
: Deep understanding of software patterns for resilience, such as circuit breaking, retries with backoff, and bulkhead isolation.
Automated Testing Proficiency
: Expertise in creating frameworks for fault injection, property-based testing or coverage-guided fuzzing.
Full-Stack Technical Knowledge
: Competency in systems-level languages and an understanding of how to build resilient frontend interfaces.
Infrastructure & Tooling
: Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and CI/CD pipelines to automate failure simulations.
Robotics Software Experience
: Hands-on experience with robotics frameworks or complex hardware-interfacing software.

description:
Company Overview
At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren’t just places to consume content — they’re places where communities build.
Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA’s history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.
Job Summary
We’re looking for a Chief of Staff & Head of Strategic Partnerships to operate as the senior leader’s right hand and to own the partnerships that are critical to product delivery and global scale.
In this role, you will be the primary interface between the company and one or more strategic external partners, ensuring relationship health, tight alignment, and reliable execution. You will act as a cultural and operating bridge across organizations—translating goals, ways of working, and decision-making norms so teams move fast without losing clarity or trust.
You will run executive operating cadence, drive cross-functional problem solving, and lead partnership strategy and execution from opportunity assessment through governance and ongoing operations. This is a high-impact role for a builder who can combine judgment, structured thinking, and strong executive communication.
Responsibilities
Lead executive operating cadence by managing priorities and driving alignment across product, engineering, publishing/operations, growth, finance, legal, and trust & safety teams.
Serve as the primary interface for strategic external partners by maintaining relationship health, securing executive alignment, and ensuring daily operational effectiveness.
Translate organizational goals, decision-making norms, and working methods across teams to maintain speed, clarity, and trust.
Establish joint operating rhythms with partners, including forums, agendas, milestone reviews, decision logs, escalation paths, and issue resolution mechanisms.
Define partnership strategy by assessing build vs. partner decisions, mapping priority partner categories, and identifying key potential partners.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Corporate Development) to support deal structuring, negotiation, diligence coordination, and translating terms into operational plans with clear roles, rights, data handling, and SLAs.
Monitor market and competitive trends in Asia, including platform policy shifts and creator ecosystem developments, to inform roadmap, launch sequencing, and partnership priorities.
Identify and surface risks early (delivery, dependency, compliance, safety, reputational), drive mitigation strategies, and ensure clear decision-making and accountability.
Produce concise executive communications such as weekly readouts, pre-reads, and leadership-ready narratives that connect progress, risks, and decisions.
Required competencies and certifications
5+ years experience in Chief of Staff, partnerships/business development, corporate strategy/operations, or general management roles within consumer platforms (UGC, games, social, media, marketplaces).
Fluency in Mandarin and English to communicate collaboratively across multicultural and multinational teams.
High judgment and ownership in ambiguous environments, with ability to manage sensitive partner relationships and escalate issues decisively.
Proven success in structuring and operating strategic partnerships, including governance design, negotiation support, and translating terms into executable plans.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Trust & Safety.
Excellent executive communication skills, including concise writing, strong synthesis, and driving decision-making through clear narratives and data.

SMRT Trains Ltd was incorporated in 1987 and operates Singapore's first mass rapid transit system. Today, we manage and operate train services on the North-South Line, East-West Line, the Circle Line, the Thomson-East Coast Line, and the Bukit Panjang Light Rail Transit. The Executive Engineer leads multiple teams in performing preventive and corrective maintenance for various railway signaling systems and platform screen doors. He provides technical advice to team members, supervises complex maintenance issues pertaining to faulty analyses and testing of railway signaling systems, and re-prioritizes work activities to address maintenance requirements. Coordinate with various stakeholders and LTA to carry out site inspection, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), System Acceptance Test (SAT) and Handover Inspections (HOI)

Actively participate in workplace continuous improvement programs to streamline processes and minimize wastage
To lead and mentor a team of Assistant Engineers and Technical Officers to build a high performing and disciplined maintenance outfit

description:
We are looking for Managing Editor, Digital Lifestyle & News Brand, to lead the next chapter of an established digital lifestyle and news brand focused on Singapore. This role is suited for an experienced editorial leader with sharp news judgment, strong aesthetic instincts, and a deep understanding of what resonates with modern Singaporean audiences.
You will be responsible for shaping and evolving the brand’s editorial direction – redefining its voice, tone, and visual sensibility – while ensuring content remains timely, relevant, and scalable across platforms, from the website to social media and future content extensions. This role requires someone who can balance creativity with performance, translating editorial vision into measurable audience growth and engagement.
What You’ll Do
Define and own the overall editorial vision and direction of the brand, with a mandate to refresh and evolve it for today’s Singaporean audiences
Lead editorial planning and oversight across lifestyle, culture, news, and trend-driven content – ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency across all platforms
Identify emerging conversations, cultural moments, and trends in Singapore – translating them into compelling editorial stories
Drive creative and editorial strategies towards measurable outcomes – with key performance metrics being community growth, reach, and engagement
Manage and work closely with writers, designers, contributors, and social media specialists to execute content efficiently and cohesively
Guide the adaptation of long-form and web content into social-first formats for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and emerging channels
Use audience insights and analytics to refine content strategy, balancing editorial creativity with data-informed decision-making
Identify opportunities to expand the brand through new formats, platforms, and editorial products with a view towards monetization
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Digital Journalism, Digital Media/Communications, or a related field
8+ years of experience in digital media, lifestyle publishing, or news, including time in a senior editorial leadership role
A strong editorial instinct and clear creative vision for repositioning and growing a digital media brand
A keen understanding of Singapore’s cultural landscape and the conversations that resonate with local audiences
Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to uphold editorial standards, refine copy, and step in to write when necessary
Strong news judgment and the ability to operate in fast-paced digital publishing cycles, quickly identifying breaking stories or emerging trends and mobilising teams to produce timely content
Experience managing editorial output across websites and social platforms, with an eye for both written and visual storytelling
Familiarity with digital audience growth, content monetisation, and platform-driven media models
The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on leadership in a dynamic newsroom environment
Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
An appreciation of the national and institutional context in which the brand operates, and the ability to incorporate appropriate messaging where relevant within editorial content
Why This Role Matters
This is not a maintenance role.
You will be brought in to reimagine and reposition the brand – shaping its voice, visual identity, and editorial priorities to meet the expectations of a modern, digitally savvy audience.
If you are excited by the challenge of building cultural relevance, setting editorial standards, and leading a brand into its next phase of growth, we would love to hear from you.

description:
Product Development Director, APAC
About Us
At Aviva Investors, our expertise is in matching the right investment approach to each client’s unique needs. As the global asset management business of Aviva plc, we bring together our broad investment capabilities to deliver client-focused solutions worldwide. Managing £253 billion in assets, our 1,000‑strong team across nine countries is brilliantly connected, collaborative, and focused on delivering outcomes that truly matter.
Working together and acting responsibly are central to how we operate. We take time to understand what our clients want to achieve and design solutions that last - strengthening every portfolio with diverse perspectives and integrated thinking. Our long track record in sustainable investing reflects our commitment to doing the right thing for clients and communities alike.
Everyone at Aviva Investors plays a part in creating an exceptional client experience. With the scale and influence to make a real difference, we take our responsibility seriously. Join us and you’ll find an inclusive, supportive environment where your contribution is valued, high performance is recognised, and you’re empowered to shape your development.
To support our regional growth, we are recruiting a Product Director to lead the design and delivery of investment products across the APAC region. This role will be pivotal in expanding our regional product shelf, driving market‑led innovation, and ensuring our offering remains competitive, commercially scalable, and aligned to Aviva Investors’ global investment capabilities.
We are seeking a senior professional with strong, demonstrable APAC product knowledge across both public and private markets. Experience in the Japan investment market—including fund design, positioning, and navigating its regulatory environment—is essential.
A bit about the role:
Reporting into the Global Head of Product while working closely with the Head of APAC for Aviva Investors, you will lead all product‑related activity across APAC. Working closely with Global Product—particularly Product Strategy—you will help shape the 1–3 year product roadmap by market and client segment. Key responsibilities include:
Product Strategy & Development
Conduct opportunity assessments, competitor and market analysis, and define product positioning across APAC—with a particular focus on Japan’s investment landscape, investor preferences, and regulatory requirements.
Identify gaps in the current product offering and recommend solutions across equities, fixed income, multi‑asset, real assets, private credit, and alternatives.
Lead feasibility assessments for new products and changes to existing ranges, ensuring proposals meet a clear client need, align with investment capability and capacity, and are underpinned by robust commercial cases.
Product Delivery & Lifecycle
Oversee the successful launch of new funds and implementation of product changes across APAC.
Ensure strong risk management, operational readiness, and positive customer outcomes throughout the product lifecycle.
Maintain deep awareness of APAC regulatory standards—especially Japan‑specific structures (e.g., investment trusts), disclosure rules, and licensing requirements—to ensure all products remain compliant.
Leadership & Stakeholder Influence
Serve as a key member of the Product Leadership team, representing APAC product priorities and ensuring the region receives appropriate strategic focus and support.
Partner closely with the Head of APAC for Aviva Investors, regional Distribution teams, and global Investment teams to ensure the product suite is relevant, commercially strong, and effectively championed across the business.
Lead the efficient project management of fund launches, closures, mergers, restructures, and operational changes.
Skills and experience we’re looking for:
Strong regulatory and product delivery knowledge across APAC—especially Japan—including Australia, Singapore, Korea, Taiwan, and others.
Solid understanding of ESG product frameworks and sustainable‑investing requirements in APAC/Japan.
Product management experience across public markets (equities, fixed income, multi‑asset) and private markets (real assets, private credit, alternatives).
Experience delivering product changes, including fund launches, mergers, restructures, and wind‑downs/closures.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑border projects partnering with investment, distribution, legal, risk, operations, and marketing teams; qualifications like CFA/CAIA/IMC welcomed but not essential.
What you’ll get for this role:
Eligibility for annual performance bonus - dependent on your performance and Aviva Investors' performance
Generous holiday entitlement plus bank holidays with the option to buy/sell up to 5 additional days
Aviva Matching Share Plan and Save As You Earn scheme
21 volunteering hours per year
Aviva is for everyone:
We’re inclusive and welcome everyone – we want applications from all backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? Even if you don’t, we would still encourage you to apply. We also consider all forms of flexible working, including part time and job shares. Most of our people are smart working –spending around 50% of their time in our offices every week - combining the benefits of flexibility, with time together with colleagues. To find out more about working at Aviva take a look here.
We’d love it if you could submit your application online. Please ensure that you have attached an up to date CV and/or updated your professional profile on Workday as we cannot submit your application without this. If you require an alternative method of applying, send an email to
GlobalRecruitment@avivainvestors.com

title: Manager, Digital Innovation Studio
snippet: Join CHI's Digital Innovation Office and drive healthcare transformation through rapid prototyping and AI-enabled solutions.
description:
NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life
CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change
The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.
About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)
The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).
DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.
JOB SUMMARY
Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Office (DIO), the role will support DIO’s three key platforms by transforming real-world challenges from clinicians and healthcare operations into testable proofs of concept (POCs). The Engineer (DIS) will play a critical technical role in rapid prototyping, iterative development, and sandbox capability building to support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.
This role blends technical engineering, user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.
MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. User Engagement and Iterative Development
Conduct regular engagement sessions with clinicians and operational users to gather feedback and validate evolving prototypes.
Collaborate with UX lead and users to co‑curate, refine, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment between user needs, feasibility, and POC objectives.
Translate user feedback into actionable technical enhancements during rapid iteration cycles.
Support usability testing, demo preparation, and evidence collection for decision-making.
2. Sandbox Capability Development & Industry Matchmaking
Support the design and enhancement of DIS’ innovation sandbox, including tools, environments, APIs, data proxies, and integration patterns that future POCs can leverage.
Work with innovation partners to onboard new sandbox-ready solutions, focusing on future healthcare, AI/ML, agentic systems, and emerging digital tools.
Track ecosystem developments and recommend new capabilities to strengthen DIO’s experimentation and feasibility‑testing platforms.
3. Technical Prototyping & Engineering (Front-end, Back-end, AI/LLM Integration)
Train teams on technical tools and approach on building functional prototypes using suitable frameworks and low-code/no-code tools, compliant with NHG cybersecurity and governance requirements.
Design lightweight solution architectures including front-end interfaces, back-end services/APIs, workflow logic and data handling for standalone POC deployments or within NHG’s controlled environments.
Advise teams on integrating prototypes with internal machine learning models, clinical decision-support modules, or LLMs where appropriate.
Advise on robust technical documentation, diagrams, and handover artefacts for future scaling.
Provide hands-on development support where needed.
4. Administrative support
Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on engineering experience (full-stack, rapid prototyping, or solution engineering).
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience integrating AI/ML models, REST APIs, or LLMs into applications preferred.
Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
Knowledge in:
Front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue)
Back-end frameworks (Node.js, FastAPI, .NET Core)
Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL)
Desired Skills
Passion for innovation prototyping and exploring effective approaches to develop novel applications.
Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in healthcare settings.
Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
Passion for enabling future tech-stack and approaches for implementation

Job description
ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking a strategic and experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to oversee our project portfolio and drive delivery excellence. In this role, you will establish project governance, standardize methodologies, and ensure that all initiatives align with our overarching business goals. You will guide cross-functional teams through complex projects, driving efficiency and continuous improvement across the organization.
YOUR MISSIONS
Governance:
Establish clear rules, oversight frameworks, and expectations to ensure all project initiatives align with the company's business goals and compliance standards.
Standardization:
Develop and implement reusable templates, tools, and "best practice" methodologies (such as Agile, Waterfall, or PRINCE2) while maximizing Jira's capabilities for standardized workflow configuration and tracking.
Strategic Planning:
Assist leadership with portfolio management by evaluating and prioritizing enterprise projects based on expected ROI, business impact, and strategic alignment.
Performance Monitoring:
Track project health and portfolio performance through key performance indicators (KPIs), delivering clear, actionable progress reports to senior stakeholders via advanced Jira dashboards.
Resource Management:
Manage the allocation of human and financial resources across the portfolio to resolve dependencies, prevent bottlenecks, and optimize delivery across concurrent projects.
ABOUT YOU
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical fields.
6+ years of proven experience in project management, portfolio management, or PMO leadership roles.
Expert-level proficiency in Jira for workflow configuration, project tracking, issue management, and portfolio reporting.
Certifications: Active PMP, PRINCE2, or PgMP certification is highly desirable. Agile/Scrum certifications are a strong plus.
Exceptional leadership and conflict-resolution abilities, with a track record of driving change management and influencing senior stakeholders.
Strong communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
Industry Knowledge:
Background or domain expertise in the Insurance sector (Life, Health, or Property & Casualty). Familiarity with insurance operations, core systems transformations, or regulatory landscapes is a distinct advantage.
WHY AMARIS?
At Amaris Consulting, we believe in creating a thriving, positive workplace where every team member can grow, connect, and make a real impact. Here’s what you can expect when you join our dynamic community:
Global Diversity
: Be part of an international team of 110+ nationalities, celebrating diverse perspectives and collaboration.
Trust and Growth
: With 70% of our leaders starting at entry-level, we’re committed to nurturing talent and empowering you to reach new heights.

: Unlock your full potential with our internal Academy and over 250 training modules designed for your professional growth.

: Enjoy a workplace where energy, fun, and camaraderie come together through afterworks, networking events, and more.
Meaningful Impact:
Join us in making a difference through our CSR initiatives, including the WeCare Together program, and be part of something bigger.
Equal Opportunity
Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
Who are we?
Amaris Consulting
is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
Brief Call
: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
Interviews
(the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
Case study
: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.
As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company.  That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

Job Description
Join the dynamic BAE Systems Maritime Solutions (MS) Contracts team and be a part of a world class contracting team to support the United States Navy 7th Fleet, effecting continuous maintenance of Forward Deployed Naval Forces in the Western Pacific and Indian Oceans. This program sustains the Navy’s global presence and force protection within the 7th fleet’s AOR. Become a part of the calling by serving, supplying and protecting those that protect us!
This position will be a part of a small, specialized team managing a complex IDIQ contract and will report to the Director of Contracts. As BAE Systems’ Contract Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for managing and leading a diverse cross-functional team in support of Navy’s Lead Maintenance Activity (LMA) in the 7th fleet’s AOR. The candidate will need the aptitude to pay meticulous attention to detail, strategically plan, analyze program data, prepare and review proposals, negotiate, communicate effectively with team members, monitor program/subcontract performance, and manage program deliverables.
This position requires a self-motivated, committed individual able to operate in an active, dynamic environment. The Navy continuously supports missions across the AOR and will require periodic maintenance for emergent and operational issues. This position may require the candidate to be available, in conjunction with the Director of Contracts, 24 hours/7days, 365 days of the year in the event of emergent requirements.
Responsibilities/Duties
Implement disciplined change management strategies and tactics to effect proactive change orders.
Provide guidance to develop overarching negotiation strategies and objectives, and takes action necessary to resolve any impasses between BAE Systems and its customers.
Develop solutions to complex contracting and business issues, which require the regular use of ingenuity and innovation. Ensure solutions are consistent with organization strategic and operational objectives.
Provide expertise, guidance, training, and leadership to support cross-functional business team members. Lead discussions and/or briefings with various leadership and other key personnel, participate in complex negotiations, and develop contract management strategies to mitigate risk. Ensure efficient and effective flow of information among leadership team, cross-functional teams, and/or customer(s) as needed.
Provide direction to cross-functional team members to address and influence major contractual, compliance and business issues encountered in the proposal and execution of contracts of all types and complexity.
Train, motivate and assist cross-functional team members to practice effective scope control strategies to enable early identification of constructive changes that may provide BAE Systems opportunities for equitable adjustments.
Interface with key government contracting and procurement officials as required and/or needed.
Monitor program deliverables to ensure program cost and schedule projections are on target.
Maintain a safe work environment and ensure compliance with safety objectives and policies.
Undertake special assignments as required and perform others duties as assigned.
Required Education, Experience, & Skills
Bachelor Degree and 8 years relevant experience required
Proven business negotiator while exercising sound business judgement with experience engaging at high organizational levels or with persons of influence both internally and externally.
Highly developed critical thinking and communication skills with ability to influence and shape favorable business outcomes.
Proven experience in managing and prioritizing in change management
Excellent communication, presentation, team-building and leadership skills, with the ability to perform in a complex cross-functional business environment.
Excellent writing skills is a must, with the ability to write clear and concise reports, business correspondence, and policies/procedures.
Ability to effect and manage change (both organizational and contractual).
Fixed Price contract experience
Expert knowledge of FAR/DFAR regulations
Experience with complex contracts and proposal preparation and execution
Ability to interact professionally and effectively at all levels of the organization
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, solicitations/RFPs, or governmental regulations.
Meticulous import/export compliance IAW ITAR/EAR
Ability to analyze data to ensure compliance and on time delivery of deliverables
Strong business acumen and experienced in risk management.
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills
4 years Fixed Price Contract experience
Naval vessel maintenance contracting experience (NAVSEA Standard Items)
Certification as CFCM or CPCM (NCMA) or CCM (IACCM) desirable
Master’s Degree/MBA/JD a plus
Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $107952 - $183518
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.
About BAE Systems Platforms & Services
BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.
The Platforms & Services (P&S) sector under BAE Systems, Inc does the big stuff: the armored combat vehicles, naval guns, missile launchers, and ship repair…just to name a few. Our employees take pride in the work they do and why they do it. They are on the front lines every day, building our products to protect the lives of those who serve. We may be biased, but we think P&S does some of the coolest work around, and we think you will too.

description:
About Syfe
Syfe is APAC's largest and fastest-growing digital wealth platform, trusted with over US$10 billion in assets. We are fundamentally changing how hundreds of thousands of people across Asia-Pacific build wealth through a holistic approach to managing money rather than just pushing investment products. Backed by world-class investors and recognised as a leader in WealthTech, we are a team of passionate builders creating the future of wealth management.
The Right Profile
Product is a key growth and retention driver for our Brokerage business. As a Product Management Intern, you will work closely with the Brokerage Product team to support the development and optimization of trading features across equities, ETFs, and options. This role is highly analytical and execution-focused. You won’t just sit in meetings, you’ll work with real trading data, write SQL queries, contribute to PRDs, and help measure feature performance. You will gain hands-on exposure to how a modern fintech brokerage builds discovery tools, pricing models, trading workflows, and analytics dashboards. You’ll learn how product decisions are driven by user behavior, market trends, and business impact while developing practical skills in structured thinking, data analysis, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is ideal for someone who is curious about financial markets, enjoys solving problems with data, and wants to experience what it takes to ship real trading products in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct market and competitor research to identify customer needs and industry trends (equities, ETFs, options, brokerage features).
Assist in drafting Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and functional specifications.
Support product analytics by: Writing basic SQL queries to extract and analyze trading/user data. Using tools like Pendo to track feature adoption, user engagement, and funnel performance.
Assist in building dashboards and performance reports to evaluate feature impact.
Collaborate with design and engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
Participate in product reviews, UAT testing, and feedback sessions.
Prepare presentations and documentation for stakeholders.
Support ad-hoc product, analytics, and operational tasks as needed.
Minimum Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Basic SQL knowledge (SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, aggregations).
Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Pendo (or similar tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA).
Basic understanding of brokerage, stock markets, ETFs, or trading products (personal investing/trading experience is a plus).
Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Google Suite.
Basic understanding of UX/UI principles.
Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

description:
With a growing global subscriber base and a reputation for insightful analysis and opinion on every aspect of world events, The Economist is one of the most widely recognised and well-read current affairs publications and the foundation of our digital consumer product portfolio. We are developing a world-class product and design organisation and have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Designer to lead and manage the e-commerce and subscriptions design team.
The role
We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to lead and manage designers based in South East Asia and the UK across our e-commerce and subscriptions product area. The team consists of 3 designers - from Mid-weight to Senior level - working across registration, conversions, purchase flows, subscription management and help centre on app and web. You will partner with peers in engineering, product management and marketing to raise the bar of design, experience and product thinking in teams that are re-imagining and optimising crucial steps in our subscription funnel to drive new acquisitions and retain subscribers.
Your role will be to connect product and business strategy with the product teams across the e-commerce and subscriptions area. This will be through producing end-to-end impactful designs for strategically important initiatives as well as managing and motivating designers to deliver outstanding work. This role combines individual contributor and managerial responsibilities. A typical day may range from helping to plan the approach, methods and workload of your team; pushing design craft by leading initiatives or pairing with designers on impactful projects—coaching through the work; to building trusted cross functional relationships and providing developmental support to your reports.
You’ll be able to demonstrate experience designing for subscription business models across app and web, running workshops, working from discovery through to delivery and driving high quality design work within teams.
You’ll be supported by a friendly and inclusive design team who have the autonomy to define and improve processes and care deeply about developing each other's capabilities. As a senior member of the team you will work closely with other design leads and the VP of Product Design to grow the team, shape our practices and foster our culture.
Responsibilities
Work with key partners across the business (from product, engineering, editorial, marketing and data) to achieve shared goals.
Champion research across teams; planning, managing and running user research alongside your team to understand user behaviour and identify needs.
Build a vision for your product area, be an important part of roadmap planning and help to set the strategy for how your designers deliver it.
Be the design representative for strategically key initiatives—holding the bar for The Economist brand digitally—ensuring that quality experiences get into the hands of subscribers.
Create artefacts like sketches, user flows or interactive prototypes to test assumptions and ideas. You will create production ready design assets and work with engineers to ensure a high quality experience is shipped.
Facilitate workshops and/or design sprints that bring stakeholders and others along the product development journey.
Communicate progress and product rationale to key partners including the C-suite, by designing and delivering presentations; or through dialogue on an ad-hoc basis.
Grow and mentor your reports - helping to shape their career paths and raise the bar of design, experience and product thinking.
Contribute and evolve the design culture within the design team.
Who you are
You have a strong portfolio that demonstrates your most significant team and personal accomplishments. It will highlight your design process and core craft skills including interaction and visual design across a breadth of platforms and project types.
Experience leading teams to deliver many launched products by working collaboratively with product managers, engineers, stakeholders and users in an agile way.
You can move between focusing on the minute details of a project to the overarching strategic vision, communicating and reacting to required trade-offs and helping your team plan accordingly.
An understanding of technologies used to build world-class digital product experiences. You have experience in agile working and sprints, will be hands-on with user-acceptance testing (UAT) and have a familiarity with the fundamentals of accessibility and usability.
Experience in responsive design across multiple screen sizes and devices; with a well-trained eye for design quality, usability and consistency.
Experience with prototyping and design tools like Miro, Figma or Protopie and can prioritise choosing the right tool at the right time. Experience in AI enabled prototyping tools would be a plus.
Experience working with subscription business models.
Experience in managing and leading a small team of product designers.
You have great communication skills and fluency in English.
If you think you are qualified for this role but don’t necessarily tick every box, please submit an application. The ‘perfect candidate’ doesn’t exist.

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Define data center system-level, product architecture, and Research and Development, while helping to develop operations and maintenance procedures for systems/processes.
Localize system-level architectures for new Data Center designs, products and ensure designs and installations meet requirements (e.g., predicted cooling, structural, operational concerns, etc.).
Report and synthesize on regional constraints, requirements, and best practices in Data Center design and constructability.
Coordinate between local engineering execution teams, construction and site acquisition partner teams, and central (U.S.. based) R&D Engineering leads.
Lead a team of individuals, set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance, development, and provide feedback and coaching.

description:
AI Product Manager
Why this role exists
The AI Center needs a single accountable leader for portfolio strategy and industrialisation-turning experiments into adopted products with controlled run-costs, clear governance, and decision-grade evidence. This role operationalises a "single-door" direction: close the door on ad-hoc tools and drive consistent, scalable AI product delivery through a governed factory model.
Portfolio scope
A) AI use-cases moving through Innovation Board gates
Recipe.AI, Chef.AI, Portfolio.AI, Marketing Translation.
B) AI Center enablement services and assets
Innovation Board operating rhythm and gate criteria
AI Lab Principles/Playbook (PoC vs pilot vs MVP vs BAU)
AI Toolkit + Sandbox adoption (standard experimentation route)
Ethics enablement
FinOps/showback, cost governance, run-cost strategy
Outcomes you will be measured on
A) Roadmap, investment logic, and value clarity
12-18 month portfolio roadmap with sequencing, dependencies, business cases (ROI + adoption assumptions), and operating model per product.
Clear prioritisation logic based on value, feasibility, risk, and run-cost.
B) Innovation Board runs as a product factory
Board has a clear charter, RACI, cadence, scorecard (funnel volume, pass/fail rates, cycle time), and decision templates.
Every gate decision is supported by decision-quality artifacts: data readiness, evaluation plan/benchmarks, security posture, cost forecast, adoption plan.
C) Service catalog clarity (standardisation at scale)
AI Lab services defined with SLAs, required artifacts, and volume forecasts (Sandbox, MLOps, Ethics, FinOps, AI CoE patterns).
"Default route" for experimentation is the Toolkit/Sandbox-exceptions are explicit and time-boxed.
D) Value realisation discipline (BAU products)
Quarterly value reviews for BAU products (Portfolio.AI, Marketing Translation) with funded optimisation backlog and measurable KPI movement.
E) Governance scaled (risk, ethics, and delivery discipline)
Clear, enforceable principles distinguishing PoC vs pilot vs MVP vs GA; "done means" standards include wired release readiness, telemetry, and operational handover.
Joint-success principles with vendors and business sponsors are explicit and measurable.
F) FinOps and run-cost control
Cross-charging model maintained; GPU/compute strategy options presented early (trade-offs among performance, cost, and reliability).
No "silent run-cost blowups": predictable budgets and proactive mitigations.
G) Singapore government co-funding success
Maintain the co-funding deliverable map (milestones, KPI targets, eligible cost tracking).
Produce structured quarterly reporting, demo days, and audit-ready evidence packs.
Manage expectations and stakeholder engagement with government counterparts and ecosystem partners.
What you do
1) Portfolio strategy and prioritisation
Define product strategy per initiative: problem statement, target users, adoption plan, KPIs, operating model.
Run prioritisation with Sonal/Dan; explicitly manage trade-offs among value, feasibility, risk, time-to-market, and run-cost.
2) Governance and operating model
Own Innovation Board mechanics: gate criteria, templates, decision logs, scorecards, and escalation paths.
Define and enforce portfolio "definition-of-done" standards (including data/model contracts, security controls, observability, BAU handover).
Ensure the Toolkit/Sandbox is not optional "nice-to-have," but the standard platform path.
3) Stakeholder leadership (business + architecture + security)
Drive alignment and sign-offs with CDAO LT and Enterprise Architecture; ensure solution strategy is board-endorsed and operationally viable.
Own narrative and executive-ready decision packs: trade-offs, cost, risk, adoption constraints, and recommended decision.
4) Vendor and partner shaping (without doing procurement's job)
Translate roadmap into outcome-based requirements and success metrics that can be contracted.
Ensure vendor delivery aligns with "industrialisation" expectations (security-by-design, documentation, monitoring, handover, cost controls).
Define joint success measures and governance cadence with partners.
5) Adoption, ethics, and community flywheel
Drive enterprise enablement motions that materially affect adoption: ethics hub, Copilot/GenAI usage guidance, community ideation intake, playbooks for responsible AI rollout.
Ensure adoption is measurable (telemetry + feedback loops) and drives roadmap decisions.

We seek entrepreneurial AI Delivery Leads to drive AI consulting and solutions across APAC. This senior role will develop, deliver, and scale Tomoro’s generative AI offerings to create transformative value for clients.
You will build partnerships, expand regionally, and mentor a diverse AI team, fostering innovation and collaboration.
If you’re passionate about leading enterprises on their AI journey, creating impactful solutions, and building talented teams, we’d love to hear from you!
AI Delivery Leads collaborate with small Tomoro andclient teams to design, build, and deploy AI applications.
They tackle complex design challenges, ensure seamless transitions to deployment, and bridge technical and non technical stakeholders.
The role includes leading delivery, mentoring, and staying updated on AI advancements, ensuring our solutions are reliable, ethical, and rigorously tested.
Business Application Design
Co-creating cutting-edge applied AI business solutions with clients and colleagues that will realise meaningful value with a feasible route to reality.
Solution Design
Supporting and prototyping AI solutions and building engineering teams who can realise designs at scale – you know the best designs are working prototypes and want to use these as a basis for an engineering team.
Delivery Problem-Solving
Solving complex delivery problems that arise during the development and scaling of AI solutions. You’ll help connect the dots to realise route to live for our clients and be the primary translator between engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Providing delivery guidance and leadership within the team, including mentoring junior colleagues and contributing to skill development.
Continuous Learning and Adaptation
Staying updated with the latest developments in AI, machine learning, and related technologies to continually enhance the quality of solutions offered.
Senior Client Relationships
Building robust, trusted relationships with senior business and technical clients. We aren’t a company of body-shop engineers – we constructively challenge our clients to help them become AI leaders in their field.

Upholding and actively contributing to ethical standards in AI development, including considerations for data privacy, bias minimization, and regulatory compliance. Helping to expand our knowledge on this subject and driving ethical ways to implement AI.

You may work across multiple accounts or projects simultaneously, amplifying your impact through effective team leadership. Your ability to juggle various responsibilities will be key to the success of our projects.

Assisting clients in understanding and effectively using AI solutions, and providing ongoing support and maintenance as needed.
Responsibilities
Strong hands-on experience of developing production-grade solutions involving:
Building Microservices (including scalable data pipelines using frameworks like Spark)
Data technologies (Python, SQL)
Large language models, fine-tuning (closed & open source, OpenAI API)
Solution design (mainly data applications using Python, SQL, and other allied tech stack)
Analytical problem solving
We are not restricted to the technologies we use to solve client challenges and are looking for people who are able to adapt to a new stack when needed.
Comfortable being client-facing
Our business is helping other businesses transform with AI. We cannot do that by looking inwards. Our Technical team is not behind the scenes; it is very much the front of the house. Communication & translation:
Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with clients, understand their needs, and explain complex AI concepts in an accessible manner.
Business acumen:
Understanding of business processes and how AI solutions can be used to improve efficiency, reduce costs, or create new opportunities.
Adaptable and self-sufficient
As a growing, fast-paced organisation, Tomoro offers significant opportunities for rapid growth for everyone in the team. In this stage of the business, we have limited capacity for handholding and need each team member to be able to operate independently and be flexible to work outside of their comfort zone.
Passionate and positive
Tomoro exists because we believe we can drive transformative change with AI across entire industries. Everyone in the team needs to share the passion for AI technology and its power for good.
Creative and curious
Staying at the forefront of the AI revolution requires everyone in the team to be aware of the latest developments in AI technology and innovating to find new ways to solve some of the hardest unsolved challenges in the industry. Pro-active self-learning and openness to new ideas are essential.
Ethical and responsible
Our people are our greatest defense against the risks AI solutions can pose to individuals, organisations, and society. Everyone in our team needs to show awareness of ethical considerations in AI, such as data privacy, bias in AI models, and the societal impact of AI technologies.

Pension

snippet: The Process Engineer provides sustaining engineering support for manufacturing sites for parts cleaning, texturing and coatings, for driving...
description:
Job Summary:
The Process Engineer provides sustaining engineering support for manufacturing sites for parts cleaning, texturing and coatings, for driving Perfect Part Qualification and for driving new business acquisition. Leads efforts in constantly improving yields, customer quality, selection of best known processes. Continually develops the skills necessary for sustaining "world class" parts clean engineering services.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Maintains conformance with the “Perfect Qual Process” to achieve timely, effective development of new and existing business opportunities.
Manages tasks for timely response to customer issues, including failure analysis, CAPA, Engineering Task force CIP and other mission critical issues.
Maintains and improves yields; performs root cause failure analysis, provides rapid hands on response to line problems in support of high-volume part clean factory.
Develops and maintains inventory records, drawings, etc. in support of production workload.
Develops/maintains/evaluates production tooling (fixtures, baskets, etc.) required for efficient, effective part processing.
Participates in selection efforts for equipment replacement and specification efforts as required.
Ensures compliance with existing operating procedures; recommends revisions as appropriate.
Monitors effectiveness of production processes, supports problem resolution efforts for technical evaluation of parts being processed.
Monitors compliance with material specification database for process materials (chemistry, gases, blast media, etc.).
Monitors and ensures maintenance of process controls (pressures, temperatures, concentration, contamination, etc.) through SPC.
Ensures process measurements and overall process CPK's fall within control and divisional limits.
Ensures work environments meet safety and housekeeping standards for tasks being performed.
Assists in development and implementation of training materials, examinations for staff training and certifications.
Participates in customer audits, complaint resolution, costs analysis, time studies for sales/marketing.
Participates in internal & external audits, CAPA resolution, defect/problem analysis, preventive action activities, etc.
Fully participates on committees (technical, safety, environmental, etc.), as assigned
Conducts monthly site qualification cleanliness testing for compliance with specifications
Liaises with Engineering Managers and/or Core Engineering Group to ensure effective procedures and BKMs are implemented at assigned sites.
Other Duties
Participates in projects as assigned to improve systems, operations & cross-functional collaboration. Other duties may be assigned and at the discretion of the Immediate Supervisor.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
Leadership and interpersonal communication skills; familiarity with wet chemistry processing, semiconductor tool consumables, semiconductor technology, critical cleaning technology, semiconductor processing, coating technologies, and CAD implementation.
High level troubleshooting skills coupled with hands-on approach to solving problems. Familiarity with "Six Sigma", "Lean Manufacturing" concepts and other process improvement methods and approaches. Effective verbal & written communication skills as well as satisfactory interpersonal skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with individuals at all levels, both within and outside the organization.
Able to successfully prioritize and manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. Demonstrable understanding of production, engineering & quality initiatives and with safety & quality practices.
Proficiency in the use Excel, PowerPoint and other systems/software to perform job duties satisfactorily.
Able to complete assignments in a timely manner while adhering to deadlines and with sense of urgency.
Educational/Certification Requirement
:
A bachelor's degree in chemical, mechanical engineering, electrical/electronic engineering, or material sciences
Work Experience Requirements:
Three (3) years working as a Process Engineer, and/or Quality Engineer is preferred
Experience in quality and manufacturing systems, business process improvement tools, and problem solving.
Experience with the ISO 9001 standard is required.
Experience managing critical customer communications.
Experience with Lean, 6S, zero defect manufacturing processes, inspection methods and tools.
Work Environment:
This job is usually performed in a professional office environment, routinely using standard office equipment such as computers, telephones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and other related equipment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment and manufacturing areas can occasionally be moderate or loud.
Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to sit; climb stairs, maintain balance; employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust optical focus.
Note:
This job description may not represent a complete list of job duties or responsibilities. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be added at any time and without notice.

The industry is moving away from centralized "clouds" toward Edge Computing. You’ll learn how to deploy applications to 300+ cities globally in milliseconds.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

title: Principal Supplier Quality Engineer
snippet: Lead supplier quality strategy. Competitive salary, training & development. Work-life balance in modern facility.
description:
Bring more to life.
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
Shape the Future with Us!
At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions.  With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.
Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
The Principal Supplier Quality Engineer ensures the quality and reliability of supplied components through strategic supplier collaboration and risk-based oversight. This role drives supplier performance improvement, resolves complex quality issues, and ensures compliance with internal, customer, and regulatory standards. Key responsibilities include managing FAI and MRB processes, leveraging data for defect prevention and continuous improvement, and serving as a technical leader, audit representative, and mentor to ensure supplied materials consistently meet organizational and customer expectations.
This position reports to the Senior Manager, Supplier Quality and is part of the Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance department located in Singapore and will be an on-site role.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to:
Supplier Qualification and Lifecycle Oversight
Qualify and approve direct and indirect suppliers of critical components/special processes to ensure consistent, compliant output. Maintain supplier status through rigorous quality system assessments, performance monitoring, and targeted corrective actions. Evaluate and approve supplier-initiated changes to safeguard conformance with specifications, customer expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. Conduct risk-based routine audits to verify adherence to contractual, customer, and regulatory requirements—driving sustained quality and reliability across the supply base.
Supplier Issue Resolution and Continuous Improvement
Lead on-site containment and resolution of complex nonconformances and escapes, applying structured problem-solving (e.g., RCA/5-Why/Fishbone) and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions. Exercise sound judgment using multiple data sources, operating with high independence and accountability. Facilitate cross-functional teams (Quality, Operations, Engineering, Procurement) to remove root causes and drive measurable improvements in defect rate, rework, and OTD impact.
​
FAI/MRB Leadership, Audit Representation & Quality Reporting
Lead and govern the First Article Inspection (FAI) and Material Review Board (MRB) processes, ensuring timely execution, compliance, and effective disposition of nonconforming material. Represent the team during external and third-party audits or inspections, addressing inquiries related to supplier management, FAI, and MRB. Establish and standardize inspection methods, procedures, gauges, and measurement systems (e.g., MSA/GR&R) with suppliers. Provide clear reporting on supplier performance, quality trends, and systemic risks to management.
​
Leadership and Technical Guidance
Representing Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) in cross‑functional forums, aligning initiatives with organisational goals, and mentoring SQEs on quality practice, technical problem‑solving, and accountability. Govern critical quality activities, including engineering change impact/risk assessment, control plan reviews, customer complaint reviews, CAPA effectiveness, and inventory containment/traceability; ensure timely communication to suppliers and durable, long‑term effectiveness of actions.
​
Operational Excellence and Compliance
Stay current with DBS tools such as 5S, DMP, SW, and TPI to promote sustainable continuous improvement. Ensure departmental compliance with the Quality Management System and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements, and address EHS concerns raised by associates.
The essential requirements of the job include:
Degree in relevant Engineering discipline with 7 years of relevant working experience or Diploma in relevant Engineering discipline with 10 years of relevant working experience.
Experience in supplier quality engineering within an assembly operations or engineering environment.
Strong knowledge in various statistical control method and in QMS 9001.
Familiar with ISO13485, USFDA QSR/cGMP (21 CFR Part 820) and ISO14971 for medical devices.
Good understanding of metrology, Inspection Methods, Equipment and engineering drawings. Knowledge of measurement techniques.

title: Digital Experience Designer
snippet: Be responsible for the end-to-end digital experience on the prettyFIT website — ensuring every page is visually cohesive, intuitively navigable.
description:
ABOUT PRETTYFIT
prettyFIT is a contemporary women’s fashion footwear brand dedicated to empowering women through stylish, trend-forward shoe collections. Our digital presence is at the heart of how we connect with our customers — and we are looking for a creative, commercially minded Digital Experience Designer to help us deliver a world-class online shopping experience.
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Digital Experience Designer is a pivotal role at the intersection of design, technology, and commerce. You will be responsible for the end-to-end digital experience on the prettyFIT website — ensuring every page is visually cohesive, intuitively navigable, and optimized to convert browsers into buyers. Working closely with the Marketing, Merchandising, and Digital teams, you will champion the customer at every stage of their online journey, across both desktop and mobile platforms.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1.  Website Design & Visual Cohesion
•      Manage and maintain a cohesive, brand-aligned visual design language across all website pages — homepage, category pages, product detail pages, campaign landing pages, and promotional hubs.
•      Develop and manage a consistent design system including typography, color palette, spacing, iconography, and component libraries to ensure uniformity across all digital touchpoints.
•      Translate seasonal campaigns and brand direction into compelling, on-brand digital experiences that reflect the prettyFIT aesthetic.
•      Collaborate with the Marketing team to deliver timely creative assets for new arrivals, sales events, festive campaigns, and brand initiatives.
2.  UX/UI — Desktop & Mobile Experience
•      Continuously refine intuitive user interfaces for both desktop and mobile platforms, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience across all screen sizes.
•      Map and optimise the full customer journey — from homepage discovery through to product browsing, cart, checkout, and post-purchase — identifying and resolving friction points at every stage.
•      Ensure full mobile responsiveness and a best-in-class mobile-first design approach, reflective of high mobile commerce adoption.
3.  Web Content Management
•      Manage day-to-day content updates on the e-commerce CMS (e.g. Shopify), including uploading new product imagery, updating banners, refreshing promotional content, and maintaining landing pages.
•      Oversee the timely rotation of website graphics and promotional assets in line with the marketing calendar — sales, launches, seasonal events, and collaborations.
•      Liaise with external photographers and creative suppliers to ensure product imagery and visual content consistently meet website specifications and brand standards.
4.  Conversion Optimisation
•      Take ownership of conversion rate optimisation (CRO) across the website — analysing performance data, identifying drop-off points, and implementing design-led solutions to improve key metrics.
•      Monitor and interpret website analytics (Google Analytics or equivalent) and translate data insights into actionable design and content enhancements.
•      Work collaboratively with the Digital Marketing team to align landing page experiences with paid media, SEO, email, and social campaigns — ensuring message-to-experience consistency.
•      Track and report on key performance indicators including conversion rate, bounce rate, average session duration, and add-to-cart rate, presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders regularly.
REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS
Essential
•      Diploma or Degree in UX/UI Design, Interaction Design, Digital Media, or a related discipline.
•      Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in UX/UI or digital experience design, ideally within an e-commerce or retail environment.
•      Good working knowledge of Adobe tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), visual asset creation and UI production.
•      Demonstrated experience working with an e-commerce CMS platform, with Shopify experience strongly preferred.
•      Solid understanding of responsive and mobile-first design principles.
•      A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end UX/UI projects with measurable outcomes, preferably in fashion, lifestyle, or retail.
•      Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for minor front-end edits and developer handoff.

As a Senior Solutions Architect in GitLab’s global Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, you’ll be the trusted technical advisor and pre-sales partner who helps customers unlock the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will solve complex challenges across the software lifecycle by connecting GitLab, AI agents, security, and cloud-native capabilities to real business outcomes, guiding customers through digital transformation and modern software delivery. Reporting into the Senior Director and acting as the AI subject matter expert on a team of specialists, you’ll own technical strategy for strategic accounts, lead value stream and Proof of Value (PoV) engagements, and serve as the technical “CTO” for your accounts. In your first year, you’ll be focused on driving successful platform evaluations and adoption as part of the pre-sales process, shaping AI-led solution architectures, influencing product direction with field feedback, and creating reusable assets and providing thought leadership for raising GitLab’s technical bar globally.
What you’ll do
You will be operating as an AI SME with a focus on Platforms
Lead technical discovery, architecture design, demos, and end-to-end evaluations (POC/POV) to validate GitLab as the preferred agentic, AI-powered DevSecOps platform for prospects and customers.
Drive AI-focused solution strategy as the team’s AI subject matter expert, including competitive positioning and business value justifications.
Own the technical strategy and influence Customer Success Plans for assigned accounts, acting as the “technical CTO” to guide multi-team, multi-year transformation initiatives across the DevSecOps lifecycle.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to shape account strategies, inform territory planning, and ensure successful platform adoption.
Provide advanced technical guidance during the pre-sales cycle, including tender and audit support, workshop design, and solving complex integration and implementation challenges.
Serve as the voice of the customer by translating real-world feedback into product requirements, documentation improvements, and roadmap input, especially for AI, security, and platform capabilities.
Create and share reusable technical assets such as reference architectures, working examples, best practice guides, and internal enablement content to scale impact across regions.
Mentor other Solutions Architects, contribute to global initiatives for the Center of Excellence, and act as an external industry authority through thought leadership, standards participation, and ecosystem relationships.
What you’ll bring
Expert resonance for the most strategic aspects of GitLab’s product and customer personas while empowering the field with domain knowledge.
Deep hands-on expertise with AI, such as designing or implementing AI-powered solutions, advising on AI adoption, or acting as an AI subject matter expert for customers or internal teams.
Experience in technical pre-sales, software consulting, or similar roles where you connect complex technology to business outcomes.

About the team
This role sits within GitLab’s global Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, our distributed team of subject matter experts focused on AI, application security, and monetization.
