Profile
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.
Sephora SEA’s omni channel business spans over 8 countries (Australia, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, and the Philippines) with 100+ stores and boasts some global flagships such as ION and Raffles City in Singapore, F88 in Kuala Lumpur and Pitt Street in Sydney. Sephora SEA is experiencing rapid growth in the region with new store openings and business channels (i.e., Click and collect and marketplace).
The Opportunity
Sephora Asia is looking for a strategic and data-driven Product Manager to own the top-of-funnel discovery experience across our web and app platforms. In this role, you will shape how millions of beauty shoppers first encounter and explore Sephora's catalogue — from the moment they land on the homepage to the instant they find exactly what they're looking for.
You will sit at the intersection of content management, search, personalisation, and experimentation — working closely with Digital, Data, UI/UX and Engineering teams to optimise discovery touchpoints and convert browsing intent into meaningful engagement.
What You'll Do
Top Funnel Strategy & Metrics
Own and drive top-of-funnel KPIs across Sephora's web and app platforms, including sessions, engagement rate, search conversion, and funnel drop-off metrics.
Define and maintain a product roadmap for discovery surfaces — homepage, category listing pages, brand listing pages, campaign landing pages, and search results.
Partner with Analytics and Data teams to develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that surface actionable insights on discovery performance.
CMS & Content Optimisation
Manage and optimise content delivery through our CMS (Contentful), ensuring homepage banners, editorial placements, and listing page content are timely, relevant, and personalised.
Collaborate with Creative, MarTech, and Campaign teams to define content strategies and structured content models that support scalable merchandising.
Define governance processes and tooling best practices for non-technical stakeholders operating within the CMS.
Search Strategy
Own the on-site search product — including search ranking, relevance tuning, null-search handling, search suggestions, and search-driven navigation.
Work with Engineering and Data teams to evaluate and improve search algorithms, leveraging behavioural signals to boost conversion.
Identify and address gaps between user search intent and product catalogue coverage.
Experimentation & Analysis
Lead a continuous A/B and multivariate testing programme across discovery surfaces — hypothesis design, test setup, monitoring, and read-out.
Translate test results into clear product decisions and communicate learnings to stakeholders across the business.
Build a culture of evidence-based iteration within the team.
What We're Looking For
Experience
5-7 years of product management experience, with a strong focus on consumer-facing e-commerce or marketplace platforms.
Proven track record of owning top-of-funnel or discovery product areas (homepage, search, browse, recommendation surfaces).
Hands-on experience with a headless CMS platform — Contentful experience strongly preferred.
Solid understanding of on-site search technologies and personalisation engines.
Experience designing and analysing A/B tests with statistical rigour.
Skills & Mindset
Metrics-first mindset — you define success in numbers and work backwards from outcomes.
Strong analytical skills; comfortable with tools such as Contentsquare, Google Analytics, PowerBI, or similar.
Excellent stakeholder communication — able to align Marketing, Engineering, Data, and CRM around a shared roadmap.
Comfortable operating in an agile environment with cross-functional squads.
AI fluency — comfortable using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) in day-to-day work, and able to identify where AI-powered features (personalisation, semantic search, generative content) can enhance the discovery experience.
Passion for beauty, retail, or consumer products is a plus.
Here, you will find:
Community
, in which authenticity is embraced, and the strength of our differences fuels our collective spirit.
Culture of empowerment
, learning & growth, that offers you the tools, space and opportunity to learn, innovate and lead.
Work that brings fulfilment
, from delighting clients every day, to inspiring our industry at large, every action makes a difference.
It is in the Sephora DNA to champion a world of inspiration and inclusion where everyone can celebrate their beauty. You can be yourself, because you are what sets us apart.
Join us and belong to something beautiful
.

title: Intern, Financial Markets (FM) Product Controller
snippet: We offer different internship opportunities in different departments and locations of our Wholesale bank. This vacancy focuses on positions within...
description:
Why ING?
The world of banking is changing faster than ever. That’s why we at ING are always broadening our horizons. Our people have a forward-thinking mentality, a strong can-do spirit and enjoy working in an agile environment.
ING in Asia Pacific
In Asia Pacific, ING offers wholesale banking across 11 markets, namely Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, and Vietnam.
ING offers both retail and wholesale banking services in Australia. ING’s regional presence includes a 13% stake in Bank of Beijing, China and a 30% stake in TMBThanachart Bank in Thailand.
Singapore is the regional headquarters for ING's Wholesale Banking (WB) business in Asia, which includes all WB business lines such as Financial Markets, Strategic Products, Sectors, Lending and Transaction Services and other support functions.
Function Overview
We offer different internship opportunities in different departments and locations of our Wholesale bank. This vacancy focuses on positions within the Financial Markets (FM) And Group Treasury (GT) Product Control function.
Product control is critical to safeguarding financial integrity and regulatory compliance, managing operational risks, and enabling informed decision making across trading activities. Under Product Control, the team ensures that the valuation of financial instruments, balance sheet, and profit and loss of trading and banking books within Financial Markets are measured, controlled and reported in accordance to IFRS accounting and regulatory standards.
Duties and responsibilities
Singapore is the regional hub for ING, including for product control activities. There are a number of different Financial Markets and Group Treasury desks controlled/supported by Product Control including Rates, Money Markets, Credit, FX, Commodities, Structured products, Non-linear derivatives, etc.
The internship would cover:
• Daily P&L reporting and risk-based P&L analysis in terms of market risk factors
• Working on ad hoc ongoing projects related to product and valuation control
• Assisting the team lead in specific valuation and P&L analysis as and when required
There would be exposure to policies and procedures governing this desk, which in turn are based on a number of items including SOX, key control testing, audit, IFRS accounting standards, regulations, bank’s risk management philosophy, current economic climate, etc.
What do we ask of you? (Skills & Specifications)
Major in Finance/Accounting and/or Quantitative Finance streams (is a plus)
Good written and oral communication skills
Should have sufficient knowledge of MS Excel
VBA / coding knowledge is a plus
Good time management and adaptability
Collaborative and be pro-active
What would you gain from this internship?
Exposures to various Financial Market and Group Treasury businesses which includes their respective P&L attribution, product control and valuation management framework within the bank.
Need more information?
For information on ING Wholesale Bank, visit https://www.ingwb.com/
For information on careers, visit https://www.ing.jobs/Global/Careers.htm
This is a six month full time Internship position starting from July 2026.

description:
Get to Know the Team
At Grab Financial Group (GFin), we're building the future of payments in Southeast Asia. As Principal Engineer for Payments, you will lead the end-to-end engineering organization powering all payment experiences across the Grab ecosystem – from in-app wallet transactions and online checkouts, to in-store POS payments and acquiring services for merchants.
Get to Know the Role
As a Principal Engineer for Payments at Grab, you will be the technical driver behind the architecture and delivery of regional-scale payments platforms that power our consumer, driver, merchant, and enterprise ecosystems across Southeast Asia. You will design and ship fault-tolerant, compliant, and cost-efficient services that process high volumes of transactions across multiple countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulatory regimes.
You will partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and country teams to build platform capabilities spanning authorization, capture, settlement, reconciliation, disbursements/payouts, refunds and disputes, as well as wallets and real-time bank transfers. You will set the technical vision, lead complex multi-quarter initiatives, and raise engineering quality across the organization through design leadership, hands-on implementation, and mentorship.
You will report to the Head of Engineering, Payments.
Worktype: 5-day onsite at Grab One-North office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Own design and delivery of mission-critical payment systems with high availability, low latency, and strict correctness.
Define core payments architecture and drive platformization with clear domains, stable APIs, event contracts, data models, and versioning.
Build resilient integrations to card networks, banks, APMs, and real-time rails that tolerate changes and outages.
Champion reliability, observability, security, compliance, scalability, operability, and cost with SRE and Security, and lead chaos tests, DR, and incidents.
Lead regionalization across currency, localization, regulation, and scheme needs with safe rollouts and migrations.
Make pragmatic, data-driven decisions that balance impact, speed, and maintainability, and align stakeholders on trade-offs.
Author and review design docs/RFCs, lead architecture reviews, set coding/testing standards, and elevate service.
Lead by example with prototypes and critical-path builds, mentor senior and staff engineers, and scale best practices and culture.

KRAASH, a streetwear start-up label based in Singapore.

description:
About Us
: We are a regional powerhouse and a trusted, household name in the travel industry with over 60 years of heritage. Known for our award-winning service, comprehensive tour packages, and deep commitment to customer satisfaction, we have spent decades perfecting the art of travel. Now, we are embarking on our next major evolution: future proofing the way we create and deliver value with Artificial Intelligence.
About the Role
: We are looking for a dedicated AI Systems Specialist to help lead our transition into an AI-enabled organization. You will be the technical bridge between our frontline travel consultants, our operational teams, and our external AI development vendors. You will own the lifecycle of our internal workflow automations—from understanding the daily friction points of our staff, to co-developing an AI roadmap, to overseeing the development and technical integration of AI applications with our custom travel databases and messaging platforms. This is a long-term career opportunity. Your goal is to deeply understand our business, absorb the technical architecture from our vendors, and eventually become one of the foundational pioneers of our in-house AI Centre of Excellence.
The Journey & Performance Milestones:
Phase 1: Discovery & The AI Roadmap (Months 1–3 - Probationary Period)
Sit with our internal stakeholders to map out complex booking workflows and identify high-ROI operational bottlenecks.
Work directly with our external tech vendor to translate these business problems into a concrete, phased 12-month "AI & Automation Roadmap."
* Note: Successful delivery and vendor alignment on this roadmap is the key KPI for probation confirmation.
Phase 2: The Proof of Concept (Months 3–6)
Act as the technical lead during our first major tech rollouts
Review the vendor’s API architecture. Test the endpoints, workflow logic, and prompt engineering yourself to ensure the AI's responses meet our high standards before live deployment.
Phase 3: Scale & Internalization (Months 6+)
Roll out the roadmap project-by-project across different business units.
Absorb the technical knowledge from the vendor. Take ownership of workflow maintenance, write custom scripts as needed, and anchor our newly formed AI Centre of Excellence.
Requirements:
Qualifications, Skills & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
1 to 3 years of experience in technical operations, systems integration, or IT business analysis. (Highly driven fresh graduates with relevant internship/project experience will be strongly considered). Experience managing external technical vendors is a strong plus.
Hard Skills
Data & Scripting
: Proficiency in SQL to query complex databases and analyze customer behaviors, and Python to write lightweight middleware scripts, process data, and connect APIs.

Practical, hands-on understanding of how modern web platforms communicate (REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON).
Workflow Automation
: Familiarity with the logic behind middleware and visual workflow automation tools.

Test Automation Framework Development: Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks specifically tailored for ServiceNow platform testing, with particular focus on Public Sector Digital Services (PSDS) capabilities and CSM module functionality. Develop automated test suites using Playwright and other modern testing tools to cover end-to-end customer service workflows, API integrations, and App Engine custom applications.

and analyse performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities.

Create detailed test plans covering functional, integration, performance, and security testing aspects. Establish testing standards and best practices for ServiceNow platform development.

description:
About Company
LionsBot International is a leading developer of cutting-edge mobile robotic platforms, committed to revolutionizing industries through innovative technology. With a diverse team of experts passionate about pushing the boundaries of embedded systems technology, we strive to deliver mission-critical firmware that ensures high performance, safety, and reliability across thousands of robots deployed globally. At LionsBot, we believe in fostering a dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative environment where talented individuals from diverse backgrounds can grow and thrive, driving the development of game-changing embedded systems.
About Job
The Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer will play a crucial role in the development of mission-critical firmware for our mobile robotic platforms, requiring precision, creativity, and accountability. This hands-on, technical leadership position demands a deep understanding of microcontrollers, hardware peripherals, and software development, with the ability to work across new and existing products to ensure high performance, safety, and reliability across thousands of robots deployed globally.
This position offers a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and collaborative team of experts who share your passion for pushing the boundaries of embedded systems technology. As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, you will have the opportunity to design and develop cutting-edge embedded systems that have a significant impact across various industries, with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and safety.
Key responsibilities include developing embedded firmware for STM32 and similar microcontrollers, participating in product definition and requirements analysis, collaborating with hardware engineers and system architects, and designing robust low-level drivers and middleware for key communication protocols. You will also be responsible for designing and tuning real-time control loops, owning the embedded firmware lifecycle, and developing test jigs and production-ready validation tools.
Responsibilities
Develop embedded firmware for STM32 and similar microcontrollers used in robotics control, power systems, and sensor integration, ensuring high performance, safety, and reliability, and meeting the evolving needs of the project.
Participate in product definition, specification, and requirements analysis with cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment and clear understanding of project objectives, and promoting effective collaboration and communication.
Collaborate with hardware engineers and system architects to ensure seamless hardware-software integration, resulting in efficient and effective system performance, and minimizing the risk of errors and system failures.
Design robust low-level drivers and middleware for I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Modbus, USB, Ethernet, and other key communication protocols, enabling reliable data exchange between system components, and ensuring high-quality system performance.
Design and tune real-time control loops for motors, battery management systems (BMS), and sensors, ensuring optimal system performance and stability, and meeting the evolving needs of the project.
Own the embedded firmware lifecycle, including bootloader design, structured release/versioning, and over-the-air (OTA) updates, ensuring efficient and flexible firmware updates and maintenance, and minimizing downtime and system disruption.
Develop test jigs and production-ready validation tools for factory use, facilitating efficient and accurate testing and validation of firmware, and ensuring high-quality system performance.
Write clean, well-documented, maintainable code with robust testing and CI integration, ensuring high-quality firmware and efficient collaboration, and promoting knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of embedded systems to identify and resolve software defects and performance issues, ensuring high-quality firmware and system performance, and minimizing the risk of errors and system failures.
Ensure firmware compliance with safety and industry standards (e.g., MISRA, IEC 61508, UL), ensuring the highest level of safety and quality in firmware development, and minimizing the risk of errors and system failures.
Mentor junior firmware engineers and drive code quality through reviews, architecture design sessions, and technical coaching, promoting knowledge sharing and skill development within the team, and ensuring high-quality firmware and system performance.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
4+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience
Deep knowledge of microcontrollers (STM32, Microchip, NXP) and hardware peripherals
Demonstrated experience in writing, testing, and debugging firmware for hardware bring-up and production deployments.
Proficient in modern C/C++, with strong understanding of RTOS and bare-metal programming
Familiarity with digital control or firmware for power electronics is a bonus (PWMs, ADC, digital filter).
Experience in embedded system or signal processing algorithms (DSP) control.
Experience implementing & developing communication stack drivers and networking physical protocols (I2C, SPI, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet, USB, CAN, etc.).
Comfortable using oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, etc.
Comfortable reading hardware schematics and data sheets.
Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD workflows, and structured release processes.
Familiarity with MISRA, IEC62304, or other coding standards is a bonus
Independent worker.
Experience collaborating with remote teams.
One or more scripting languages (e.g. Python, bash etc)

description:
Career in the Hospital
Join our incredible team at the National University Hospital (NUH), where we believe that a hospital is more than just a workplace. Every day, we witness the remarkable impact that our healthcare professionals can have on individuals, families, and entire communities.
At NUH, we are driven by a shared purpose – to lend a helping hand to those in need, to be a source of support and healing, and to empower patients to live their best lives.
We are looking for passionate and committed individuals to join us as we transform lives and create a lasting impact in the lives of our patients. The impact you make at NUH will be profound, regardless of the role you take up in the hospital.
About NUH
The National University Hospital (NUH) is Singapore’s leading university hospital, with a proud heritage dating back to 1905 with the establishment of what’s now the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Our strong ties with the medical school have shaped us into a unique institution, allowing us to seamlessly integrate clinical care with teaching and research. As a university hospital, we go beyond the realm of providing tertiary medical care. We are a hub of knowledge and innovation, attracting healthcare professionals who are passionate about pushing boundaries and making significant contributions to the field.
About Department and Purpose of the Position
The Job Holder will lead strategic data initiatives to transform healthcare delivery through advanced analytics, supporting the department's vision of innovative intersection between Complex Care, Population Health, and Artificial Intelligence. This role will establish and drive data-driven decision-making processes, working closely with clinicians and operational teams to improve patient care outcomes and operational efficiency.
As part of a dynamic team of Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Software Developers, the Analyst will collaborate with clinicians to propose, develop, and implement advanced Artificial Intelligence and machine learning models that augment clinical workflows in NUH. Using a data-driven approach, they will engage in rapid prototyping and continuous iteration to improve care delivery for NUH's patients, ensuring the adequacy and effectiveness of developed models and tools in line with NUH's mission and vision.
The Analyst is also responsible and accountable for the associated data and databases, applying proper data governance and protection practices throughout all initiatives.

Data Analytics
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive data analytics strategies
Design and maintain automated data pipelines and ETL processes
Clean, preprocess, and validate data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness

Develop predictive models and implement machine learning solutions including LLMs
Partner with clinical teams to integrate PROMs into care workflows
Collaborate with GTO and AIO for enhanced data visibility and accessibility
Design and implement LLM-powered solutions for care pathway optimisation

Identify and analyze meaningful patterns, trends, and correlations in healthcare data
Develop and implement data quality checks and validation processes
Prepare and deliver clear and concise reports and presentations to stakeholders
Ensure data visualisations are intuitive and accessible for non-technical audiences
Collaborate with teams across the organisation to understand their data needs

Ensure compliance with NUHS Data Governance Guidelines and relevant healthcare regulations
Implement robust data security measures and access controls
Oversee data quality management and standardisation
Manage data privacy requirements including PDPA and HBRA compliance
Establish protocols for secure data sharing and collaboration
Ensure responsible AI implementation and LLM usage
Other Duties
Any other duties assigned by Reporting Officer
The role’s job scope and compensation may commensurate based on grade and experience.
Key Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Statistics or related field); Master's degree preferred
Minimum 2 years' experience in healthcare analytics or related field
Demonstrated experience developing and deploying LLM applications in production environments with GitHub portfolio showcasing LLM/AI agent projects and clear documentation of role and contributions
Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems beyond academic coursework with evidence of real-world implementation through public repositories, deployed applications, or detailed project case studies
Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI and TIBCO Spotfire
Experience with cloud-based analytic platforms preferably Databricks
Experience with statistical techniques and data mining methods, such as correlation analysis, predictive modelling, A/B testing, and time series forecasting
Experience in implementing and fine-tuning AI models, including knowledge of LLMs and their applications in healthcare
Experience with cloud computing platforms, particularly AWS
Proficiency in containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with web development frameworks including Streamlit, NextJS, and TypeScript
Proficiency in FastAPI or equivalent REST API frameworks
Knowledge of database concepts and experience with database management tools such as SQLAlchemy
Experience in handling large datasets is a plus
Proficiency in Git version control and collaborative development
Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps practices
Strong understanding of healthcare systems and medical terminology
Proven track record in stakeholder management and project delivery
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication, presentation, writing, and interpersonal skills
Strong attention to detail and proven ability to handle and analyse data accurately
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Team player with a positive attitude and ability to work within deadlines
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Closing & Applications
When you join NUH, you become part of a dynamic and collaborative environment where expertise, knowledge, and compassion all come together.
Working in healthcare offers satisfaction that extend far beyond the ordinary. The smiles of gratitude from patients and the profound sense of fulfilment that comes from helping others cannot be measured. It is a career that allows for both personal and professional growth. The challenges you encounter in this rapidly evolving industry push you to constantly expand your knowledge and skills, as well as encourage lifelong learning.
Be a part of a team that gets to create a transformative healthcare experience for our patients and professionals alike.

What is a hackathon?
A hackathon is a competition in which both technical & non-technical talent from all walks of life meet to develop solutions to real-world problems. The period when teams with diverse skill sets and professional levels work together to create a solution is called the hacking period, which may last from 24 hours to weeks, depending on the difficulty of the technology used and the complexity of the expected submission. Provide on-site coordination and support during event days to ensure they run smoothly and problem-solve issues that arise.

Process Improvement

r

description:
About the Role
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented
Quality Control Technician (Microbiology)
to join our Quality and Food Safety team. In this role, you will support microbiological testing and environmental monitoring to ensure the safety, quality, and regulatory compliance of our cocoa-based products—including cocoa powder, liquor, and butter. You will work closely with laboratory and production teams to uphold high standards of food safety and product integrity.
Key Responsibilities
Microbiological Testing & Sample Management
Prepare and handle raw materials, in-process, finished products, and environmental samples following aseptic techniques.
Conduct routine and non-routine microbiological tests such as Total Plate Count (TPC), Yeasts and Molds, Enterobacteriaceae, Salmonella spp., and other indicator or pathogenic organisms.
Operate laboratory equipment including incubators, autoclaves, colony counters, etc.
Ensure test results are accurate, repeatable, and compliant with specifications.
Environmental Monitoring
Carry out scheduled sampling of production and hygiene-sensitive areas (air, surfaces, equipment, personnel).
Analyse environmental samples, record deviations, and escalate abnormal findings to the Microbiology Supervisor.
Data Management & Reporting
Record test observations, results, and deviations accurately in laboratory logs or digital systems.
Perform timely data entry in MES or LIMS (if applicable).
Highlight out-of-specification results and support root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions (CAPA), and related documentation.
Laboratory Maintenance & Safety
Maintain laboratory hygiene through routine cleaning, disinfection, and equipment upkeep.
Follow biosafety standards and PPE requirements.
Report equipment issues, safety hazards, or non‑conformances promptly.
Compliance & Continuous Improvement
Adhere to SOPs, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), and internal quality standards.
Assist with method validation, equipment qualification, and inter-laboratory comparisons.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance laboratory efficiency and testing accuracy.
Mentor new technicians on laboratory procedures and best practices.
Requirements
Fresh graduates or candidates with 1–2 years of relevant laboratory experience are welcome.
Minimum O‑level, Nitec, or Diploma in Food Science, Microbiology, or related field.
Experience in microbiological testing within the food industry is advantageous.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills.
Preferred: Basic SAP knowledge and familiarity with laboratory safety procedures.

2026 Summer Internship Programme - Macro Trading, Singapore
The Firm
Brevan Howard Asset Management is one of the leading absolute return/hedge fund managers, overseeing assets on behalf of institutional investors from around the world, including pension funds, endowments, insurance companies, government agencies, private banks, and fund of funds.
Brevan Howard was founded in 2002 and launched its flagship global macro strategy in April 2003. The firm currently manages over $34bn and engages predominantly in discretionary directional and relative value trading in fixed income, FX markets, and equities. BH Digital, a division within Brevan Howard that manages crypto and digital asset strategies was launched in 2022.
The firm currently employs over 1,000 personnel worldwide, including over 400 investment professionals. This global presence gives Brevan Howard the ability to identify and source attractive investment opportunities, as well as investment management talent wherever they may be. Brevan Howard has won several industry awards for excellence in risk management, operational robustness, and investment performance.
The firm's main hubs are in London, Jersey, Geneva, New York, Austin, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi.
Overview & Responsibilities
Our ten-week summer Internship Programme seeks to hire ambitious, enthusiastic candidates who have strong mathematical, quantitative backgrounds and coding skills, with demonstrated passion for markets and an interest to work on all facets of Portfolio Management. Interns will work with our investment teams, within Macro and Equities Trading.

snippet: HOPE Technik – Engineering the Future, Delivering Excellence
description:

: Singapore (Onsite)
Company Overview
:
Hope Technik is a homegrown engineering powerhouse specializing in the design and manufacture of high-specification vehicles, robotics, and specialized engineering solutions. Known for our "0-to-1" spirit, we push the boundaries of technology to deliver mission-critical platforms for defense, emergency services, and industrial sectors.
Join a team of passionate innovators where your designs don't just stay on a screen—they are built, tested, and deployed to solve real-world challenges.
Role Overview
:
We are looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our scaling team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between digital design and physical reality, spending approximately 70% of your time on CAD development and 30% on the workshop floor. You will be responsible for owning sub-assembly designs for specialized vehicles and containerized systems, ensuring they are robust, functional, and ready for deployment.
Key Responsibilities
:
End-to-End Mechanical Design:
Devise innovative solutions at the assembly and sub-assembly levels, creating detailed CAD models and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks.
Hands-on Prototyping & Testing:
Lead the build-up of prototypes and Proof of Concepts (POCs). You will actively support fabrication, welding, and assembly processes to see your designs come to life.
Engineering Analysis:
Perform structural analysis (FEA) on components and sub-assemblies to ensure they meet stringent design specifications and performance standards.
Technical Documentation:
Translate complex customer needs into technical requirements, producing comprehensive design documents, test reports, and risk assessments.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with workshop teams to ensure Design for Manufacture (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA), identifying and resolving mechanical issues in real-time.
Requirements
:
Minimum/Core Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks is highly preferred).
Demonstrated experience in mechanical design, which may include professional roles, internships, or significant academic projects involving complex assemblies.
Strong mechanical aptitude and a desire to work in a "shop floor" environment; you enjoy getting your hands dirty and working alongside fabricators.
Foundational knowledge of sheet metal parts, weldments, truss structures, and kinematic solutions.
Genuine Occupational Requirement:
Due to the nature of our specialized vehicle and defense projects, candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary security clearances required for these sensitive programs.
Preferred/Bonus Requirements:
Experience in the design of hydraulic circuits (pumps, valves, cylinders, and safety locks).
Prior exposure to specialized vehicles, mobile platforms, or large-scale ruggedized structures.
Familiarity with SolidWorks Simulation for quasi-static loading analysis.
Why you should be interested
:
True Ownership:
This isn't a "paper-pushing" engineering role. You will own your designs from the first sketch to the final physical prototype.
Scale and Impact:
Work on large-scale, high-impact projects that require a unique blend of creativity and heavy-engineering rigor.
Rapid Learning Curve:
Whether you are a fresh graduate or a junior engineer, you will receive mentorship from some of the best engineering minds in the region while enjoying high levels of autonomy.
Innovation at Heart:
Be part of a culture that values innovation and technical excellence, where your ideas are heard and implemented.

The IT Helpdesk Manager is responsible for overseeing and delivering end‑user IT services while remaining actively involved in day‑to‑day technical operations. This is a hands‑on leadership role that combines people management, service ownership, and direct technical contribution to ensure high‑quality support, operational stability, and a positive end‑user experience across the organization.
The role manages a team of support engineers and acts as the primary owner of end‑user support services, endpoint operations, and helpdesk performance.
Key Responsibilities
1. End‑User Support & Service Delivery (Hands‑On)
Provide and oversee technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
Actively participate in troubleshooting hardware and software issues, especially for complex or high‑impact cases.
Ensure timely resolution of IT support requests in accordance with defined SLA targets.
Serve as the escalation point for unresolved incidents and step in when required to restore service quickly.
2. People Management & Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of EUC / Helpdesk engineers, including interns and junior staff.
Own hiring, onboarding, training, and day‑to‑day people management for the team.
Conduct performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support career development and skills progression.
Address performance issues and coordinate with HR on disciplinary or corrective actions when required.
Foster a customer‑centric, collaborative, and accountable team culture.
3. Service Management & Operational Ownership
Own end‑user support services and helpdesk operations end‑to‑end.
Define, maintain, and continuously improve helpdesk processes, SOPs, and escalation workflows.
Ensure consistent service quality across regions and support locations.
Act as the primary point of accountability for service outcomes and user satisfaction.
4. Device Deployment & Endpoint Management
Oversee and participate in the preparation, deployment, and refresh of laptops, desktops, and IT equipment.
Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, applications, and security updates.
Ensure endpoint standardization and compliance with company security and IT policies.
Support endpoint management initiatives such as MDM, patching, device compliance, and health monitoring.
5. IT Asset, Procurement & Budget Coordination
Maintain accurate records of IT assets including laptops, monitors, and accessories.
Oversee asset lifecycle management including issuance, return, refresh, and disposal.
Coordinate with procurement and vendors for hardware purchases and renewals.
Support budget planning and cost control for end‑user computing and helpdesk‑related spend.
6. Account, Access & Identity Support
Oversee user account provisioning, access requests, and password resets.
Ensure access management processes align with security, audit, and governance requirements.
Work closely with Infrastructure and Security teams on access‑related controls and reviews.
7. Escalation, Vendor & Cross‑Team Coordination
Diagnose and resolve complex issues using structured troubleshooting approaches.
Coordinate escalations with Level 2/3 Infrastructure, Security, or Application teams.
Manage and engage external vendors for endpoint‑related support and services.
Act as the EUC point of contact for cross‑team initiatives, rollouts, and regional projects.
8. Governance, Security & Compliance
Ensure endpoint security practices are enforced, including patching, antivirus, encryption, and access controls.
Support internal and external IT audits related to end‑user computing and helpdesk operations.
Promote security awareness and guide users on safe and compliant use of IT systems and tools.
9. Reporting, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze service metrics such as SLA performance, ticket trends, and user satisfaction.
Prepare regular reports and insights for IT leadership.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance the end‑user experience.
Drive root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
10. Documentation & Knowledge Management
Ensure accurate documentation of configurations, procedures, and support processes.
Enforce use of and contribution to the internal knowledge base.
Promote knowledge sharing and standardization within the team.

Strong hands‑on experience supporting Windows and macOS environments and end‑user devices.
Proven experience managing or leading an IT Helpdesk or EUC team.
Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g. Intune, SCCM, or equivalent).
Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow).
Solid troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and basic networking.
Ability to balance technical execution with people and service leadership.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and escalation handling skills.

Degree or Diploma in Information Technology or related field.
ITIL certification or equivalent service management experience.
Experience supporting multi‑region or global end‑user environments.

Rapsodo is a Sports Technology company with offices in the USA, Singapore, Turkey & Japan. From Major League Baseball star pitchers to Golf tour players, athletes use Rapsodo technology to up their game across the world. Trusted by coaches and players from youths to professionals, Rapsodo provides real-time insights for all-time performance.
We are innovative, focused, and rapidly growing. We are continuously looking for very driven team players who will stop at nothing to deliver state-of-the-art solutions as part of Team Rapsodo.
As an MBA Intern at Rapsodo, you will contribute to strategic decision-making by providing comprehensive market research, conducting thorough analysis, and identifying potential business opportunities. Working closely with the CEO and CFO, you will assist in developing presentations, formulating business plans, and executing key projects. This internship is designed to challenge and enhance your business acumen, analytical skills, and leadership abilities, providing you with a solid foundation for a successful career in the sports analytics industry.
Responsibilities
Market Research: Conduct extensive market research and analysis to identify emerging trends, evaluate competitors, understand customer preferences, and uncover potential target markets. Utilize a wide range of sources, including industry reports, databases, and primary research, to gather and synthesize relevant information.
Business Analysis: Analyze financial data, operational metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess Rapsodo's performance and identify areas for improvement. Develop actionable insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
Project Management: Support the CEO and CFO in managing and executing strategic projects by conducting thorough research, gathering data, and creating well-defined project plans. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project milestones and objectives are met.
Business Development: Explore and evaluate potential business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and untapped markets. Conduct comprehensive feasibility studies and prepare persuasive business cases to support investment decisions and growth initiatives.
Presentation and Reporting: Prepare and deliver professional, concise, and visually engaging presentations to senior management, stakeholders, and potential partners. Summarize complex data and analysis into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Business Planning: Assist in the development of robust business plans, financial models, and forecasts. Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity testing to evaluate the impact of various factors on business performance.
Stay abreast of industry trends, market dynamics, and best practices in sports analytics and business analysis.
Requirements
Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA degree from a reputable university or business school.
Analytical Skills: Exceptional analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, perform rigorous financial analysis, and generate valuable insights.
Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated ability to think strategically and provide valuable input to business decisions. Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive landscape, and industry trends in the sports analytics domain.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create compelling presentations and reports. Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and deliver results within established deadlines. Meticulous attention to detail with strong organizational and time management skills.
Business Acumen: Solid understanding of business principles, financial concepts, and the ability to translate analysis into actionable strategies aligned with organizational goals.
Proficiency in Technology: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with data analysis tools or programming languages is highly desirable.

Junior Legal Counsel

Assist in corporate governance, compliance and regulatory matters where relevant.

Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations, including but not limited to data protection and privacy laws.
Keep abreast of relevant legal developments and changes in laws and regulations that may impact the business.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date internal records.
Support ad-hoc projects as the business and group continues to grow and evolve.
Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit:
Law degree from a recognised university.
Qualified lawyer in SG, UK or other common law jurisdiction with 2 to 3 years of legal experience.
Strong knowledge of corporate and commercial law or M&A. Prior experience in IP, TMT, regulatory practice or in industries such as technology, gaming or digital services would be an added advantage but not compulsory.
Excellent written and oral communication skills with experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts.
Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
A motivated, reliable, meticulous, disciplined self-starter with strong work ethic who thinks and works proactively and independently with minimal supervision while being a collaborative team player.
Ability to manage and support projects across multiple geographies and diverse subject matters.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think and negotiate creatively and effectively, balancing legal constraints with business goals and objectives and engage effectively with both legal and non-legal stakeholders across various backgrounds.

title: Technical Director
snippet: The Technical Director is responsible for providing the strategic leadership, technical direction and expert opinions for the Singapore Silat...
description:
Role Description
The Technical Director is responsible for providing the strategic leadership, technical direction and expert opinions for the Singapore Silat Federation in four main areas:
a) High Performance Planning & Systems Development
b) Athlete Pathway & Outreach of Sport Development
c) Quality Daily Training Environment
d) Coach Education & Capability Development
Key Responsibilities:
1. High Performance Planning & Systems Development
1.1 Develop and drive a High Performance Plan (within six months of commencement of employment) to deliver an overall objective of continued podium success based on the agreed upon key performance indicators and the “National High Performance Sports’ Visions & Ambitions” at the Major Games and international/continental competitions.
1.2 Periodic review of the established High Performance Plan for continuous improvement, adapting to environmental/situational changes within the local and international Silat scene.
1.3 Contribute to, and/or prepare the selection policies for the nomination of athletes for Major Games, Major Championships and competitions including tiering of overseas competitions for national junior athletes’ representation for exposure.
1.4 Lead and co-ordinate the selection process of athletes to represent Singapore at Major Games, Major Championships and competitions, in consultation with the National Coaches and JMC.
1.5 Conduct and provide a report on post-games and/or post-competition performance review for future competition preparation.
1.6 Organise and lead regular communications across the National Coaches and high performance support staff including those in HPSI.
1.7 Foster and manage close working relationships with National Coaches (defining their roles and responsibilities), stakeholders and leads of other disciplines to ensure a cohesive and dynamic performance-based team culture.
2. Athlete Pathway & Outreach of Sport Development
2.1 Provide strategic direction to the development of Silat in Singapore by synergizing existing the feeder systems with new outreach of sport and pathway development initiatives.
2.2 Develop and implement plans/programmes for youth development and talent/potential identification based on proven talent identification (and specialisation) methodology at every age group that suits the local system, in consultation with HPSI.
2.3 Establish and implement a robust talent pathway development structure/plan that would ensure a sustainable pipeline for the National Squad.
2.4 Undertake regular visits to identified performance hubs across Singapore for talent identification.
2.5 Planning and advise on local/national competitions for talent/potential identification for the National Squad.
2.6 Establish close rapport with stakeholders such as local coaches, teachers-in-charge etc for customised school and outreach of sport programmes.
3. Quality Daily Training Environment
3.1 Work closely with the National Coaches and high-performance support staff to create a quality elite athlete daily training environment, incorporating performance support services, sport science & sport medicine, equipment and access to world class facilities (including overseas training camps).
3.2 Contribute to the review and performance planning of the Multi-Year Periodized Training Plan and Yearly Planning Instrument of the National Squad, ensuring quality integration of performance servicing such as sports science and sports medicine support.
4. Coach Education & Capability Development
4.1 Develop a holistic and comprehensive Coaching Pathway Plan which enables the growth of all attributes of a high-performance coach and coaching expertise for the promotion of Silat, and the development of medal-winning elite athletes (all levels).
4.2 Plan and develop technical manuals for Silat Technical courses and coach education resources, integrating SportSG’s CoachSG coaching curriculum guidelines and recommendations for best practices.
4.3 Plan, mentor, conduct technical courses, and make provisions for coaching attachments/apprenticeship for identified local coaches as part of succession planning.
4.4 Advocate applied coaching methods using performance data and sports science.
4.5 Formulate and establish guidelines for the selection of National Coaches and contract preparation.
Additional Responsibilities
5. Budget Planning & Management
5.1 Work closely with Silat for annual Multi Year Sports Plan submission.
5.2 Plan and manage the National Squad’s budgets based on the agreed upon targets in consultation with the High-Performance Manager, National Squad Coaches and HPSI.
5.3 Plan and manage the athlete annual pathway and coach development budgets.
6. Reporting
6.1 To attend SSF Board Meetings, JMC Meetings, Functional Sports Programme Meetings and all high performance related meetings.
6.2 To submit quarterly reports to the JMC on progress made in the specified areas of responsibility.
6.3 To submit budget proposals to the JMC for approvals.
6.4 To submit all other reports and statistics as and when required.
6.5 To attend working committee meetings with the High Performance Manager every month or when required, to review past developments and forward planning.
6.6 To undertake additional tasks and responsibilities as required by the [name of nsa] and/or the JMC.
Pre-requisites
In addition to demonstrating relevant experiences across the functional areas identified in this Job Description, candidates applying for the role will require a range of personal and professional skills, including:
7. Qualifications/Experiences
7.1 A recognized technical Coaching Certification (minimum Level 3).
7.2 A recognized university degree in a related field of study would be an advantage.
7.3 At least 5-10 years of extensive experience of coaching including leading of a team coaches, support services and athletes in a high-performance environment.
7.4 Strong international networks with top training centres that would allow coaches and athletes to benefit from.
7.5 Strong understanding of the International Federation Rules and Regulations and Anti-Doping rules.
7.6 Leadership and management experience with extensive exposure to high performance related matters and solutions.
7.7 Ability to accurately analyse and translate performance data into meaningful programme opportunities and to enhance athletes’ performance.
7.8 Experience in driving a high-performance system at least at national level. Prior experience in working with a country having a similar demographics as Singapore and in-depth understanding of the regional Silat scene would be an added advantage.
7.9 Able to conceptualise and submit proposals, reports and programmes independently.
8. High Performance Behaviours
8.1 Strong desire and passion to excel at whatever task at hand; seeking to achieve world-class levels of professionalism, technical delivery and quality standards.
8.2 Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain positive working relationships with athletes, coaches, support staff and stakeholders.
8.3 Ability to identify strengths/weaknesses and opportunities for improvement, constructively challenges traditional assumptions and methods.
8.4 Actively accommodates and implements change initiatives.
8.5 A good understanding and/or willingness to utilise technology and performance monitoring tools.
8.6 Use appropriate techniques and communication strategies to gain acceptance of ideas and plans.
8.7 High adaptability in customising programmes such that it will thrive in local context.
9. General
9.1 Strong written and spoken command of the English Language.
9.2 Able to deliver effective presentations.
9.3 Exceptional planning and attention to details.
9.4 Excellent relationship and management skills.

title: Internship - Quantitative Strategist
snippet: Virtu's internship program offers graduate students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have...
description:
Virtu is an industry-leading financial technology firm that operates both proprietary trading and client-facing businesses in the global financial marketplace. Our cutting edge, proprietary technology is core to everything we do. We trade in over 35 countries, across 235 financial exchanges and over 25% of retail order flow in the US. is serviced by Virtu.
Our team is a dedicated group of traders, quants and developers that are inspired by the unique and exciting challenges we solve every day. Our culture combines the creativity of a fast paced start up, with the stability of a disciplined financial services firm. We are a flat organization and encourage our people to innovate and lean on their teammates for support and collaboration. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do.
Quantitative Strategist Internship (Singapore)
Virtu's internship program offers graduate students an extraordinary opportunity to learn about the firm and the world’s financial markets. We have built a thoughtful and challenging curriculum with projects that introduce students to the many complex and ever changing problems to solve. Students can expect a company-curated global training week for our interns, real quantitative problems to solve throughout the program and engaging social events to get to know our team and culture.
Location: Singapore
Dates: 10 week program, starting June 8th 2026 - August 14th 2026 (with some flexibility if needed).
Training: Ongoing training throughout the summer and a training week held in Singapore.
Projects: Real problems to solve throughout the program. Interns will work from a list of projects and have several senior mentors throughout the summer program.
Perks: Daily Breakfast, Lunch Allowance, Transport Allowance, Onsite Gym & Workout Classes, Massage Sessions, Social Events
Our Quantitative Strategists and Researchers are an integral part of the algorithmic research team, working to improve Virtu's trading algorithms through transforming large data sets into usable trading models. Successful quantitative researchers work well independently and collaboratively, enjoy learning and applying new algorithmic techniques, and are excited to see their ideas turn into tangible results.
Interns will work directly with senior members of the team on our trading strategies used in Virtu's customer market making business. Interns in this track will apply their quantitative analysis and research skills to discover patterns that can potentially improve our trading algorithms. Through these projects, interns will learn about Virtu's market making business, learn to apply basic data analysis tools to large trading data sets and be pushed to think out of the box for trading ideas. Each intern will complete one to two projects which could come from different mentors and groups.
Requirements
Rising juniors, or students expected to be ready for full time employment between December 2026 - June 2027
Advanced degree (preferably PhD) in Science, Math, Engineering or other quantitative field
History of diverse, challenging, and interesting coursework paired with a strong GPA
Exceptional quantitative, mathematical, and problem-solving skills
Great communication skills and the ability to collaborate with peers
Ability to solve technical and or quantitative problems under pressure
Ability to express ideas mathematically and algorithmically
Strong programming skills (especially C/C++ and Python, Pandas)
Intellectually curious and self-motivated
Ability to communicate within and across teams, at a high and low level, on both technical and non-technical subjects
Ability to seek guidance and learn new skills from peers
Extraordinary mental flexibility and a high tolerance for ambiguity
Strong drive for success within a collaborative team
Interest in financial markets
THE PROCESS
After applicants pass an initial resume screening, an online programming test will be emailed to you via Hackerrank. Upon review, we will reach out to arrange next steps. We are looking forward to meeting you!

Role Overview
As our Software Tester, you’ll be responsible for testing everything from our web and mobile apps to the APIs and device integrations behind them. Contribute to regression testing suites and ensure that releases meet quality standards.
Suggest improvements for testability, reliability, and automation opportunities.

Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and passion for quality.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment.

Familiarity with automated testing tools (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Pytest).

Knowledge of performance or security testing.

Work on products that directly improve safety for real-world workers.

title: Junior Quant Trader (2026 Start, Training in Chicago)
snippet: Over the 3-day virtual course, participants will work through five lectures with our trading team, and complete five corresponding quizzes. By the...
description:
Highlight:
You will start in the Akuna Capital Singapore office as a Junior Quant Trader in the derivatives trading domain.
This is a unique opportunity, as the trader training program for this role will take place in Akuna's Chicago headquarters.
Once your training is complete, you will return to Akuna’s Singapore office to trade full-time on one of our trading desks.
The role will provide you with:
a systematic educational program to help you develop quickly, and
a global vision and work experience to extend your knowledge on international markets across a diverse set of asset classes, and
a welcoming and supportive culture with a strong emphasis on collaboration and employee growth.
Timeline:
Application Deadline: April 1, Wed, 2026, SGT
Interview Round 1 (Options 201 course, please refer to below section for further details): April 6, Mon – April 8, Wed, 2026
Final Round Interview: April 10, Fri – April 14, Fri, 2026
Start Date: your start date is expected in August 2026 based on visa condition
Chicago Training: starting August 24, 2026
What you'll do as a Junior Quant Trader at Akuna Singapore office:
Our traders are bright, well-rounded thinkers, competitive, and ambitious! Joining us as a Junior Quant Trader means you don't need to have any finance or trading experience. We are looking for individuals with potential, a desire to compete and drive to create immediate impact in our firm.
Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. Our Juniors are trusted with more responsibility and opportunity to advance quickly in your career. We have brilliant young people leading some of our largest desks and have several emerging desks in growth phase.
We’re committed to providing collaborative & valuable mentorship from our experienced Traders that will help you to learn quickly, find value from our Trader Training Program(introduction as below) and make an immediate impact on the business.
What you can expect after applying:
Apply for this role with your most updated resume by April 1, 2026
After passing the resume screen, you will be invited to join our Options 201 course (introduction as below) as the first-round interview which will take place ~1.5 hours per day for 3 consecutive days from April 6 to April 8, 2026 from 6:30am SGT.
Top performers will be expedited to final round interviews during April 10 to April 24
You can expect to hear from your recruiter on initial application updates in ~2 business days.
Akuna Capital’s Options 201 Course:
During our 3-day virtual Options 201 Course, running from
April 6 to April 8, 2026
, we will build upon what is introduced in our online Akuna’s Options 101 Course. We will deep dive into how market makers 1) price options 2) analyze risk 3) automate their workflow and more. Please note that prior completion of the Options 101 Course is not required, but highly recommended.
Over the 3-day virtual course, participants will work through five lectures with our trading team, and complete five corresponding quizzes. By the end of the course, we expect all participants to better understand options market making, and most importantly, have a better idea of whether trading is the right career for them.
Top performers will be expedited to final round interviews for our Junior Quant Trader role. As mentioned, this role includes trader training in Akuna’s Chicago headquarters, providing a unique opportunity for successful candidates.
Trader Training Program at Akuna Chicago office:
Your learning is important to us! You will begin our Akuna Training Program with lectures, projects, written assessments, mock trading games and job shadowing at our Chicago office which takes around 3 months. We will teach you all about:
Market Making
Options Greeks
Risk Management
Proprietary systems.
Guided by our experienced traders,
mock market games
will teach you how to value futures and options, hedge your risk, and get comfortable with option combinations, all while staking real money as you compete against your peers.
Junior Quant traders will develop their technical skills (coding is not a requirement!) via
statistics-based projects
aimed at solving real problems being faced by our trading teams. These might involve conducting analysis and constructing models using python and Excel or building interactive trading tools for use on our desks.
We place traders with teams so that they can get experience and build and broaden their skills and eventually select where we believe they can have the biggest impact and career growth. Our team values strong mental maths, great communication, and a passion for creative problem solving. If you’re ready to challenge yourself at an exciting firm with opportunity to grow and develop, Akuna is the place for you!
Requirements for this role:
Able to dedicate 1.5-2 hours each day throughout
April 6-April 8, 2026
to attend Options 201 course including virtual lectures, mini-shadows, office hours, and complete quizzes.
Able to meet the timelines per illustrated “Timeline” section above
Graduated before July 2026 with 0-2 years’ experience
Bachelor, Masters or PhDs in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Mechanics, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Economics, FinTech, Data Science, Business Analytics, Financial Engineering, Big Data or related degrees
Quick mental maths, pattern recognition, and probability skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Desire to learn about financial markets and economic theories
Risk appetite & ability to work well under pressure in a face paced, team environment
Qualities that make great candidates:
Distinction Average or proven strong academics
Awards, prizes, medals, competitions, and scholarships
Achievements outside of studies through your hobbies and interests
Work experience that enhanced your communication, problem solving, analytical, and teamwork skills
About Akuna:
Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market-maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.
Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Singapore, Shanghai, Boston and London.
At Akuna, we believe that the people are the centre of everything we do. Our brand-new Singapore office is open most recently and has a close-knit start-up feel - you really get to know the team! We are growing and looking for the best talent to join us on this journey. If you enjoy being part of smart, driven teams with real challenges to solve- this could be the place for you!

description:

a place to do great work

a great place to work,
providing you the unique, gamer-centric #LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.
Job Responsibilities :
This role will focus on designing and developing advanced Reinforcement Learning (RL) driven solutions for game developers and players. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in RL algorithms, agent-based modeling, and scalable training frameworks to create intelligent gameplay agents and adaptive in-game behaviors. This role involves working closely with AI engineers, game developers, and software engineers to build cutting-edge AI capabilities that enhance exploration and fast iteration in production environments.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Design and deploy reinforcement learning (RL) agents in the gaming domain to support in-house AI services.
Research, prototype, and evaluate RL agents with different policies and learning methodologies.
Develop reward functions, learning strategies, and training environments aligned with gameplay objectives.
Optimize agent performance through hyperparameter tuning, reward shaping, and model architecture refinement.
Generalize RL agent solutions to scale across various game engines and games spanning multiple genres.
Incorporate state, event, and perception signals into RL observation spaces.
Evaluate agents using task success metrics, stability, sample efficiency, and convergence behavior.
Analyze agent failures and debug training instabilities or policy collapse.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineers, developers, researchers) to integrate RL gameplay agents seamlessly into games.
Document training pipelines, assumptions, and evaluation results.
Qualifications
Proficiency in Python, experience in compiled languages like C++ / Rust is a plus.
Hands-on experience in PyTorch, MLX, TensorFlow, or similar reinforcement libraries.
Solid understanding of policy-based, value-based, and actor-critic methods.
Experience with reward design and exploration strategies.
Familiarity with simulation environments or gaming frameworks (e.g., OpenAI Gym, Unity, Unreal Engine).
Experience designing state representations, observation spaces, and action abstractions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.
Preferred
Experience with multi-agent RL, self-play, or adversarial training.
Exposure to offline RL, imitation learning, or hybrid approaches.
Experience with messaging and communication technologies such as RabbitMQ, gRPC, REST APIs for service integration.
Familiarity with experiment tracking, reproducibility, and evaluation tooling.
Education & Experience
Master’s or PhD in a relevant field (Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, etc.).
2+ years of applied experience in reinforcement learning (academic or industry).
Travel Requirements
Role based in Singapore office, with occasional travel (up to
1 trip per year
) for conferences, research collaborations, or business meetings.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Enablement

description:
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Enablement team and drive company-wide developer productivity. You will build and evolve internal platforms, services, and toolchains that power engineering workflows across Motional.
In this role, you will partner closely with teams across the organization to identify systemic bottlenecks, design scalable, self-service developer platforms that reduce cognitive load, streamline CI/CD workflows, and enable teams to move from code to production with speed and confidence.
Your primary focus will be our internal developer platform and productivity tooling, enabling engineers to ship reliable, high-quality code faster and more efficiently.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Build scalable backend services, CI/CD pipelines, build systems, toolchains and platforms that can support developer workflows
Work closely with engineering teams throughout the company to understand their needs, identify pain-points and drive initiatives to improve their development workflows
Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, and observability across distributed systems by introducing new tools and/or building new features
Monitor system performance and health, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact users
Contribute to system architecture decisions and technical roadmaps
What We Are Looking For:
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience
5+ years in Software Engineering or related roles
Strong background in modern programming languages (Python, Go, C++ are the ones we use).
Experience with Unix-like environments, software, and toolchains.
Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g. GitLab CI, Jenkins), cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP) & infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Expertise in software development lifecycle including the ability to understand ambiguous goals and convert them into software requirements
Strong communication and interpersonal skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Bonus Points (not required, but a plus):
Experience in the AV industry or robotics
Deep expertise with monorepo software development tools and services (e.g. Bazel)
Previously been on on-call roster to support P1 & P0 systems
Experience with AI/LLM integration, specifically building/extending Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enhance developer productivity and system automation.
Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.
Our journey is always people first.
We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.
Higher purpose, greater impact.
We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.
Scale up, not starting up.
Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.
Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.
